אב.definition: 1) father of an individual; 2) of God as father of his people; 3) head or founder of a household, group, family, or clan; 4) ancestor; 4a) grandfather, forefathers - of person; 4b) of people; 5) originator or patron of a class, profession, or art; 6) of producer, generator (fig.); 7) of benevolence and protection (fig.); 8) term of respect and honour; 9) ruler or chief (spec.); Also means: av (אַב "father" H0002)
אב.grammar_note: Segholate noun with irregular plural אָבוֹת
אב.forms: pl. אָבוֹת, cstr. אֲבִי, w/suff. אָבִי
אב.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic *ʾab- 'father'. Cognate with Akkadian abu, Arabic ʾab.

אבגתא.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Est.1.10 ; § Abagtha = "God-given"; one of the seven eunuchs in the Persian court of Ahasuerus;

אבד.definition: 1) perish, vanish, go astray, be destroyed; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) perish, die, be exterminated; 1a2) perish, vanish (fig.); 1a3) be lost, strayed; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to destroy, kill, cause to perish, to give up (as lost), exterminate; 1b2) to blot out, do away with, cause to vanish, (fig.); 1b3) cause to stray, lose; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to destroy, put to death; 1c1a) of divine judgment; 1c2) object name of kings (fig.); Aramaic equivalent: a.vad (אֲבַד "to destroy" H0007)

אבה.definition: 1) to be willing, consent; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be willing; 1a2) to consent, yield to, accept; 1a3) to desire

אבוי.definition: Oh!, Woe!, (exclamation of pain - indicates desire or uneasiness)
אבוי.grammar_note: from H14 (אָבָה) (in the sense of desiring);

אבחה.grammar_note: from an unused root (apparently meaning to turn);

אביאל.definition: Abiel = "El (God) is (my) father"; Saul's grandfather, a man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.9.1; ; son of: Zeror (H6872C); married to Maacah (H4601N); ; father of: Kish (H7027), Ner (H5369), Abdon (H5658J), Zur (H6698I), Baal (H1168B), Nadab (H5070J), Gedor (H1446I), Ahio (H0283I), Zecher (H2144) and Mikloth (H4732); also called Jeiel (Ketiv: Jeuel; KJV: Jehiel) at 1Ch.9.35; Ner at 1Ch.8.33; 9.39;
אביאל.grammar_note: from H1 (אָב) and H410 (אֵל); father (i.e. possessor) of God;

אביאסף.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.6.24; ; son of: Korah (H7141I); ; brother of: Assir (H0617) and Elkanah (H0511); ; father of: Assir (H0617H) and Kore (H6981); also called Abiasaph at Exo.6.24; Asaph at 1Ch.26.1; ; Another name of ev.ya.saph (אֶבְיָסָף, אֲבִיאָסָף "Ebiasaph" H0043) ; § Abiasaph = "my father has gathered"; son (descendant) of Korah;
אביאסף.grammar_note: from H1 (אָב) and H622 (אָסַף); father of gathering (i.e. gatherer);

אביב.definition: Month of exodus and passover (March or April) ; Also named: ni.san (נִיסָן "Nisan" H5212) ; This name means fresh, young barley ears, barley;
אביב.grammar_note: from an unused root (meaning to be tender);

אבי גבעון.definition: Abi Gibon = "father of Gibeon"; site of great Bamah, location of the tabernacle of the Lord in the high place
אבי גבעון.grammar_note: from H1 (אָב) and H1391 (גִּבְעוֹן); father (i.e. founder) of Gibon;

אביגיל.definition: Abigail or Abigal, the name of two Israelitesses
אביגיל.grammar_note: or shorter אֲבִיגַל; from H1 (אָב) and H1524 (גִּיל); father (i.e. source) of joy;

אבידן.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.1.11; ; son of: Gideoni (H1441) ; § Abidan = "my father is judge"; a prince (ruler) of Benjamin;
אבידן.grammar_note: from H1 (אָב) and H1777 (דִּין); father of judgment (i.e. judge);

אבידע.definition: A man of the Midianites living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.25.4; ; son of: Midian (H4080); ; brother of: Ephah (H5891), Epher (H6081), Hanoch (H2585I) and Eldaah (H0420) ; § Abida or Abidah = "my father knows"; fourth son of Midian and grandson of Abraham by his wife Keturah (after Sarah died);
אבידע.grammar_note: from H1 (אָב) and H3045 (יָדַע); father of knowledge (i.e. knowing);

אביה.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.8.2; ; son of: Samuel (H8050); ; brother of: Joel (H3100); § Abia or Abiah or Abijah = "Jehovah is (my) father"; second son of Samuel
אביה.grammar_note: or prolonged אֲבִיָּהוּ ; from H1 (אָב) and H3050 (יָהּ); father (i.e. worshipper) of Jah;

אביהוא.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.6.23; ; son of: Aaron (H0175) and Elisheba (H0472); ; brother of: Nadab (H5070), Eleazar (H0499) and Ithamar (H0385) ; § Abihu = "he is (my) father"; a son of Aaron destroyed for sacrificing strange fire to God;
אביהוא.grammar_note: from H1 (אָב) and H1931 (הוּא); father (i.e. worshipper) of Him (i.e. God);

אביהוד.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at 1Ch.8.3; ; son of: Bela (H1106A); ; brother of: Ard (H0714H), Naaman (H5283H), Ezbon (H0675H), Uzzi (H5813I), Uzziel (H5816I), Jerimoth (H3406), Iri (H5901), Addar (H0146H), Gera (H1617I), Abishua (H0050H) and Ahoah (H0265) ; § Abihud = "my father is majesty"; son of Bela, a Benjamite;
אביהוד.grammar_note: from H1 (אָב) and H1935 (הוֹד); father (i.e. possessor) of renown;

אביהיל.definition: Abihail or Abichail, the name of three Israelites and two Israelitesses
אביהיל.grammar_note: or (more correctly) אֲבִיחַיִל ; from H1 (אָב) and H2428 (חַיִל); father (i.e. possessor) of might;

אבי העזרי.definition: Someone descended from Abiezer, a man of the tribe of Manasseh living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.26.30; ; son of: Gilead (H1568H); ; brother of: Helek (H2507), Asriel (H0844), Shechem (H7928), Shemida (H8061) and Hepher (H2660A); also called Iezer (KJV: Jeezer) at Num.26.30; ; Group of a.vi.e.zer (אֲבִיעֶ֫זֶר "Abiezer" H0044I) ; § Abiezrite = "my father is help"; one of the family of Abiezer, a descendant of Joseph's son, Manasseh;
אבי העזרי.grammar_note: from H44 (אֲבִיעֶזֶר) with the article inserted; father of the Ezrite;

אביון.definition: 1) in want, needy, chiefly poor, needy person; 2) subject to oppression and abuse; 3) needing help, deliverance from trouble, especially as delivered by God; 4) general reference to lowest class
אביון.grammar_note: from H14 (אָבָה), in the sense of want (especially in feeling);

אביטוב.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.8.11; ; son of: Shaharaim (H7842) and Hushim (H2366A); ; brother of: Jobab (H3103J), Zibia (H6644), Mesha (H4331), Malcam (H4445A), Jeuz (H3263), Sachia (H7634), Mirmah (H4821) and Elpaal (H0508) ; § Abitub = "my father is good(ness)"; son of Shaharaim, a Benjamite;
אביטוב.grammar_note: from H1 (אָב) and H2898 (טוּב); father of goodness (i.e. good);

אביטל.definition: A woman living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.3.4; married to David (H1732); ; mother of: Shephatiah (H8203) ; § Abital = "my father is (the) dew"; a wife of David;
אביטל.grammar_note: from H1 (אָב) and H2919 (טַל); father of dew (i.e. fresh);

אבים.definition: A king of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.14.31; ; son of: Rehoboam (H7346) and Maacah (H4601K); ; brother of: Attai (H6262I), Ziza (H2124H) and Shelomith (H8019); ; father of: Asa (H0609); ; half-brother of: Jeush (H3266K), Shemariah (H8114H) and Zaham (H2093); also called Abijam (KJV: Abia) at 1Ki.14.31; 15.1,7,8; ; Another name of a.viy.yah (אֲבִיָּ֫הוּ, אֲבִיָּה "Abijah" H0029I) ; § Abijam = "my father is the sea" or "Yah(u) is (my) father"; king of Judah, son and successor of Rehoboam;
אבים.grammar_note: from H1 (אָב) and H3220 (יָם); father of (the) sea (i.e. seaman);

אבימאל.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.10.28; ; son of: Joktan (H3355); ; brother of: Almodad (H0486), Sheleph (H8026), Hazarmaveth (H2700), Jerah (H3392), Hadoram (H1913A), Uzal (H0187), Diklah (H1853), Obal (H5745), Sheba (H7614H), Ophir (H0211), Havilah (H2341I) and Jobab (H3103) ; § Abimael = "my father is El (God)"; son of Joktan, descendant of Shem;
אבימאל.grammar_note: from H1 (אָב) and an elsewhere unused (probably foreign) word; father of Mael (apparently some Arab tribe);

אבימלך.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.20.2; § Abimelech = "Melek is father" or "my father is king"; 1) king of Gerar in Abraham's time; 2) king of Gath in David's time; maybe title of Philistine kings; 3) son of Gideon by a concubine; 4) priest, son of Abiathar
אבימלך.grammar_note: from H1 (אָב) and H4428 (מֶלֶךְ); father of (the) king;

אבינדב.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.7.1; ; father of: Eleazar (H0499H), Uzzah (H5798A), Ahio (H0283); § Abinadab = "my father is noble" or "my father is willing"; 1) a man of Gibeah who sheltered the ark; 2) second son of Jesse, David's older brother; 3) a son of Saul, slain with him by the Philistines
אבינדב.grammar_note: from H1 (אָב) and H5068 (נָדַב); father of generosity (i.e. liberal);

אבינעם.definition: A man living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jdg.4.6; ; father of: Barak (H1301) ; § Abinoam = "my father is delight"; father of Barak, descendant of Naphtali;
אבינעם.grammar_note: from H1 (אָב) and H5278 (נֹעַם); father of pleasantness (i.e. gracious);

אביעזר.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.23.27; § Abiezer = "my father is help"; 1) a Manassite, called "son" of Gilead, also son of Gilead's sister; 2) a Benjamite, warrior of David
אביעזר.grammar_note: from H1 (אָב) and H5829 (עֵזֶר); father of help (i.e. helpful);

אביעלבון.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.23.31; Also named: a.vi.el (אֲבִיאֵל "Abiel" H0022H) ; § Abialbon = "El (God) is my father"; one of David's mighty men (hero);
אביעלבון.grammar_note: from H1 (אָב) and an unused root of uncertain derivation; probably, father of strength (i.e. valiant);

אביר.definition: 1) mighty, valiant; 1a) of men; 1b) of angels; 1c) of animals; 1d) (metaph); 1d1) of enemies; 1d2) of princes; 1d3) of sacrificial objects; 1e) obstinate (fig.)

אבירם.definition: A man of the tribe of Reuben living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.16.1; ; son of: Eliab (H0446H); ; brother of: Dathan (H1885) and Nemuel (H5241); § Abiram = "my father is exalted" or "(the) Exalted One is (my) father"; 1) a Reubenite, son of Eliab in exodus; 2) son of Hiel the Bethelite who worked to rebuild Jericho
אבירם.grammar_note: from H1 (אָב) and H7311 (רוּם); father of height (i.e. lofty);

אבישג.definition: A woman living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.1.3 ; § Abishag = "my father is a wanderer"; David's beautiful young nurse;
אבישג.grammar_note: from H1 (אָב) and H7686 (שָׁגָה); father of error (i.e. blundering);

אבישוע.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at 1Ch.6.4; ; son of: Phinehas (H6372); ; father of: Bukki (H1231H); § Abishua = "my father is rescue (safety), or is opulence"; son of Phinehas, grandson of Aaron
אבישוע.grammar_note: from H1 (אָב) and H7771 (שׁוֹעַ); father of plenty (i.e. prosperous);

אבישור.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.2.28; ; son of: Shammai (H8060); ; brother of: Nadab (H5070I); married to Abihail (H0032H); ; father of: Ahban (H0257) and Molid (H4140) ; § Abishur = "my father is a wall"; son of Shammai, descendant of Judah;
אבישור.grammar_note: from H1 (אָב) and H7791 (שׁוּר); father of (the) wall (i.e. perhaps mason);

אבישי.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.26.6 and Zeruiah (H6870); ; brother of: Joab (H3097) and Asahel (H6214) ; § Abishai = "my father is Jesse" or "my father is a gift"; grandson of Jesse, nephew of David via his sister Zeruiah, brother of Joab;
אבישי.grammar_note: or (shorter) אַבְשַׁי ; from H1 (אָב) and H7862 (שַׁי); father of a gift (i.e. probably generous);

אבישלום.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.3.3; ; son of: David (H1732) and Maacah (H4601I); ; half-brother of: Amnon (H0550), Chileab (H3609), Adonijah (H0138), Shephatiah (H8203), Ithream (H3507), Shammua (H8051H), Shobab (H7727), Nathan (H5416), Solomon (H8010), Ibhar (H2984), Elishua (H0474), Nepheg (H5298H), Japhia (H3309I), Elishama (H0476H), Eliada (H0450), Eliphelet (H0467), Tamar (H8559H), Elpelet (H0467I), Nogah (H5052) and Jerimoth (H3406N); ; father of: Tamar (H8559I); also called Abishalom at 1Ki.15.2,10; ; § Absalom or Abishalom = "my father is peace"; 1) father-in-law of Rehoboam; 2) third son of David, killer of first-born son Amnon, also leader of revolt against his father-David;
אבישלום.grammar_note: or (shortened) אַבְשָׁלוֹם ; from H1 (אָב) and H7965 (שָׁלוֹם); father of peace (i.e. friendly);

אביתר.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.22.20; ; son of: Ahimelech (H0288); ; father of: Ahimelech (H0288I), Jonathan (H3083I); Also named: Abiathar (Ἀβιαθάρ "Abiathar" G0008) ; § Abiathar = "my father is great"; priest, son of Ahitub (Ahimelech), faithful to David, but later rebelled with Adonijah;
אביתר.grammar_note: contracted from H1 (אָב) and H3498 (יָתַר); father of abundance (i.e. liberal);

אבך.definition: 1) to roll, turn; 1a) (Hithpael) to roll, roll up, billow

אבל.definition: 1) to mourn, lament; 1a) (Qal) to mourn, lament; 1a1) of humans; 1a2) of inanimate objects (fig.); 1a2a) of gates; 1a2b) of land; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to mourn, cause to mourn (fig.); 1c) (Hithpael); 1c1) to mourn; 1c2) play the mourner

אבל ביתמעכה.definition: Abel Beth Maachah = "meadow of the house of Maachah"; city in northern Israel near Beth Maachah
אבל ביתמעכה.grammar_note: from H58 (אָבֵל) and H1004 (בַּיִת) and H4601 (מַעֲכָה); meadow of Beth-Maakah;

אבל השטים.definition: Abel Shittim = "meadow of acacias"; place in lowlands of Moab; Another name of shit.tim (שִׁטִּים "Shittim" H7851G)
אבל השטים.grammar_note: from H58 (אָבֵל) and the plural of H7848 (שִׁטָּה), with the article inserted; meadow of the acacias;

אבל כרמים.definition: Abel Keramim = "meadow of the vineyards"; a place in Ammon;
אבל כרמים.grammar_note: from H58 (אָבֵל) and the plural of H3754 (כֶּרֶם); meadow of vineyards;

אבל מחולה.definition: Abel Meholah = "meadow of dancing"; a city of Issachar, birthplace of Elisha;
אבל מחולה.grammar_note: from H58 (אָבֵל) and H4246 (מְחֹלָה)xlit mᵉchôwlâh corrected to mᵉchôlâh; meadow of dancing;

אבל מים.definition: Abel Maim = "meadow of waters"; a city in northern Israel (perhaps Abel Beth Maachah); Another name of a.vel bet-ma.a.khah (אָבֵל בֵּית־מֲעַכָה "Abel-beth-maachah" H0062)
אבל מים.grammar_note: from H58 (אָבֵל) and H4325 (מַיִם); meadow of water;

אבל מצרים.definition: Abel Mizraim = "meadow of Egypt"; a place east of the Jordan (perhaps "as fertile as Egypt"); Another name of a.tad (אָטָד "Atad" H0329G)
אבל מצרים.grammar_note: from H58 (אָבֵל) and H4714 (מִצְרַיִם); meadow of Egypt;

אבן.definition: : weight; 1) stone (large or small); 1a) common stone (in natural state); 1b) stone, as material; 1b1) of tablets; 1b2) marble, hewn stones; 1c) precious stones, stones of fire; 1d) stones containing metal (ore), tool for work or weapon; 1e) weight; 1f) plummet (stones of destruction) also made of metal; 1g) stonelike objects, eg hailstones, stony heart, ice; 1h) sacred object, as memorial Samuel set up to mark where God helped Israel to defeat the Philistines; 1i) (simile); 1i1) sinking in water, motionlessness; 1i2) strength, firmness, solidity; 1i3) commonness; 1j) (metaph); 1j1) petrified with terror; 1j2) perverse, hard heart
אבן.grammar_note: from the root of H1129 (בָּנָה) through the meaning to build;

אבנה.definition: A river in Syria flowing through Damascus; Also named: a.ma.nah (אֲמָנָה "Amana" H0549H)
אבנה.grammar_note: perhaps feminine of H68 (אֶבֶן); stony;  Compare H549 (אֲמָנָה).

אבן העזר.definition: ; § Ebenezer = "stone of help"; memorial stone erected by Samuel to mark where God helped Israel to defeat the Philistines-north of Jerusalem;
אבן העזר.grammar_note: from H68 (אֶבֶן) and H5828 (עֵזֶר) with the article inserted; stone of the help;

אבנט.definition: 1) girdle, sash, waistband; 1a) of high priest; 1b) of other priests; 1c) of high official

אבנר.grammar_note: or (fully) אֲבִינֵר ; from H1 (אָב) and H5216 (נִיר); father of light (i.e. enlightening);

אבעבעה.grammar_note: (by reduplication) from an unused root (meaning to belch forth);

אבץ.definition: ; § Abez = "I will make white (or miry)"; a city in Issachar;
אבץ.grammar_note: from an unused root probably meaning to gleam; conspicuous;

אבצן.definition: A Judge living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jdg.12.8 ; § Ibzan, "their whiteness (literally their tin - as white"; a Bethlehemite judge in time of the judges;
אבצן.grammar_note: from the same as H76 (אֲבַעְבֻּעָה); splendid;

אבק.grammar_note: a primitive root, probably to float away (as vapor), but used only as denominative from H80 (אָבָק);

אבר.definition: 1) pinion, wing; 1a) of bird (dove, eagle); 1b) of Babylonian king (fig.)

אברה.definition: 1) pinion, wing; 1a) of bird (ostrich, eagle, dove); 1b) of God (metaph)

אברהם.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.11.26; ; son of: Terah (H8646); ; brother of: Nahor (H5152H), Haran (H2039) and Sarah (H8283); married to Sarah (H8283), Hagar (H1904) and Keturah (H6989); ; father of: Ishmael (H3458), Isaac (H3327), Zimran (H2175), Jokshan (H3370), Medan (H4091), Midian (H4080), Ishbak (H3435) and Shuah (H7744); also called Abram at Gen.11.26--17.5; 2x ; § Abraham = "father of a multitude" or "chief of multitude"; friend of God and founder of Hebrew nation via God's elective covenant;
אברהם.grammar_note: contracted from H1 (אָב) and an unused root (probably meaning to be populous); father of a multitude;

אברך.definition: 1) (meaning uncertain) -a shout made to announce Joseph's chariot; 1a) bow!; 1b) knee; Aramaic equivalent: ar.khu.vah (אַרְכֻבָּה "knee" H0755)

אברם.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.11.26; ; son of: Terah (H8646); ; brother of: Nahor (H5152H), Haran (H2039) and Sarah (H8283); married to Sarah (H8283), Hagar (H1904) and Keturah (H6989); ; father of: Ishmael (H3458), Isaac (H3327), Zimran (H2175), Jokshan (H3370), Medan (H4091), Midian (H4080), Ishbak (H3435) and Shuah (H7744); also called Abram at Gen.11.26--17.5; 2x; Another name of av.ra.ham (אַבְרָהָם "Abraham" H0085) ; § Abram = "exalted father"; original name of Abraham;

אבת.definition: ; § Oboth = "waterskins"; undetermined site of an Israelite camp in the wilderness (perhaps at east boundary of Moab);

אגא.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Sa.23.11; ; father of: Shammah (H8037) ; § Agee = "I shall increase"; father of a warrior of David;

אגג.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.24.7; § Agag = "I will overtop"; king of Amalek, spared by Saul but slain by Samuel
אגג.grammar_note: or אֲגָג; of uncertain derivation (compare H89 (אָגֵא)); flame;

אגגי.definition: Someone descended from Agag, a man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.15.8; Group of a.gag (אֲגָג "Agag" H0090H) ; § Agagite = "I will overtop"; said of Haman, Haman the Agagite;

אגדה.definition: 1) band, binding; 1a) cords, bands, thongs (metaphorical of slavery); 1b) bunch of hyssop; 1c) band of men, troops; 1d) vault (of the heavens), firmament (binding earth to the heavens)
אגדה.grammar_note: feminine passive participle of an unused root (meaning to bind);

אגור.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at Pro.30.1; ; son of: Jakeh (H3348) ; § Agur = "gathered"; son of Jakeh, an author or compiler of Pr 30:1-33;
אגור.grammar_note: passive participle of H103 (אָגַר); gathered (i.e. received among the sages);

אגל.grammar_note: from an unused root (meaning to flow down or together as drops);

אגלים.definition: ; § Eglaim = "double reservoir"; a town in Moab;
אגלים.grammar_note: dual of H96 (אֶגֶל).; a double pond;

אגם.definition: 1) pool, troubled pool; 1a) troubled or muddy (gloomy) pools, marshes; 1b) any pool, pond; 1c) swamp reeds, reeds, rush(es)
אגם.grammar_note: from an unused root (meaning to collect as water);

אגמון.definition: bulrush (as growing there); collectively a rope of bulrushes
אגמון.grammar_note: from the same as H98 (אֲגַם); a marshy pool (others from a different root, a kettle); by implication

אגן.definition: 1) bowl, basins; 1a) basins used in ritual; 1b) human body (metaph), curves of the body (simile); 1c) of family of Eliakim (metaph)

אגף.definition: wing (of an army), band, army, hordes
אגף.grammar_note: probably from H5062 (נָגַף) (through the idea of impending); a cover or heap; i.e.

אגרא.definition: letter, missive (Aramaic loan-word used in last OT books); Aramaic of ig.ge.ret (אִגֶּ֫רֶת "letter" H0107)

אגרף.grammar_note: from H1640 (גָּרַף) (in the sense of grasping);

אגרת.definition: letter, missive; Aramaic equivalent: ig.g.ra (אִגְּרָא "letter" H0104)

אד.grammar_note: from the same as H181 (אוּד) (in the sense of enveloping);

אדב.definition: 1) to grieve, cause grief; 1a) (Hiph) to cause to grieve, to grieve, to cause grief

אדבאל.definition: A man of the Arabs living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.25.13; ; son of: Ishmael (H3458); ; brother of: Nebaioth (H5032), Kedar (H6938), Mibsam (H4017), Mishma (H4927), Dumah (H1746), Massa (H4854), Hadad (H2301), Tema (H8485), Jetur (H3195), Naphish (H5305), Kedemah (H6929) and Mahalath (H4258) ; § Adbeel = "chastened of God"; third son of Ishmael and grandson of Abraham;
אדבאל.grammar_note: probably from H109 (אָדַב) (in the sense of chastisement) and H410 (אֵל); disciplined of God;

אדד.definition: A man of the Egyptians living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.11.14; married to sister_of_Tahpenes (H8472I); ; father of: Genubath (H1592); Another spelling of ha.dad (הֲדַד "Hadad" H1908I) ; § Hadad = "I shall move softly: I shall love"; an Edomite enemy God raised up to punish Solomon for his sins;
אדד.grammar_note: probably an orthographical variation for H2301 (חֲדַד);

אדו.definition: A prophet living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.8.17 ; § Iddo = "I will praise him"; a chief Israelite during resettlement;

אדון.definition: 1) firm, strong, lord, master; 1a) lord, master; 1a1) reference to men; 1a1a) superintendent of household, of affairs; 1a1b) master; 1a1c) king; 1a2) reference to God; 1a2a) the Lord God; 1a2b) Lord of the whole earth; 1b) lords, kings; 1b1) reference to men; 1b1a) proprietor of hill of Samaria; 1b1b) master; 1b1c) husband; 1b1d) prophet; 1b1e) governor; 1b1f) prince; 1b1g) king; 1b2) reference to God; 1b2a) Lord of lords (probably = "thy husband, Yahweh"); 1c) my lord, my master; 1c1) reference to men; 1c1a) master; 1c1b) husband; 1c1c) prophet; 1c1d) prince; 1c1e) king; 1c1f) father; 1c1g) Moses; 1c1h) priest; 1c1i) theophanic angel; 1c1j) captain; 1c1k) general recognition of superiority; 1c2) reference to God; 1c2a) my Lord, my Lord and my God; 1c2b) Adonai (parallel with Yahweh)
אדון.grammar_note: or (shortened) אָדֹן; from an unused root (meaning to rule);

אדורים.definition: ; § Adoraim = "double glory"; city in Judah fortified by Rehoboam about 5 miles or 8 km SW of Hebron;
אדורים.grammar_note: dual from H142 (אָדַר) (in the sense of eminence); double mound;

אדין.definition: then, afterwards, thereupon, from that time; Aramaic of az (אָז "then" H0227A)

אדיר.definition: 1) great, majestic; 1a) of waters of sea; 1b) of a tree; 1c) of kings, nations, gods; 2) great one, majestic one; 2a) of nobles, chieftains, servants

אדליא.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Est.9.8; ; son of: Haman (H2001); ; brother of: Parshandatha (H6577), Dalphon (H1813), Aspatha (H0630), Poratha (H6334), Aridatha (H0743), Parmashta (H6534), Arisai (H0747), Aridai (H0742) and Vaizatha (H2055) ; § Adalia = "I shall be drawn up of Jah"; fifth son of Haman, executed at same time;

אדם.definition: The first named man living at the time before the Flood, first mentioned at Gen.2.19; ; married to Eve (H2332); ; father of: Cain (H7014B), Abel (H1893) and Seth (H8352); also translated "man" at Gen.2.19,21,23; 3.8,9,20; 5.2; "mankind" at Deu.32.8; "others" at Job.31.33; ; Another spelling of a.dam (אָדָם "Adam" H0121); man, human being
אדם.grammar_note: to show blood (in the face), i.e.
אדם.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic *ʾadam- 'man, human'. Related to √ʾdm 'to be red'.

אדמה.definition: : country; 1) ground, land; 1a) ground (as general, tilled, yielding sustenance); 1b) piece of ground, a specific plot of land; 1c) earth substance (for building or constructing); 1d) ground as earth's visible surface; 1e) land, territory, country; 1f) whole inhabited earth; 1g) city in Naphtali

אדמי.definition: ; § Adami = "man of Adar"; a pass or fortified place in Naphtali;

אדמים.definition: ; § Adummim = "ruddy one: quieted ones?"; pass or ridge of hills, west of Gilgal;

אדמני.definition: reddish (of the hair or the complexion)

אדמתא.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Est.1.14 ; § Admatha = "a testimony to them"; prince of Persia in reign of Ahasuerus (Xerxes);

אדן.definition: 1) base, pedestal, socket (strong, firm); 1a) pedestals of gold on which marble pillars were set; 1b) pedestals of the earth, foundation of the earth; 1c) pedestals, bases, or sockets on which tabernacle stood
אדן.grammar_note: from the same as H113 (אָדוֹן) (in the sense of strength);

אדני.definition: Lord - a title, spoken in place of Yahweh in Jewish display of reverence ; Another name of ye.ho.vah (יהוה "LORD" H3068G)

אדניבזק.definition: A man living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jdg.1.5 ; § Adoni-Bezek = "my lord is Besek"; king of the Canaanite city of Bezek, killed by Israelites;
אדניבזק.grammar_note: from H113 (אָדוֹן) and H966 (בֶּזֶק); lord of Bezek;

אדניה.definition: Adonijah, the name of three Israelites
אדניה.grammar_note: original (prolonged) אֲדֹנִיָּהוּ ; from H113 (אָדוֹן) and H3050 (יָהּ); lord (i.e. worshipper) of Jah;

אדניצדק.definition: A man living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jos.10.1 ; § Adoni-zedek = "my lord is righteous"; Canaanite king slain by Joshua;
אדניצדק.grammar_note: from H113 (אָדוֹן) and H6664 (צֶדֶק); lord of justice;

אדניקם.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.13 ; § Adonikam = "my lord arose"; the head of an Israelite clan who returned from exile;
אדניקם.grammar_note: from H113 (אָדוֹן) and H6965 (קוּם); lord of rising (i.e. high);

אדנירם.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.20.24; ; son of: Abda (H5653); also called Adoniram at 1Ki.4.6; 5.14; Hadoram at 2Ch.10.18; ; Another name of a.do.ram (אֲדֹרָם "Adoram" H0151) ; § Adoniram = "my lord is exalted"; one of Solomon's officers;
אדנירם.grammar_note: from H113 (אָדוֹן) and H7311 (רוּם); lord of height;

אדר.definition: 1) to be great, be majestic, wide, noble (poetic); 1a) (Niphal) majestic, glorious (participle); 1b) (Hiphil) make glorious

אדרגזר.grammar_note: (Aramaic) from the same as H147 (אִדַּר), and H1505 (גְּזַר);

אדרכן.definition: drachma, dram, daric-unit of weight and value (of gold, money) equal to 128 grains or 4.32 grams

אדרם.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.20.24; ; son of: Abda (H5653); also called Adoniram at 1Ki.4.6; 5.14; Hadoram at 2Ch.10.18; ; § Adoram = "my lord is exalted"; 1) an officer of David; 2) an officer of Rehoboam;

אדרמלך.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Ki.17.31; § Adrammelech = "honour of the king" or "Adar is prince" or "Adar is Counsellor, Decider"; 1) an idol or god of the Sepharvites, introduced to Israel by Shalmaneser the fifth; 2) the son and murderer of Sennacherib
אדרמלך.grammar_note: from H142 (אָדַר) and H4428 (מֶלֶךְ); splendor of (the) king;

אדרע.definition: strong, force, arm, power; Aramaic of ze.ro.a (זְרוֹעַ "arm" H2220)

אדרעי.definition: ; § Edrei = "goodly pasture"; a chief city of Bashan, north of Jabbok river;
אדרעי.grammar_note: from the equivalent of H153 (אֶדְרָע); mighty;

אדרת.definition: 1) glory, cloak; 1a) glory, splendour, magnificence (of a vine, shepherds); 1b) mantle, cloak made of fur or fine material; 1b1) prophet's garment
אדרת.grammar_note: feminine of H117 (אַדִּיר); ; also the same as H145 (אֶדֶר)

אדש.definition: (Qal) to tread, tread on, thresh, trample on; Another spelling of dush (דּוּשׁ "to tread" H1758)

אהב.definition: : lover; 1) to love; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) human love for another, includes family, and sexual; 1a2) human appetite for objects such as food, drink, sleep, wisdom; 1a3) human love for or to God; 1a4) act of being a friend; 1a4a) lover (participle); 1a4b) friend (participle); 1a5) God's love toward man; 1a5a) to individual men; 1a5b) to people Israel; 1a5c) to righteousness; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) lovely (participle); 1b2) loveable (participle); 1c) (Piel); 1c1) friends; 1c2) lovers (fig. of adulterers); 2) to like; Also means: a.hav (אָהֵב ": friend" H0157H)

אהבה.definition: 1) love; 1a) human love for human object; 1a1) of man toward man; 1a2) of man toward himself; 1a3) between man and woman; 1a4) sexual desire; 2) God's love to His people
אהבה.grammar_note: feminine of H158 (אַהַב) and meaning the same

אהד.definition: A man of the tribe of Simeon living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.10; ; son of: Simeon (H8095); ; brother of: Jemuel (H3223), Jamin (H3226), Jachin (H3199), Zerah (H2226L) and Shaul (H7586H) ; § Ohad = "united"; son of Simeon and grandson of Jacob;
אהד.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to be united; unity;

אהה.grammar_note: apparently a primitive word expressing pain exclamatorily;

אהוא.definition: ; § Ahava = "I shall subsist"; town or area in Babylonia;

אהוד.definition: A Judge of the tribe of Benjamin living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jdg.3.15; ; son of: Gera (H1617); ; father of: Naaman (H5283J), Ahijah (H0281K), Gera (H1617J), Uzza (H5798H) and Ahihud (H0284); Also named: e.chud (אֵחוּד "Ehud" H0261); § Ehud = "I will give thanks: I will be praised" or "undivided, union" in (1Ch. 8:6) only; 1) Benjamite judge of Israel, deliverer of Israel from Moab; 2) another Benjamite, son of Bilhan (1Ch 8:6)
אהוד.grammar_note: from the same as H161 (אֹהַד); united;

אהי.grammar_note: apparently an orthographical variation for H346 (אַיֵּה);

אהל.definition: : tent; 1) tent; 1a) nomad's tent, and thus symbolic of wilderness life, transience; 1b) dwelling, home, habitation; 1c) the sacred tent of Jehovah (the tabernacle); Also means: o.hel (אֹ֫הֶל ": home" H0168H)

אהלה.definition: A woman living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezk.23.4; ; sister of: Oholibah (H0172) ; § Aholah = "her own tent"; Samaria as an adulteress with Assyria (metaph);
אהלה.grammar_note: in form a feminine of H168 (אֹהֶל), but in fact for אׇהֳלָהּ; from H168 (אֹהֶל); her tent (i.e. idolatrous sanctuary);

אהליאב.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.31.6; ; son of: Ahisamach (H0294) ; § Aholiab = "Father's tent"; chief assistant of Bezaleel in construction of the tabernacle;
אהליאב.grammar_note: from H168 (אֹהֶל) and H1 (אָב); tent of (his) father;

אהליבה.definition: A woman living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezk.23.4; ; sister of: Oholah (H0170) ; § Aholibah = "woman of the tent" or "the tent is in her"; (metaph) Jerusalem as adulterous wife of Jehovah;
אהליבה.grammar_note: (similarly with H170 (אׇהֳלָה)) for אׇהֳלִיבָהּ ; from H168 (אֹהֶל); my tent (is) in her;

אהליבמה.definition: A woman living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.36.2; her mother was Anah (H6034); married to Esau (H6215); ; mother of: Jeush (H3266), Jalam (H3281) and Korah (H7141); § Aholibamah = "tent of the high place"; 1) wife of Esau; 2) an Edomite chieftain
אהליבמה.grammar_note: from H168 (אֹהֶל) and H1116 (בָּמָה); tent of (the) height;

אהלים.grammar_note: or (feminine) אֲהָלוֹת (only used thus in the plural); of foreign origin;

או.definition: 1) or, rather; 1a) implying that the latter choice is preferred; 1b) or if, introducing an example to be seen under a particular principle; 1c) (in series) either...or, whether...or; 1d) if perchance; 1e) except, or else; 2) whether, not the least, if, otherwise, also, and, then
או.grammar_note: presumed to be the 'constructive' or genitival form of אַו ; short for H185 (אַוָּה);

אואל.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Ezr.10.34 ; § Uel = "wish or will of God"; a Judean who had taken a foreign woman during the exile;
אואל.grammar_note: from H176 (אוֹ) and H410 (אֵל); wish of God;

אוב.definition: 1) water skin bottle; 2) necromancer; 1b) necromancer, one who evokes the dead; 1c) ghost, spirit of a dead one; 1d) practice of necromancy; 3) one that has a familiar spirit
אוב.grammar_note: from the same as H1 (אָב) (apparently through the idea of prattling a father's name);

אוביל.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.27.30 ; § Obil = "camel driver"; manager of David's camels;

אובל.grammar_note: or (shortened) אֻבָל ; from H2986 (יָבַל) (in the sense of H2988 (יָבָל));

אוד.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to rake together;

אודות.grammar_note: or (shortened) אֹדוֹת (only thus in the plural); from the same as H181 (אוּד);

אוה.definition: 1) desire, incline, covet, wait longingly, wish, sigh, want, be greedy, prefer; 1a) (Piel) to desire, crave (food and drink); 1b) (Hithpael) to desire, long for, lust after (of bodily appetites)

אוזי.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.3.25; ; father of: Palal (H6420) ; § Uzai = "I shall have my sprinklings"; a Judean, one of the repairers of Jerusalem's walls;
אוזי.grammar_note: perhaps by permutation for H5813 (עֻזִּי), strong;

אוזל.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.10.27; ; son of: Joktan (H3355); ; brother of: Almodad (H0486), Sheleph (H8026), Hazarmaveth (H2700), Jerah (H3392), Hadoram (H1913A), Diklah (H1853), Obal (H5745), Abimael (H0039), Sheba (H7614H), Ophir (H0211), Havilah (H2341I) and Jobab (H3103); § Uzal = "I shall be flooded"; sixth son Joktan

אוי.definition: 1) woe! alas! oh!; 1a) passionate cry of grief or despair
אוי.grammar_note: probably from H183 (אָוָה) (in the sense of crying out after);

אויל.definition: 1) be foolish, foolish; 1a) (subst); 1a1) of one who despises wisdom; 1a2) of one who mocks when guilty; 1a3) of one who is quarrelsome; 1a4) of one who is licentious
אויל.grammar_note: from an unused root (meaning to be perverse);

אויל מרדך.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.25.27 ; § Evil Merodach = "man of Merodach"; son and successor of Nebuchadnezzar, king of Neo-Babylonian empire, 562-560 BC;
אויל מרדך.grammar_note: of Aramaic derivation and probably meaning soldier of Merodak;

אול.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to twist, i.e. (by implication) be strong;

אולי.definition: 1) perhaps, peradventure; 2) if peradventure; 3) unless; 4) suppose

אולם.definition: 1) but, but indeed (a strong adversative); 2) however, nevertheless
אולם.grammar_note: or (shortened), אֻלָם ; from H481 (אָלַם) (in the sense of tying);

אומר.definition: A man of the Edomites living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.36.11; ; son of: Eliphaz (H0464); ; brother of: Teman (H8487), Zepho (H6825), Gatam (H1609), Kenaz (H7073), Amalek (H6002H) and Korah (H7141H) ; § Omar = "speaker" or "eloquent"; grandson of Esau;

און.definition: 1) trouble, wickedness, sorrow; 1a) trouble, sorrow; 1b) idolatry; 1c) trouble of iniquity, wickedness; Also means: a.ven (אָ֫וֶן ": trouble" H0205H)
און.grammar_note: probably from the same as H205 (אָוֶן) (in the sense of effort, but successful);

אונו.definition: Ono = "vigorous" ; city in Benjamin; 2) a valley (of craftsman); Also named: ke.phi.rim (כְּפִירִים "Hakkephirim" H3715B)
אונו.grammar_note: or (shortened) אֹנוֹ; prolonged from H202 (אוֹן); strong;

אונם.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.36.23; ; son of: Shobal (H7732); ; brother of: Alvan (H5935), Manahath (H4506B), Ebal (H5858B) and Shepho (H8195); § Onam = "vigorous"; 1) a Horite chief, grandson of Seir; 2) son Jerahmeel, a chief of Judah

אונן.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.38.4; ; son of: Judah (H3063) and Bath-shua (H1323I) ; ; brother of: Er (H6147) and Shelah (H7956); ; half-brother of: Perez (H6557) and Zerah (H2226I) ; § Onan = "strong"; second son of Judah, slain by God for not fulfilling the levitical requirement to beget a child with the wife of a dead, childless brother;

אופז.definition: ; § Uphaz = "desire of fine gold"; a place famous for its gold ;

אופיר.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.10.29; ; son of: Joktan (H3355); ; brother of: Almodad (H0486), Sheleph (H8026), Hazarmaveth (H2700), Jerah (H3392), Hadoram (H1913A), Uzal (H0187), Diklah (H1853), Obal (H5745), Abimael (H0039), Sheba (H7614H), Havilah (H2341I) and Jobab (H3103); § Ophir = "reducing to ashes"; 1) eleventh son of Joktan; 2) a land or city in southern Arabia in Solomon's trade route where gold evidently was traded for goods; 3) characteristic of fine gold; 4) fine gold
אופיר.grammar_note: or (shortened) אֹפִיר; and אוֹפִר; of uncertain derivation;

אופן.definition: 1) wheel; 1a) chariot wheel; 1b) wheel in Ezekiel's vision; 1c) wheels of the ten bases beneath the lavers in Solomon's temple
אופן.grammar_note: or (shortened) אֹפָן; from an unused root meaning to revolve;

אוץ.definition: 1) to press, be pressed, make haste, urge, be narrow; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to press, hasten; 1a2) to be pressed, confined, narrow; 1a3) to hasten, make haste; 1a4) be narrow; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to urge, insist; 1b2) to hasten

אוצר.definition: 1) treasure, storehouse; 1a) treasure (gold, silver, etc); 1b) store, supplies of food or drink; 1c) treasure-house, treasury; 1c1) treasure-house; 1c2) storehouse, magazine; 1c3) treasury; 1c4) magazine of weapons (fig. of God's armoury); 1c5) storehouses (of God for rain, snow, hail, wind, sea)

אור.definition: 1) to be or become light, shine; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to become light (day); 1a2) to shine (of the sun); 1a3) to become bright; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be illuminated; 1b2) to become lighted up; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to give light, shine (of sun, moon, and stars); 1c2) to illumine, light up, cause to shine, shine; 1c3) to kindle, light (candle, wood); 1c4) lighten (of the eyes, his law, etc); 1c5) to make shine (of the face)

אורה.definition: manger, stall, crib; Another spelling of ur.vah (אֻרְיָה "stall" H0723)

אורי.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.31.2; ; son of: Hur (H2354); ; brother of: Shobal (H7732H), Salma (H8007H), Hareph (H2780), Jezreel (H3157J), Ishma (H3457), Idbash (H3031), Hazzelelponi (H6753), Penuel (H6439H) and Ezer (H5829); ; father of: Bezalel (H1212); § Uri = "fiery"; 1) a prince of Judah, a son of Hur who was used by God to prepare the tabernacle; 2) an officer (or the father of an officer) of Solomon in Gilead; 3) a porter or gatekeeper in time of Ezra who took a foreign woman as wife

אוריאל.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.6.24; ; son of: Tahath (H8480H); ; father of: Uzziah (H5818H); also called Zephaniah at 1Ch.6.36; ; Also named: tse.phan.yah (צְפַנְיָהוּ "Zephaniah" H6846J); § Uriel = "God (El) is my light"; 1) chief of the Levitical line of Kohath in David's time; 2) maternal grandfather of Abijah
אוריאל.grammar_note: from H217 (אוּר) and H410 (אֵל); flame of God;

אוריה.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.11.3; married to Bathsheba (H1339); Also named: Ourias (Οὐρίας "Uriah" G3774); § Uriah or Urijah = "Jehovah (Yahweh) is my light (flame)"; 1) Hittite husband of Bathsheba; 2) a priest who built king Ahaz' heathen altar; 3) a priest who rebuilt Jerusalem's wall
אוריה.grammar_note: or (prolonged) אוּרִיָּהוּ ; from H217 (אוּר) and H3050 (יָהּ); flame of Jah;

אורים.definition: Urim = "lights"; stones kept in a pouch on the high-priest's breastplate, used in determining God's decision in certain questions and issues; Also named: dēlos (δῆλος "Urim" G1212)

אות.definition: : 2_indicator; 1) sign, signal; 1a) a distinguishing mark; 1b) banner; 1c) remembrance; 1d) miraculous sign; 1e) omen; 1f) warning; 2) token, ensign, standard, miracle, proof

אז.definition: 1) then, at that time; 1a) temporal expressions; 1a1) then (past); 1a2) then, if...then (future); 1a3) earlier; 1b) logical expressions; 1b1) in that case; 1b2) that (being so)

אזבי.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.11.37; ; father of: Naarai (H5293) ; § Ezbai = "my humblings"; father of one of David's mighty men;

אזוב.definition: hyssop, a plant used for medicinal and religious purposes

אזור.definition: 1) waist-cloth, the innermost piece of clothing; 1a) of God's power over kings (fig.); 1b) of faithfulness (metaph); 2) waistband

אזכרה.definition: memorial-offering, the portion of the meal (food) offering which is burned

אזל.definition: 1) to go, to go away, to go about; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to go away; 1a2) to go about; 1a3) to be used up, be exhausted, be gone, evaporated; 1b) (Pual) to go to and fro
אזל.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √ʾzl 'to go, depart'. Common Aramaic verb replacing Hebrew הלך.

אזן.definition: : to[ears_of](PERSON); 1) ear, as part of the body; 2) ear, as organ of hearing; 3) (subjective) to uncover the ear to reveal; the receiver of divine revelation
אזן.grammar_note: a primitive root; probably to expand; but used only as a denominative from H241 (אֹזֶן);

אזן שארה.definition: ; § Uzzen Sherah = "portion of Sherah"; city built by Sherah, Ephraim's daughter;
אזן שארה.grammar_note: from H238 (אָזַן) and H7609 (שֶׁאֱרָה); plot of Sheerah (i.e. settled by him);

אזנות תבור.definition: ; § Aznoth Tabor = "peaks of Tabor"; a pair of hills on Naphtali's border;
אזנות תבור.grammar_note: from H238 (אָזַן) and H8396 (תָּבוֹר); flats (i.e. tops) of Tabor (i.e. situated on it);

אזני.definition: A man of the tribe of Gad living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.16; ; son of: Gad (H1410); ; brother of: Ziphion (H6837), Haggi (H2291), Shuni (H7764), Eri (H6179), Arod (H0720) and Areli (H0692); also called Ozni at Num.26.16; ; Another name of ets.bon (אֶצְבּוֹן "Ezbon" H0675G); § Ozni = "my ear (hearing)"; son of Gad

אזניה.grammar_note: from H238 (אָזַן) and H3050 (יָהּ); heard by Jah;

אזר.definition: 1) gird, encompass, equip, clothe; 1a) (Qal) to gird, gird on (metaphorical of strength); 1b) (Niphal) be girded; 1c)(Piel) hold close, clasp; 1d) (Hiphpael) gird oneself (for war)

אזרח.definition: 1) a native (one rising from the soil); 1a) of man, native Israelites; 1b) of tree, native (to Israel)
אזרח.grammar_note: from H2224 (זָרַח) (in the sense of springing up);

אזרחי.definition: Someone descended from Ezrah(?), first mentioned at 1Ki.4.31 ; § Ezraite = "a native (as arising out of the soil)"; Ezrahite, of the family of Zerach;

אח.definition: : male-relative; 1) brother; 1a) brother of same parents; 1b) half-brother (same father); 1c) relative, kinship, same tribe; 1d) each to the other (reciprocal relationship); 1e) (fig.) of resemblance
אח.grammar_note: Irregular noun with dual origin; pl. אַחִים
אח.forms: pl. אַחִים, cstr. אֲחִי, w/suff. אָחִי

אחאב.definition: A king of the Kingdom of Israel, living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.16.28; ; son of: Omri (H6018); married to Jezebel (H0348); ; father of: Joash (H3101H), Ahaziah (H0274), Joram (H3141H), Athaliah (H6271); § Ahab = "father's brother"; 1) king of Israel, son of Omri, husband of Jezebel; 2) false prophet executed by Nebuchadrezzar, time of Jeremiah
אחאב.grammar_note: once (by contraction) אֶחָב (Jeremiah 29:22); from H251 (אָח) and H1 (אָב); brother (i.e. friend) of (his) father;

אחבן.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.2.29; ; son of: Abishur (H0051) and Abihail (H0032H); ; brother of: Molid (H4140) ; § Ahban = "brother of an understanding (intelligent) one"; son of Abishur of Judah;
אחבן.grammar_note: from H251 (אָח) and H995 (בִּין); brother (i.e. possessor) of understanding;

אחד.definition: 1) one (number); 1a) one (number); 1b) each, every; 1c) a certain; 1d) an (indefinite article); 1e) only, once, once for all; 1f) one...another, the one...the other, one after another, one by one; 1g) first; 1h) eleven (in combination), eleventh (ordinal)

אחוד.definition: A Judge of the tribe of Benjamin living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jdg.3.15; ; son of: Gera (H1617); ; father of: Naaman (H5283J), Ahijah (H0281K), Gera (H1617J), Uzza (H5798H) and Ahihud (H0284); Another spelling of e.hud (אֵהוּד "Ehud" H0164) ; § Ehud = "united"; great grandson of Benjamin;

אחוה.grammar_note: from H2331 (חָוָה) (in the sense of H2324 (חֲוָא));

אחוח.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at 2Sa.23.9; ; son of: Bela (H1106A); ; brother of: Ard (H0714H), Naaman (H5283H), Ezbon (H0675H), Uzzi (H5813I), Uzziel (H5816I), Jerimoth (H3406), Iri (H5901), Addar (H0146H), Gera (H1617I), Abihud (H0031) and Abishua (H0050H); also called Ahoah at 1Ch.8.4; ; Also named: a.cho.chi (אֲחוֹחִי "Ahohite" H0266) ; § Ahoah = "brother of rest"; a grandson of Benjamin;

אחוחי.definition: Someone descended from Ahoah, a man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at 2Sa.23.9; ; son of: Bela (H1106A); ; brother of: Ard (H0714H), Naaman (H5283H), Ezbon (H0675H), Uzzi (H5813I), Uzziel (H5816I), Jerimoth (H3406), Iri (H5901), Addar (H0146H), Gera (H1617I), Abihud (H0031) and Abishua (H0050H); also called Ahoah at 1Ch.8.4; ; Group of a.cho.ach (אֲחוֹחַ "Ahoah" H0265) ; § Ahohite = "brother of rest"; one of the clan of Ahoah;

אחומי.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.2; ; son of: Jahath (H3189); ; brother of: Lahad (H3855) ; § Ahumai = "a water reed: brother of waters"; grandson of Shobal, descendant of Judah;
אחומי.grammar_note: perhaps from H251 (אָח) and H4325 (מַיִם); brother (i.e. neighbour) of water;

אחור.definition: 1) the back side, the rear; 1a) backwards; 1b) hereafter (of time); 1c) behind

אחות.definition: 1) sister; 1a) sister (same parents); 1b) half-sister (same father); 1c) relative; 1c1) (metaph) of Israel's and Judah's relationship; 1d) beloved; 1d1) bride; 1e) (fig.) of intimate connection; 1f) another

אחז.definition: 1) grasp, take hold, seize, take possession; 1a) (Qal) to grasp, take hold of; 1b) (Niphal) to be caught, grasped, be settled; 1c) (Piel) to enclose, overlay; 1d) (Hophal) fastened

אחזה.definition: 1) possession, property; 1a) land; 1b) possession by inheritance

אחזי.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at 1Ch.9.12; ; son of: Meshillemith (H4921); ; father of: Jahzerah (H3170); also called Ahzai (KJV: Ahasai) at Neh.11.13;; Another name of me.shul.lam (מְשֻׁלָּם "Meshullam" H4918M) ; § Ahasai = "my holder, protector"; a post-exilic priest, in Jerusalem;

אחזיה.definition: Achazjah, the name of a Jewish and an Israelite king
אחזיה.grammar_note: or (prolonged) אֲחַזְיָהוּ ; from H270 (אָחַז) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has seized;

אחזם.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.6; ; son of: Ashhur (H0806) and Naarah (H5292B); ; brother of: Hepher (H2660), Temeni (H8488) and Haahashtari (H0326); ; half-brother of: Zereth (H6889), Izhar (H3328), Ethnan (H0869) and Koz (H6976) ; § Ahuzam = "possessor"; a descendant of Judah through Caleb;

אחזת.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, only mentioned at Gen.26.26 ; § Ahuzzath = "possession"; friend of Abimelech;

אחי.definition: A man of the tribe of Gad living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.5.15; ; son of: Abdiel (H5661); § Ahi = "my brother"; 1) a head of the families of Gad; 2) an Asherite

אחיאם.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.23.33; ; son of: Sharar (H8325) ; § Ahiam = "mother's brother"; one of David's warriors (heroes);
אחיאם.grammar_note: from H251 (אָח) and H517 (אֵם); brother of the mother (i.e. uncle);

אחידה.definition: puzzle, riddle; Aramaic of chi.dah (חִידָה "riddle" H2420)

אחיה.definition: Achijah, the name of nine Israelites
אחיה.grammar_note: or (prolonged) אֲחִיָּהוּ ; from H251 (אָח) and H3050 (יָהּ); brother (i.e. worshipper) of Jah;

אחיהוד.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.34.27; ; son of: Shelomi (H8015) ; § Ahihud = "brother of majesty"; a prince of Asher;
אחיהוד.grammar_note: from H251 (אָח) and H1935 (הוֹד); brother (i.e. possessor) of renown;

אחיו.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.6.3; ; son of: Abinadab (H0041); ; brother of: Eleazar (H0499H) and Uzzah (H5798A); § Ahio = "brotherly" or "fraternal"; 1) son of Abinadab who sheltered the ark; 2) a Benjamite; 3) another Benjamite of Saul's ancestry

אחיחד.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living before Israel's Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.8.7; ; son of: Ehud (H0164); ; brother of: Naaman (H5283J), Ahijah (H0281K), Gera (H1617J) and Uzza (H5798H) ; § Ahihud = "brother of mystery"; a Benjamite, son of Ehud;
אחיחד.grammar_note: from H251 (אָח) and H2330 (חוּד); brother of a riddle (i.e. mysterious);

אחיטוב.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.14.3; ; son of: Phinehas (H6372H); ; brother of: Ichabod (H0350); ; father of: Ahimelech (H0288); § Ahitub = "my brother is good (goodness)"; 1) a grandson of Eli; 2) the father of Zadok the priest
אחיטוב.grammar_note: from H251 (אָח) and H2898 (טוּב); brother of goodness;

אחילוד.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.8.16; ; father of: Jehoshaphat (H3092), Baana (H1195) ; § Ahilud = "child's brother"; 1) father of Jehoshaphat, David's recorder; 2) father of Baana, an officer of Solomon;
אחילוד.grammar_note: from H251 (אָח) and H3205 (יָלַד); brother of one born;

אחימות.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.6.25; ; son of: Amasai (H6022); ; father of: Elkanah (H0511J); also called Mahath at 1Ch.6.35; ; Also named: ma.chat (מַ֫חַת "Mahath" H4287I) ; § Ahimoth = "brother of death" or "my brother is death"; a son of Elkanah, a Levite;
אחימות.grammar_note: from H251 (אָח) and H4191 (מוּת); brother of death;

אחימלך.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.14.3; ; son of: Ahitub (H0285); ; father of: Abiathar (H0054); also called Ahijah (KJV: Ahiah) at 1Sa.14.3,18;; Also named: a.chiy.yah (אֲחִיָּ֫הוּ "Ahijah" H0281O); § Ahimelech = "my brother is king" or "brother of Melek"; 1) a priest murdered by Doeg at Saul's command, for supposedly assisting David; 2) a Hittite warrior under David
אחימלך.grammar_note: from H251 (אָח) and H4428 (מֶלֶךְ); brother of (the) king;

אחימן.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.13.22; ; son of: Anak (H6061); ; brother of: Sheshai (H8344) and Talmai (H8526); § Ahiman = "my brother is a gift"; 1) a son of Anak; 2) a Levite servant in the temple
אחימן.grammar_note: or אֲחִימָן ; from H251 (אָח) and H4480 (מִן); brother of a portion (i.e. gift);

אחימעץ.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Sa.14.50; ; father of: Ahinoam (H0293); § Ahimaaz = "my brother is anger (wrath)"; 1) father-in-law of Saul; 2) Zadok's son who aided David during Absalom's rebellion; 3) a supply officer of Solomon
אחימעץ.grammar_note: from H251 (אָח) and the equivalent of H4619 (מַעַץ); brother of anger;

אחין.definition: A man of the tribe of Manasseh living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at 1Ch.7.19; ; son of: Shemida (H8061); ; brother of: Shechem (H7928H), Likhi (H3949) and Aniam (H0593) ; § Ahian = "brotherly" or "fraternal"; son of Shemida of Manasseh;

אחינדב.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.14; ; son of: Iddo (H5714) ; § Ahinadab = "my brother is liberal, or, noble"; a supply officer of Solomon;
אחינדב.grammar_note: from H251 (אָח) and H5068 (נָדַב); brother of liberality;

אחינעם.definition: A woman living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Sa.14.50; ; daughter of: Ahimaaz (H0290); married to Saul (H7586G); ; mother of: Jonathan (H3083H), Abinadab (H0041H), Malchi-shua (H4444), Merab (H4764) and Michal (H4324); § Ahinoam = "my brother is delight"; 1) wife of Saul, daughter of Ahimaaz; 2) wife of David, mother of Amnon, a Jezreelitess
אחינעם.grammar_note: from H251 (אָח) and H5278 (נֹעַם); brother of pleasantness;

אחיסמך.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.31.6; ; father of: Oholiab (H0171) ; § Ahisamach = "my brother is support (has supported)"; a Danite, father of Aholiab, a workman on the tabernacle;
אחיסמך.grammar_note: from H251 (אָח) and H5564 (סָמַךְ); brother of support;

אחיעזר.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.1.12; ; son of: Ammishaddai (H5996); § Ahiezer = "my brother is help"; 1) a Danite chief who assisted Moses; 2) a Danite chief, one of David's heroes
אחיעזר.grammar_note: from H251 (אָח) and H5828 (עֵזֶר); brother of help;

אחיקם.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.22.12; ; son of: Shaphan (H8227B); ; brother of: Elasah (H0501J) and Gemariah (H1587H); ; father of: Gedaliah (H1436B) ; § Ahikam = "my brother has risen (arisen)"; 1) son of Shaphan, an officer in Josiah's reign; 2) protector of Jeremiah; 3) father of Gedaliah;
אחיקם.grammar_note: from H251 (אָח) and H6965 (קוּם); brother of rising (i.e. high);

אחירם.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.26.38; ; son of: Benjamin (H1144); ; brother of: Bela (H1106A), Becher (H1071), Ashbel (H0788), Gera (H1617), Naaman (H5283), Ehi (H0278), Rosh (H7220), Muppim (H4649), Huppim (H2650H), Ard (H0714) and Jediael (H3043); Also named: a.chi.ra.mi (אֲחִירָמִי "Ahiramite" H0298) ; § Ahiram = "my brother is exalted" or "brother or (the) lofty"; a Benjamite, son of Benjamin;
אחירם.grammar_note: from H251 (אָח) and H7311 (רוּם); brother of height (i.e. high);

אחירמי.definition: Someone descended from Ahiram, a man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.26.38; ; son of: Benjamin (H1144); ; brother of: Bela (H1106A), Becher (H1071), Ashbel (H0788), Gera (H1617), Naaman (H5283), Ehi (H0278), Rosh (H7220), Muppim (H4649), Huppim (H2650H), Ard (H0714) and Jediael (H3043); Group of a.chi.ram (אֲחִירָם "Ahiram" H0297) ; § Ahiramite = "brother of mother"; one of the clan of Ahiram;

אחירע.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.1.15; ; son of: Enan (H5881) ; § Ahira = "my brother is evil"; a chief of Naphtali;
אחירע.grammar_note: from H251 (אָח) and H7451 (רַע); brother of wrong;

אחישחר.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.7.10; ; son of: Bilhan (H1092H); ; brother of: Jeush (H3266H), Benjamin (H1144H), Ehud (H0164H), Chenaanah (H3668H), Zethan (H2133) and Tarshish (H8659I) ; § Ahishahar = "my brother is dawn" or "brother of the dawn"; a Benjamite;
אחישחר.grammar_note: from H251 (אָח) and H7837 (שַׁחַר); brother of (the) dawn;

אחישר.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.6 ; § Ahishar = "my brother sang"; chief steward for Solomon;
אחישר.grammar_note: from H251 (אָח) and H7891 (שִׁיר); brother of (the) singer;

אחיתפל.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.15.12; ; father of: Eliam (H0463H) ; § Ahithophel = "my brother is foolish (folly)"; a counsellor of David, grandfather of Bathsheba (cf 2Sa 11:3, 23:34), who joined Absalom in revolt against David, and committed suicide when Absalom did not heed his counsel;
אחיתפל.grammar_note: from H251 (אָח) and H8602 (תָּפֵל); brother of folly;

אחלב.definition: Ahlab = "fertile place"; a town allotted to Asher, site presently unknown; Also named: che.vel (חֶ֫בֶל "Mahalab" H2256A)
אחלב.grammar_note: from the same root as H2459 (חֶלֶב); fatness (i.e. fertile);

אחלי.definition: Oh that...!; oh would that!; ah that!

אחלמה.definition: amethyst, a gem in the third row on the ephod, breastplate of judgment worn by the high priest. Transliteration of the Septuagint word. Identification is not certain but is a purple stone perhaps a corundum or red or brown jasper.

אחמתא.definition: ; § Achmetha = "Ecbatana"; capital of Media, captured by Cyrus in 550 BC and then summer residence of Persian kings;

אחסבי.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Sa.23.34; ; father of: Eliphelet (H0467H) ; § Ahasbai = "brother of my encompassers"; father of Eliphelet, one of David's heroes;

אחר.definition: 1) after the following part, behind (of place), hinder, afterwards (of time); 1a) as an adverb; 1a1) behind (of place); 1a2) afterwards (of time); 1b) as a preposition; 1b1) behind, after (of place); 1b2) after (of time); 1b3) besides; 1c) as a conjunction; 1c) after that; 1d) as a substantive; 1d1) hinder part; 1e) with other prepositions; 1e1) from behind; 1e2) from following after

אחרון.definition: 1) behind, following, subsequent, western; 1a) behind, hindermost, western (of location); 1b) later, subsequent, latter, last (of time)

אחרח.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.21; ; son of: Benjamin (H1144); ; brother of: Bela (H1106A), Becher (H1071), Ashbel (H0788), Gera (H1617), Naaman (H5283), Rosh (H7220), Muppim (H4649), Huppim (H2650H), Ard (H0714), Ahiram (H0297) and Jediael (H3043); also called Aharah at 1Ch.8.1; ; Another name of e.chi (אֵחִי "Ehi" H0278) ; § Aharah = "a following brother"; a son of Benjamin;
אחרח.grammar_note: from H310 (אַחַר) and H251 (אָח); after (his) brother;

אחרחל.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.8; ; son of: Harum (H2037) ; § Aharhel = "a following host"; a descendant of Judah through Caleb;
אחרחל.grammar_note: from H310 (אַחַר) and H2426 (חֵיל); behind (the) intrenchment (i.e. safe);

אחרי.definition: other, another; Aramaic of a.cher (אַחֵר "another" H0312)

אחרין.definition: 1) end, outcome; 1a) hid part (of cows); 1b) end (of time); 1c) remnant, descendants

אחרית.definition: 1) after part, end; 1a) end, issue, event; 1b) latter time (prophetic for future time); 1c) posterity; 1d) last, hindermost; Aramaic equivalent: a.cha.rit (אַחֲרִית "latter" H0320)

אחרן.definition: other, another; Aramaic of a.cher (אַחֵר "another" H0312)
אחרן.grammar_note: (Aramaic) from H311 (אַחַר); the same as H317 (אׇחֳרִי);

אחשדרפן.definition: satrap, a governor of a Persian province; Aramaic equivalent: a.chash.dar.pan (אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנִין "satrap" H0324)

אחשורוש.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.4.6; married to Vashti (H2060); ; father of: Darius (H1868H) ; § Ahasuerus = "I will be silent and poor"; title of the king of Persia, probably Xerxes;

אחשתרי.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.6; ; son of: Ashhur (H0806) and Naarah (H5292B); ; brother of: Ahuzzam (H0275), Hepher (H2660) and Temeni (H8488); ; half-brother of: Zereth (H6889), Izhar (H3328), Ethnan (H0869) and Koz (H6976) ; § Haahashtari = "I will diligently observe the searching"; a descendant of Ashur of Judah;

אט.grammar_note: from an unused root perhaps meaning to move softly;

אטד.definition: Atad, a threshing floor ; afterwards called Bethhogla was located on the west of Jordan between the Jordan and Jericho ; Also named: a.vel mits.ra.yim (אָבֵל מִצְרַיִם "Abel-mizraim" H0067);
אטד.grammar_note: from an unused root probably meaning to pierce or make fast;

אטון.grammar_note: from an unused root (probably meaning to bind);

אטם.definition: 1) to shut, shut up, close; 1a) (Qal) to shut, stop (of lips); 1b) (Hiphil) of the wicked stopping their ears (fig.)

אטר.definition: 1) (Qal) shut; 1a) to shut up, close, bind; 1b) close one's mouth

אי.definition: 1) whereto ?, whence?; 2) which?, how? (in prefix with other adverb)

איב.definition: 1) to be hostile to, to be an enemy to; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be hostile to; 1a2) to treat as an enemy

איד.definition: 1) distress, burden, calamity; 1a) burden (of the righteous); 1b) calamity (of nation); 1c) disaster (of wicked); 1d) day of calamity
איד.grammar_note: from the same as H181 (אוּד) (in the sense of bending down);

איך.grammar_note: also אֵיכָה ; and אֵיכָכָה ; prolonged from H335 (אַי);

איכבוד.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.4.21; ; son of: Phinehas (H6372H); ; brother of: Ahitub (H0285) ; § Ichabod = "no glory"; a son of Phinehas, so named because of the capture of the Ark by the Philistines;

איכה.definition: interrog adv; 1) how?; interj; 2) how! (in lamentation); 3) expression of satisfaction
איכה.grammar_note: probably a variation for H349 (אֵיךְ), but not as an interogative;

איל.definition: 1) ram; 1a) ram (as food); 1b) ram (as sacrifice); 1c) ram (skin dyed red, for tabernacle)

אילון.definition: ; § Ajalon or Aijalon = "field of deer"; Levitical city in Dan, 14 miles or 25 km NW of Jerusalem, later ruled by the Amorites, then the Benjamites of Judah, then by the Philistines;
אילון.grammar_note: or (shortened) אֵלוֹן ; or אֵילֹן ; from H352 (אַיִל); oak-grove;

אילון בית חנן.definition: ; § Elon Beth-hanan = "oak of the house of grace"; a city of Dan;
אילון בית חנן.grammar_note: from H356 (אֵילוֹן), H1004 (בַּיִת), and H2603 (חָנַן); oak-grove of (the) house of favor;

אילות.grammar_note: or אֵילַת ; from H352 (אַיִל); trees or a grove (i.e. palms);

אילם.grammar_note: or (shortened) אֵלָם ; or (feminine) אֵלַמָּה ; probably from H352 (אַיִל);

איל פארן.definition: ; § El-paran = "palm of Paran"; town and harbour at tip of Gulf of Aqaba on the Red Sea;
איל פארן.grammar_note: from H352 (אַיִל) and H6290 (פָּארָן); oak of Paran;

אים.grammar_note: from an unused root (meaning to frighten);

אימה.grammar_note: or (shortened) אֵמָה; from the same as H366 (אָיֹם);

אימים.definition: People descended from Em(?), first mentioned at Gen.14.5 ; § Emims = "terrors"; ancient inhabitants of Moab;

אין.definition: 1) nothing, not, nought n; 1a) nothing, nought neg; 1b) not; 1c) to have not (of possession) adv; 1d) without w/prep; 1e) for lack of
אין.grammar_note: as if from a primitive root meaning to be nothing or not exist;

איעזר.definition: A man of the tribe of Manasseh living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.26.30; ; son of: Gilead (H1568H); ; brother of: Helek (H2507), Asriel (H0844), Shechem (H7928), Shemida (H8061) and Hepher (H2660A); also called Iezer (KJV: Jeezer) at Num.26.30; ; Another name of a.vi.e.zer (אֲבִיעֶ֫זֶר "Abiezer" H0044I) ; § Jeezer = "no help"; a descendant of Manasseh;
איעזר.grammar_note: from H336 (אִי)lemma אי missing vowel, corrected to אִי and H5828 (עֵזֶר); helpless;

איעזרי.definition: Someone descended from Iezer, a man of the tribe of Manasseh living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.26.30; ; son of: Gilead (H1568H); ; brother of: Helek (H2507), Asriel (H0844), Shechem (H7928), Shemida (H8061) and Hepher (H2660A); also called Iezer (KJV: Jeezer) at Num.26.30; ; Group of a.vi.e.zer (אֲבִיעֶ֫זֶר "Abiezer" H0044I) ; § Jeezerite = "no help"; one of the tribe of Jeezer;

איפה.definition: 1) ephah; 1a) a dry measure of quantity, equal to 3 seahs, 10 omers; the same as the liquid measure bath; (about 9 imperial gallons (40 l), rabbinical writings give sizes of one-half this amount); 1b) the receptacle for measuring or holding that amount

איש.definition: : anyone/someone; 1) man; 1a) man, male (in contrast to woman, female); 1b) husband; 1c) human being, person (in contrast to God); 1d) servant; 1e) mankind; 1f) champion; 1g) great man; 2) whosoever; 3) each (adjective)
איש.grammar_note: contracted for H582 (אֱנוֹשׁ) (or perhaps rather from an unused root meaning to be extant);

אישבשת.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.2.8; ; son of: Saul (H7586G); ; brother of: Jonathan (H3083H), Abinadab (H0041H), Malchi-shua (H4444), Merab (H4764), Michal (H4324), Armoni (H0764), Mephibosheth (H4648H); Also named: esh.ba.al (אֶשְׁבַּעַל "Eshbaal" H0792) ; § Ishbosheth = "man of shame"; surviving son of Saul, king of Israel for 7 years while David was king over Judah; succeeded by David who united the kingdom;
אישבשת.grammar_note: from H376 (אִישׁ) and H1322 (בֹּשֶׁת); man of shame;

אישהוד.definition: A man of the tribe of Manasseh living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.7.18; his mother was Hammolecheth (H4447); ; brother of: Abiezer (H0044H) and Mahlah (H4244H) ; § Ishod = "man of majesty"; a Manassite from east of the Jordan;
אישהוד.grammar_note: from H376 (אִישׁ) and H1935 (הוֹד); man of renown;

אישון.definition: 1) pupil of the eye; 2) middle of the night (that is the deepest blackness)

אישחיל.grammar_note: from H376 (אִישׁ) and H2428 (חַיִל); man of might; by defective transcription (2 Samuel 23:20) אִישׁ־חַיxlit ʼÎsh-Chay corrected to ʼÎysh-Chay; as if from H376 (אִישׁ) and H2416 (חַי); living man;

אישטוב.definition: Ishtob = "man of Tob"; a region beyond Jordan, north or northeast of Gilead
אישטוב.grammar_note: from H376 (אִישׁ) and H2897 (טוֹב); man of Tob;

איתי.definition: 1) there is, there are; 2) particle denoting existence

איתיאל.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.11.7; ; son of: Jeshaiah (H3470K); ; father of: Maaseiah (H4641U); § Ithiel = "God is with me"; 1) the disciple to whom Agur gave proverbs; 2) a Benjamite in Nehemiah's time
איתיאל.grammar_note: perhaps from H837 (אֹשֶׁר) and H410 (אֵל); God has arrived;

איתמר.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.6.23; ; son of: Aaron (H0175) and Elisheba (H0472); ; brother of: Nadab (H5070), Abihu (H0030) and Eleazar (H0499) ; § Ithamar = "coast of palms"; fourth and youngest son of Aaron;
איתמר.grammar_note: from H339 (אִי) and H8558 (תָּמָר); coast of the palm-tree;

איתן.definition: 1) perpetual, constant, perennial, ever-flowing; 1a) ever-flowing (of a stream); 1b) permanence, permanent, enduring (fig.)
איתן.grammar_note: or (shortened) אֵתָן ; from an unused root (meaning to continue);

איתנים.definition: ; § Ethanim = "enduring"; seventh Jewish month, corresponding to modern Oct. to Nov.; so named because permanent streams still flowed;
איתנים.grammar_note: plural of H386 (אֵיתָן); always with the article; the permanent brooks;

אך.definition: 1) indeed, surely (emphatic); 2) howbeit, only, but, yet (restrictive)

אכד.definition: ; § Accad = "subtle"; a city in north Babylonia, also the district around it;
אכד.grammar_note: from an unused root probably meaning to strengthen; a fortress;

אכזב.definition: deceitful, treacherous, deception, lie, deceptive, disappointing

אכזיב.definition: ; § Achzib = "deceit"; a town in the lowland of west Judah
אכזיב.grammar_note: from H391 (אַכְזָב); deceitful (in the sense of a winter-torrent which fails in summer);

אכזר.grammar_note: from an unused root (apparently meaning to act harshly);

אכילה.definition: food, a meal, an eating, meat

אכיש.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.21.10; ; son of: Maoch (H4582); also called Abimelech (NIV: Abimelek) at Psa.34.1; ; Also named: a.vi.me.lekh (אֲבִימֶ֫לֶךְ "Abimelech" H0040I) ; § Achish = "I will blacken (or terrify)" or "only a man"; Philistine king of Gath;

אכלה.definition: 1) food; 1a) food, eating; 1b) object of devouring, consuming; 1b1) by wild beasts (figurative); 1b2) in fire; 1b3) of judgment (figurative)

אכן.definition: 1) surely, truly, indeed; 1a) truly, indeed (strong assertive force); 1b) but indeed, but in fact (emphasizing a contrast)

אכף.grammar_note: a primitive root; apparently meaning to curve (as with a burden);

אכר.definition: 1) plowman, husbandman, farmer; 1a) working the land, yet not owning any of it
אכר.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to dig;

אכשף.definition: ; § Achshaph = "I shall be bewitched"; city in north Canaan at foot of Mt Carmel;

אל.definition: 1) to, toward, unto (of motion); 2) into (limit is actually entered); 2a) in among; 3) toward (of direction, not necessarily physical motion); 4) against (motion or direction of a hostile character); 5) in addition to, to; 6) concerning, in regard to, in reference to, on account of; 7) according to (rule or standard); 8) at, by, against (of one's presence); 9) in between, in within, to within, unto (idea of motion to)

אלדד.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.11.26 ; § Eldad = "God has loved"; one of the two elders who prophesied in the Israelite camp;
אלדד.grammar_note: from H410 (אֵל) and H1730 (דּוֹד); God has loved;

אלו.definition: behold!, lo!; Aramaic of al.lay (אַלְלַי "woe!" H0480)

אלוה.grammar_note: rarely (shortened) אֱלֹהַּ; probably prolonged (emphatic) from H410 (אֵל);

אלול.definition: ; § Elul = "nothingness"; sixth Jewish month corresponding to modern Aug. or Sep.;

אלון.definition: This name means tree, great tree, terebinth; Combined with a.nan (עָנַן "Diviners'" H6049)

אלון בכות.definition: ; § Allon Bachuth = "oak of weeping"; site of Deborah's (Rebekah's nurse) grave near Bethel;
אלון בכות.grammar_note: from H437 (אַלּוֹן) and a variation of H1068 (בְּכִית); oak of weeping;

אלוני.grammar_note: or rather (shortened) אֵלֹנִי; patron from H438 (אַלּוֹן);

אלוש.definition: ; § Alush = "I will knead (bread)"; a wilderness encampment following the Exodus;

אלזבד.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.12.12; § Elzabad = "God has given"; 1) a Gadite warrior who aided David; 2) a Korhite Levite
אלזבד.grammar_note: from H410 (אֵל) and H2064 (זָבַד); God has bestowed;

אלחנן.grammar_note: from H410 (אֵל) and H2603 (חָנַן); God (is) gracious;

אלידד.grammar_note: from the same as H419 (אֶלְדָּד); God of (his) love;

אליה.grammar_note: from H422 (אָלָה) (in the original sense of strength);

אליהו.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.1.1; ; son of: Tohu (H8459); ; father of: Jeroham (H3395); also called Eliab at 1Ch.6.27; Eliel at 1Ch.6.34; ; § Elihu = "He is my God"; 1) the younger man who rebuked Job and his three friends; 2) an Ephraimite, Samuel's great grandfather; 3) a Manassite warrior chief for David; 4) son of Shemaiah and Korhite gatekeeper; 5) David's brother
