בית מעכה.definition: Beth-maachah = "house of pressure"; a place in the northern kingdom; Combined with a.vel (אָבֵל "Abel" H0059H)
בית מעכה.grammar_note: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H4601 (מַעֲכָה); house of Maakah;

בית נמרה.definition: Beth-Nimrah = "house of the leopard"; a place east of the Jordan in Gad; Also named: nim.rah (נִמְרָה "Nimrah" H5247)
בית נמרה.grammar_note: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and the feminine of H5246 (נָמֵר); house of (the) leopard;

בית עדן.definition: ; § Beth-eden = "house of delight"; a city in Syria, modern Juseih (cuneiform = Bit Adini);
בית עדן.grammar_note: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H5730 (עֵדֶן); house of pleasure;

בית עזמות.definition: house of Azmaveth, a place in Palestine

בית ענות.grammar_note: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and a plural from H6030 (עָנָה); house of replies;

בית ענת.grammar_note: an orthographical variation for H1042 (בֵּית עֲנוֹת);

בית עקד.grammar_note: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and a derivative of H6123 (עָקַד); house of (the) binding (for sheep-shearing);

בית עשתרות.definition: Beth-ashtaroth = "house of Ashtaroth"; a Philistine temple
בית עשתרות.grammar_note: ; from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H6252 (עַשְׁתָּרוֹת); house of Ashtoreths;

בית פלט.definition: ; § Beth-palet = "house of escape" or "place of escape"; a place in southern Judah;
בית פלט.grammar_note: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H6412 (פָּלִיט); house of escape;

בית פעור.definition: ; § Beth-peor = "house of Peor"; a place east of the Jordan, in the land of the Amorites, allotted to the tribe of Reuben;
בית פעור.grammar_note: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H6465 (פְּעוֹר); house of Peor;

בית פצץ.definition: ; § Beth-pazzez = "house of dispersion"; a place in Issachar;
בית פצץ.grammar_note: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and a derivative from H6327 (פּוּץ); house of dispersion;

בית צור.grammar_note: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H6697 (צוּר); house of (the) rock;

בית רחוב.grammar_note: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H7339 (רְחֹב); house of (the) street;

בית רפא.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.12; ; son of: Eshton (H0850); ; brother of: Paseah (H6454) and Tehinnah (H8468) ; § Beth-rapha = "house of healing"; the son of Eshton;
בית רפא.grammar_note: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H7497 (רָפָא); house of (the) giant;

בית שאן.definition: ; § Beth-shean or Beth-Shan = "house of ease"; a place in Manasseh, west of the Jordan;
בית שאן.grammar_note: or בֵּית שָׁן; from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H7599 (שָׁאַן); house of ease;

בית שמש.definition: ; § Beth-shemesh = "house of the sun" or "sun-temple"; a town in southwest Judah;
בית שמש.grammar_note: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H8121 (שֶׁמֶשׁ); house of (the) sun;

בית תפוח.grammar_note: from H1004 (בַּיִת) and H8598 (תַּפּוּחַ); house of (the) apple;

בכא.definition: 1) balsam tree-a shrub which drips sap when it is cut; 2) possible name of a vale of balsam trees in Ps 84:6

בכה.definition: 1) to weep, bewail, cry, shed tears; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to weep (in grief, humiliation, or joy); 1a2) to weep bitterly (with cognate acc.); 1a3) to weep upon (embrace and weep); 1a4) to bewail; 1b) (Piel) participle; 1b1) lamenting; 1b2) bewailing

בכור.definition: 1) firstborn, firstling; 1a) of men and women; 1b) of animals; 1c) noun of relation (fig.)

בכורה.definition: 1) first ripe fig, early fig; 2) (TWOT) firstfruits

בכורת.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Sa.9.1; ; son of: Aphiah (H0647); ; father of: Zeror (H6872C) ; § Bechorath = "first-born"; a Benjamite ancestor of Saul;

בכים.definition: Bochim = "weeping"; a place near Gilgal (or Bethel), where sons of Israel wept; Another name of bet-el (בֵּֽיתְ־אֵל "Bethel" H1008G)
בכים.grammar_note: plural active participle of H1058 (בָּכָה); (with the article) the weepers;

בכירה.definition: 1) firstborn daughter, firstborn (of women); 1a) always used of women

בכר.definition: 1) to be born first; 1a) (Piel); 1a1) to bear early, new fruit; 1a2) to give the right of the firstborn; 1a2a) to make as firstborn; 1a2b) to constitute as firstborn; 1b) (Pual); 1b1) to be born a firstling; 1b2) to be made a firstling; 1c) (Hiphil) one bearing her first child
בכר.grammar_note: a primitive root; properly, to burst the womb, i.e. (causatively) bear or make early fruit (of woman or tree); also (as denominative from H1061 (בִּכּוּר))

בכרה.definition: birthright, primogeniture, right of the first-born

בכרו.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.8.38; ; son of: Azel (H0682A); ; brother of: Azrikam (H5840H), Ishmael (H3458I), Sheariah (H8187), Obadiah (H5662J) and Hanan (H2605H) ; § Bocheru = "firstborn"; a Benjamite;

בכרי.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.20.1; ; father of: Sheba (H7652A); Also named: be.ri (בֵּרִים "Bichrite" H1276) ; § Bichri = "youthful"; 1) a Benjamite, father of Sheba; adj; 2) (BDB) the Bichrites;

בל.definition: mind, heart; Aramaic of lev (לֵב "heart" H3820A)

בלא.definition: 1) (Pael) to wear away, wear out; 1a) to harass constantly (fig.)
בלא.grammar_note: (Aramaic) corresponding to H1086 (בָּלָה) (but used only in a mental sense);

בלאדן.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.20.12; ; son of: Baladan (H1081); ; father of: Merodach-baladan (H1255) ; § Baladan = "Bel (is his) lord)"; the father of Merodach-baladan to whom Hezekiah revealed the riches of his treasures;
בלאדן.grammar_note: from H1078 (בֵּל) and H113 (אָדוֹן) (contracted); Bel (is his) lord;

בלג.definition: 1) to gleam, smile; 1a) (Hiphil) only; 1a1) to show a smile, look pleasant; 1a2) to cause to burst

בלגה.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.24.14; § Bilgah = "cheerfulness"; 1) a priest of the 15th course, in David's time; 2) a priest accompanying Zerubbabel

בלגי.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Neh.10.8; also called Bilgai at Neh.10.8; ; Another name of bil.gah (בִּלְגָּה "Bilgah" H1083H) ; § Bilgai = "my cheerfulness"; a priest who covenanted with Nehemiah;

בלדד.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Job.2.11 ; § Bildad = "confusing (by mingling) love"; the second friend of Job;

בלה.definition: 1) to wear out, become old; 1a) (Qal) to wear out; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to wear out; 1b2) to wear out by use, use up completely; 1b3) to enjoy, use to the full; Aramaic equivalent: be.la (בְּלָא "to wear out" H1080)

בלהן.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.36.27; ; son of: Ezer (H0687); ; brother of: Zaavan (H2190) and Akan (H3292); § Bilhan = "their decrepitude"; 1) a descendant of Esau; 2) a Benjamite

בלו.grammar_note: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H1086 (בָּלָה);

בלטשאצר.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezk.14.14; also called Belteshazzar at Dan.1.7; 2.26; 4.8,9,18,19; 5.12; 10.1; ; Another name of da.niy.yel (דָּנִיֵּאל, דָּנִאֵל "Daniel" H1840G) ; § Belteshazzar = "lord of the straitened's treasure"; 1) the 4th of the greater prophets, taken as hostage in the first deportation to Babylon; because of the gift of God of the interpretation of dreams, he became the 2nd in command of the Babylon empire and lasted through the end of the Babylonian empire and into the Persian empire. His prophecies are the key to the understanding of end time events. Noted for his purity and holiness by contemporary prophet, Ezekiel; 1a) also, 'Daniel' (H1840 or H1841);

בלי.definition: subst; 1) wearing out; adv of negation; 2) without, no, not

בליעל.definition: : worthless; 1) worthlessness; 1a) worthless, good for nothing, unprofitable, base fellow; 1b) wicked; 1c) ruin, destruction (construct); Also means: be.liy.ya.al (בְּלִיַּ֫עַל ": destruction" H1100H)
בליעל.grammar_note: from H1097 (בְּלִי) and H3276 (יַעַל);(often in connection with H376 (אִישׁ), H802 (אִשָּׁה), H1121 (בֵּן), etc.)

בלל.definition: 1) to mix, mingle, confuse, confound; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to mingle, confuse; 1a2) to mix; 1b) (Hithpoel) to mix oneself (among others); 1c) (Hiphil) to fade away
בלל.grammar_note: a primitive root; (also  denominatively from H1098 (בְּלִיל)) to fodder

בלס.definition: (Qal) to gather figs, tend sycamore trees

בלע.definition: 1) to swallow down, swallow up, engulf, eat up; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to swallow down; 1a2) to swallow up, engulf; 1b) (Niphal) to be swallowed up; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to swallow; 1c2) to swallow up, engulf; 1c3) squandering (fig.); 1d) (Pual) to be swallowed up; 1e) (Hithpael) to be ended

בלעדי.grammar_note: or בַּלְעֲדֵי; constructive plural from H1077 (בַּל) and H5703 (עַד), not till, i.e. (as preposition or adverb)

בלעי.definition: Someone descended from Bela who was a man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.21; ; son of: Benjamin (H1144); ; brother of: Becher (H1071), Ashbel (H0788), Gera (H1617), Naaman (H5283), Ehi (H0278), Rosh (H7220), Muppim (H4649), Huppim (H2650H), Ard (H0714), Ahiram (H0297) and Jediael (H3043); ; father of: Ard (H0714H), Naaman (H5283H), Ezbon (H0675H), Uzzi (H5813I), Uzziel (H5816I), Jerimoth (H3406), Iri (H5901), Addar (H0146H), Gera (H1617I), Abihud (H0031), Abishua (H0050H) and Ahoah (H0265); Group of be.la (בֶּ֫לַע "Bela" H1106A) ; § Belaites = "swallowing"; descendants of Bela;

בלעם.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.22.5; ; son of: Beor (H1160H); Also named: Balaam (Βαλαάμ "Balaam" G0903); § Balaam = "not of the people"; the son of Beor, a man endowed with the gift of prophecy
בלעם.grammar_note: probably from H1077 (בַּל) and H5971 (עַם); not (of the) people, i.e. foreigner;

בלק.definition: 1) to waste, lay waste, devastate; 1a) (Poel) to make waste; 1b) (Pual) devastated (participle)

בלשאצר.grammar_note: or בֵּלְאשַׁצַּרlemma בֵּלְאשַׁצּר missing vowel, corrected to בֵּלְאשַׁצַּר; of foreign origin (compare H1095 (בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּר));

בלשן.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.2 ; § Bilshan = "in slander"; an exile who returned with Zerubbabel;

בלתי.definition: subst; 1) not, except; adv; 2) not; 3) except (after preceding negation); conj; 4) except (after an implied or expressed negation); with prep; 5) so as not, in order not; 6) an account of not, because...not; 7) until not
בלתי.grammar_note: constructive feminine of H1086 (בָּלָה) (equivalent to H1097 (בְּלִי));

במה.definition: 1) high place, ridge, height, bamah (technical name for cultic platform); 1a) high place, mountain; 1b) high places, battlefields; 1c) high places (as places of worship); 1d) funeral mound?
במה.grammar_note: from an unused root (meaning to be high);

במהל.definition: A man of the tribe of Asher living before Israel's Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.7.33; ; son of: Japhlet (H3310); ; brother of: Pasach (H6457) and Ashvath (H6220) ; § Bimhal = "in circumcision: in weakness (by mixture)"; a descendant of Asher;
במהל.grammar_note: probably from H4107 (מָהַל) with prepositional prefix; with pruning;

במות.definition: ; § Bamoth = "high places" or "great high place"; a town on the river Arnon in Moab
במות.grammar_note: plural of H1116 (בָּמָה); heights; or (fully) בָּמוֹת בַּעַל; from the same and H1168 (בַּעַל); heights of Baal;

בן.definition: : descendant, people, tribe, nation; A sub-meaning of ben (בֵּן ": child" H1121) ; § : child/son;

בןאבינדב.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.11; ; son of: Abinadab (H0041J); married to Taphath (H2955) ; § Ben-Abinadab = "son of Abinadab"; an officer of Solomon;
בןאבינדב.grammar_note: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H40 (אֲבִימֶלֶךְ); (the) son of Abinadab;

בןאוני.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.35.18; ; son of: Israel (H3478) and Rachel (H7354); ; brother of: Joseph (H3130); ; half-brother of: Reuben (H7205), Simeon (H8095), Levi (H3878), Judah (H3063), Dan (H1835H), Naphtali (H5321), Gad (H1410), Asher (H0836), Issachar (H3485), Zebulun (H2074) and Dinah (H1783); ; father of: Bela (H1106A), Becher (H1071), Ashbel (H0788), Gera (H1617), Naaman (H5283), Ehi (H0278), Rosh (H7220), Muppim (H4649), Huppim (H2650H), Ard (H0714), Ahiram (H0297) and Jediael (H3043); also called Jamin at 1Sa.9.1,4; 22.7; 1x; Another name of bin.ya.min (בִּנְיָמִין "Benjamin" H1144G) ; § Ben-oni = "son of my sorrow"; the name given to Benjamin by Rachel;
בןאוני.grammar_note: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H205 (אָוֶן); son of my sorrow;

בןגבר.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.13; ; son Geber (H1398) ; § Ben-geber = "the son of Geber" or "the son of a man"; an officer of Solomon
בןגבר.grammar_note: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H1397 (גֶּבֶר); son of (the) hero;

בןדקר.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.9; ; son of: Deker (H1857); § Ben-dekar = "son of stabbing" or "son of Dekar"; an officer of Solomon
בןדקר.grammar_note: from H1121 (בֵּן) and a derivative of H1856 (דָּקַר); son of piercing (or of a lance);

בנה.definition: 1) to build, rebuild, establish, cause to continue; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to build, rebuild; 1a2) to build a house (ie, establish a family); 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be built; 1b2) to be rebuilt; 1b3) established (of restored exiles) (fig.); 1b4) established (made permanent); 1b5) to be built up (of childless wife becoming the mother of a family through the children of a concubine); Aramaic equivalent: be.nah (בְּנָה "to build" H1124)

בןהדד.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.15.18; ; son of: Tabrimmon (H2886); § Ben-hadad = "son of [the false god] Hadad"; 1) the king of Syria, contemporary with Asa of Judah; 2) the son of Hazael, also king of Syria
בןהדד.grammar_note: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H1908 (הֲדַד); son of Hadad;

בנוי.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.10; also called Binnui at Neh.7.15; ; Another spelling of ba.ni (בָּנִי "Bani" H1137Q); § Binnui = "built up"; 1) an exile returnee with Zerubbabel, son of Henadad, who assisted at the reparation of the wall of Jerusalem, under Nehemiah; 2) a Levite in time of Ezra, father of Noadiah; 3) another Levite in time of Ezra, who took a foreign wife; 4) still another Levite in time of Ezra, who took a foreign wife

בןזוחת.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah(?) living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.20; ; son of: Ishi (H3469H); ; brother of: Zoheth (H2105) ; § Ben-zoheth = "son of Zoheth"; one of the tribe of Judah;
בןזוחת.grammar_note: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H2105 (זוֹחֵת); son of Zocheth;

בןחור.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.8; ; son of: Hur (H1133H); § Ben-hur = "son of whiteness" or "son of Chur"; a man who was commissariat officer for Solomon in Mount Ephraim
בןחור.grammar_note: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H2354 (חוּר); son of Chur;

בןחיל.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Ch.17.7 ; § Ben-hail = "son of strength" or "son (man) of might"; a ruler (prince) under Jehoshaphat;
בןחיל.grammar_note: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H2428 (חַיִל); son of might;

בןחנן.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah(?) living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.20; ; son of: Shimon (H7889); ; brother of: Amnon (H0550H), Rinnah (H7441) and Tilon (H8436) ; § Ben-hanan = "son of favour"; one of the tribe of Judah;
בןחנן.grammar_note: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H2605 (חָנָן); son of Chanan;

בןחסד.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.10; ; son of: Hesed (H2618) ; § Ben-hesed = "son of mercy"; an officer of Solomon;
בןחסד.grammar_note: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H2617 (חֵסֵד); son of kindness;

בני.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Sa.23.36; § Bani = "built"; 1) a Gadite, one of David's mighty warriors; 2) a Levite of the line of Merari, and forefather to Ethan; 3) a man of Judah of the line of Pharez; 4) "children of Bani" returned from captivity with Zerubbabel; 5) one or up to three Levites in Nehemiah's time

בניברק.definition: ; § Bene-barak = "sons of lightning"; a city in Dan;
בניברק.grammar_note: from the plural construction of H1121 (בֵּן) and H1300 (בָּרָק);

בני יעקן.definition: ; § Bene-jaakan = "sons of twisting"; an Israelite place of encampment in the wilderness (same as be.e.rot be.ne-ya.a.qan (בְּאֵרֹת בְּנֵי־יַעֲקָן "Beeroth-bene-jaakan" H0885))
בני יעקן.grammar_note: from the plural of H1121 (בֵּן) and H3292 (יַעֲקָן); sons of Yaakan;

בנים.definition: 1) between, space between two armies; 1a) man of the space between armies, i.e. champion (of Goliath) (meton)

בנימין.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.35.18; ; son of: Israel (H3478) and Rachel (H7354); ; brother of: Joseph (H3130); ; half-brother of: Reuben (H7205), Simeon (H8095), Levi (H3878), Judah (H3063), Dan (H1835H), Naphtali (H5321), Gad (H1410), Asher (H0836), Issachar (H3485), Zebulun (H2074) and Dinah (H1783); ; father of: Bela (H1106A), Becher (H1071), Ashbel (H0788), Gera (H1617), Naaman (H5283), Ehi (H0278), Rosh (H7220), Muppim (H4649), Huppim (H2650H), Ard (H0714), Ahiram (H0297) and Jediael (H3043); also called Jamin at 1Sa.9.1,4; 22.7; 1x; § Benjamin = "son of the right hand"; 1) Jacob's and Rachel's youngest son, Joseph's full brother; 2) son of Bilhan, great-grandson of Benjamin; 3) a Benjamite, one of the sons of Harim, in the time of Ezra who had taken a strange wife; 4) the tribe descended from Benjamin, the son of Jacob
בנימין.grammar_note: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H3225 (יָמִין); son of (the) right hand;

בןימיני.definition: Someone from the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.35.18; ; son of: Israel (H3478) and Rachel (H7354); ; brother of: Joseph (H3130); ; half-brother of: Reuben (H7205), Simeon (H8095), Levi (H3878), Judah (H3063), Dan (H1835H), Naphtali (H5321), Gad (H1410), Asher (H0836), Issachar (H3485), Zebulun (H2074) and Dinah (H1783); ; father of: Bela (H1106A), Becher (H1071), Ashbel (H0788), Gera (H1617), Naaman (H5283), Ehi (H0278), Rosh (H7220), Muppim (H4649), Huppim (H2650H), Ard (H0714), Ahiram (H0297) and Jediael (H3043); also called Jamin at 1Sa.9.1,4; 22.7; 1x; Group of bin.ya.min (בִּנְיָמִין "Benjamin" H1144) ; § Benjamite = "a son of the right hand"; one of the tribe of Benjamin;
בןימיני.grammar_note: sometimes (with the article inserted) בֵּן־הַיּמִינִי; with H376 (אִישׁ) inserted (1 Samuel 9:1) בֶּן־אִישׁ ימִינִי; son of a man of Jemini; or shortened אִישׁ יְמִינִי; (1 Samuel 9:4; Esther 2:5) a man of Jemini, or (1 Samuel 20:1) simply יְמִינִיxlit Yᵉmînîy corrected to Yᵉmîynîy; a Jeminite; (plural) בְּנֵי יְמִינִיxlit Bᵉnîy corrected to Bᵉnêy; patron from H1144 (בִּנְיָמִין);

בנין.definition: structure, building; Aramaic equivalent: bin.yan (בִּנְיָן "building" H1147)

בנינו.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.10.13 ; § Beninu = "our son"; a returning Levite exile who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah;
בנינו.grammar_note: probably from H1121 (בֵּן) with pron. suff.; our son;

בנעא.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.8.37; ; son of: Moza (H4162H); ; father of: Raphah (H7498), Eleasah (H0501H) and Azel (H0682A) ; § Binea or Bineah = fountain; a descendant of Jonathan;

בןעמי.definition: A man of Ammon living at the time of the Patriarchs, only mentioned at Gen.19.38; ; son of: Lot (H3876) and his second daughter (H3876I); half-brother of Moab (H4124H) ; § Ben-ami = "son of my people"; son of Lot, born to his second daughter, progenitor of the Ammonites;
בןעמי.grammar_note: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H5971 (עַם) with pronomial suffix; son of my people;

בסודיה.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.3.6; ; father of: Meshullam (H4918S) ; § Besodeiah = "with the counsel of Jehovah" or "in the secret of the Lord"; father of one of the repairers of the wall of Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah;
בסודיה.grammar_note: from H5475 (סוֹד) and H3050 (יָהּ) with prepositional prefix; in (the) counsel of Jehovah;

בסי.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.49 ; § Besai = "my treading"; a temple slave (or group of slaves) who returned with Zerubbabel;

בסר.definition: unripe or sour grapes; Another spelling of bo.ser (בֹּ֫סֶר "unripe grape" H1155)
בסר.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to be sour;

בעא.definition: 1) to ask, seek, request, desire, pray, make petition; 1a) (P'al); 1a1) to ask, request; 1a2) to seek (for favour)
בעא.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √bʿy 'to seek, request'. Common Aramaic verb.

בעד.definition: 1) behind, through, round about, on behalf of, away from, about; 1a) through (of action); 1b) behind (with verbs of shutting); 1c) about (with verbs of fencing); 1d) on behalf of (metaph. especially with Hithpael)

בעה.definition: 1) to seek out, swell, cause to swell, boil up, enquire; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to seek, enquire; 1a2) to cause to boil up; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be searched out; 1b2) to be swelling, bulging, swelling out

בעו.definition: 1) petition, request; 2) prayer (always in Jewish liturgy)

בעור.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.36.32; ; father of: Bela (H1106); § Beor = "burning"; 1) father of Balaam; 2) father of Bela, king of Edom
בעור.grammar_note: from H1197 (בָּעַר) (in the sense of burning); a lamp;

בעז.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Rut.2.1; ; son of: Salmon (H8007) and Rahab (H7343); married to Ruth (H7327); ; father of: Obed (H5744); Also named: Booz (Βοόζ "Boaz" G1003); § Boaz = "fleetness"; 1) ancestor of David, kinsman-redeemer to Ruth, daughter-in-law of Naomi; 2) name of the left of two brazen pillars, 18 cubits high, erected in the porch of Solomon's temple
בעז.grammar_note: from an unused root of uncertain meaning;

בעט.definition: 1) to kick, kick at; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to kick; 1a2) to kick at; 1a3) to desire (fig.)

בעי.definition: ruin, heap of ruins; Another spelling of i (עִי "ruin" H5856)

בעיר.grammar_note: from H1197 (בָּעַר) (in the sense of eating);

בעל.definition: 1) to rule over, possess, own; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be lord over; 1a2) to rule over; 1b) (Niphal) to be ruled; § 1) to marry, rule over, possess, own; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to marry, be lord (husband) over; 1a2) to rule over; 1b) (Niphal) to be married
בעל.grammar_note: a primitive root; also as denominative from H1167 (בַּעַל)

בעל ברית.definition: ; § Baal-berith = "lord of the covenant"; a god of the Philistines;
בעל ברית.grammar_note: from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H1285 (בְּרִית); Baal of (the) covenant;

בעל גד.definition: Baal-gad = "lord of fortune"; a city noted for Baal-worship, located at the most northern or northwestern point to which Joshua's victories extended; Another name of cher.mon (חֶרְמוֹן "(Mount )Hermon" H2768)
בעל גד.grammar_note: from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H1409 (גָּד); Baal of Fortune;

בעלה.definition: 1) mistress, female owner; 2) sorceress, necromancer (noun of relationship)

בעל המון.definition: Baal-hamon = "lord (possessor) of abundance"; the site of Solomon's vineyard; Another spelling of cher.mon (חֶרְמוֹן "(Mount )Hermon" H2768)
בעל המון.grammar_note: from H1167 (בַּעַל) and H1995 (הָמוֹן); possessor of a multitude;

בעלות.definition: Baalath or Bealoth = "mistresses"; a town in south Judah; Another name of ba.a.lat be.er (בַּעֲלַת בְּאֵר "Baalath-beer" H1192)

בעל זבוב.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.1.2 ; § Baal-zebub = "lord of the fly"; a Philistine deity worshipped at Ekron;
בעל זבוב.grammar_note: from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H2070 (זְבוּב); Baal of (the) Fly;

בעל חנן.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.36.38; ; son of: Achbor (H5907); § Baal-hanan = "Baal is gracious"; 1) an early king of Edom; 2) one of David's officers, a Gederite, who had the superintendence of his olive and sycamore plantations
בעל חנן.grammar_note: from H1167 (בַּעַל) and H2603 (חָנַן); possessor of grace;

בעל חצור.definition: ; § Baal-hazor = "lord of the village"; a town on the border between Ephraim and Benjamin, apparent location of a sheep farm of Absalom and location of Amnon's murder;
בעל חצור.grammar_note: from H1167 (בַּעַל) and a modification of H2691 (חָצֵר); possessor of a village;

בעל חרמון.definition: Baal-hermon or Baal-chermon = "lord of destruction"; a city near or on Mount Hermon, named as a seat of Baal worship; Another name of cher.mon (חֶרְמוֹן "(Mount )Hermon" H2768)
בעל חרמון.grammar_note: from H1167 (בַּעַל) and H2768 (חֶרְמוֹן); possessor of Hermon;

בעלי.definition: Baali = "my lord"; a deity in the northern kingdom, variation of the name 'Baal'; Another name of ye.ho.vah (יהוה "LORD" H3068G)
בעלי.grammar_note: from H1167 (בַּעַל) with pron. suff.; my master;

בעלי במות.definition: Baale-bamoth = "the lords of the high places"; the people of Arnon, east of Jordan
בעלי במות.grammar_note: from the plural of H1168 (בַּעַל) and the plural of H1116 (בָּמָה); Baals of (the) heights;

בעלידע.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.5.16; ; son of: David (H1732); ; brother of: Amnon (H0550), Chileab (H3609), Absalom (H0053), Adonijah (H0138), Shephatiah (H8203), Ithream (H3507), Shammua (H8051H), Shobab (H7727), Nathan (H5416), Solomon (H8010), Ibhar (H2984), Elishua (H0474), Nepheg (H5298H), Japhia (H3309I), Elishama (H0476H), Eliphelet (H0467), Tamar (H8559H), Elpelet (H0467I), Nogah (H5052) and Jerimoth (H3406N); also called Beeliada at 1Ch.14.7; ; Another name of el.ya.da (אֶלְיָדָע "Eliada" H0450G) ; § Beeliada = "the lord knows"; a son of David, born in Jerusalem, elsewhere named 'Eliada';
בעלידע.grammar_note: from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H3045 (יָדַע); Baal has known;

בעליה.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.12.5 ; § Bealiah = "Jehovah is master"; a Benjamite who went over to David at Ziklag and was one of David's mighty warriors;
בעליה.grammar_note: from H1167 (בַּעַל) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah (is) master;

בעלי יהודה.definition: Baale-Judah = "the lords of Judah"; a place in Judah named for the Baalim, also known as Kirjath-jearim, Kirjath-baal; modern Kuriet el Enab; Combined with qir.yat ye.a.rim (קִרְיַת יְעָרִים "Kiriath-jearim" H7157)
בעלי יהודה.grammar_note: from the plural of H1167 (בַּעַל) and H3063 (יְהוּדָה); masters of Judah;

בעליס.definition: A man of the Ammonites living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at Jer.40.14 ; § Baalis = "lord of the banner: in causing the joy"; king of the Ammonites at the time of the destruction of Jerusalem by Nebuchadnezzar;
בעליס.grammar_note: probably from a derivative of H5965 (עָלַס) with prepositional prefix; in exultation;

בעל מעון.definition: ; § Baal-meon = "lord of the habitation"; a town in Reuben, mentioned in connection with Nebo, and in the time of Ezekiel, Moabite;
בעל מעון.grammar_note: from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H4583 (מָעוֹן); Baal of (the) habitation (of) (compare H1010 (בֵּית בַּעַל מְעוֹן));

בעל פעור.definition: Baal-peor = "lord of the gap"; the deity worshipped at Peor with probable licentious rites; Another name of ba.al (בַּעַל "Baal" H1168A)
בעל פעור.grammar_note: from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H6465 (פְּעוֹר); Baal of Peor;

בעל פרצים.definition: ; § Baal-perazim = "lord of the breaks"; the site of a victory of David over the Philistines, and of a great destruction of their images; also called 'Mount Perazim';
בעל פרצים.grammar_note: from H1167 (בַּעַל) and the plural of H6556 (פֶּרֶץ); possessor of breaches;

בעל צפון.definition: ; § Baal Tsphon or Baal-zephon = "lord of the north"; a place in Egypt near the Red Sea where Pharaoh and his army were destroyed during the Exodus;
בעל צפון.grammar_note: from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H6828 (צָפוֹן) (in the sense of cold) (according to others an Egyptian form of Typhon, the destroyer); Baal of winter;

בעל שלשה.definition: ; § Baal-shalisha = "thrice-great lord"; a place in Ephraim near Gilgal;

בעלת באר.definition: ; § Baalath-beer = "mistress of the well"; a town in the south part of Judah, given to Simeon, which also bore the name of 'Ramath-negeb';
בעלת באר.grammar_note: from H1172 (בַּעֲלָה) and H875 (בְּאֵר); mistress of a well;

בעל תמר.definition: ; § Baal-tamar = "lord of the palms"; a place near Gibeah in Benjamin;
בעל תמר.grammar_note: from H1167 (בַּעַל) and H8558 (תָּמָר); possessor of (the) palm-tree;

בען.definition: Beon = "in the dwelling: indwelling"; a place or city in Reuben; Another name of ba.al me.on (בַּ֫עַל מְעוֹן "Baal-meon" H1186)
בען.grammar_note: probably a contraction of H1010 (בֵּית בַּעַל מְעוֹן);

בענא.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.12; ; son of: Ahilud (H0286); ; brother of: Jehoshaphat (H3092); § Baana or Baanah = "in the affliction"; 1) the son of Ahilud, Solomon's commissariat officer in Jezreel and the north of the Jordan valley; 2) another of Solomon's officers; 3) father of Zadok who assisted in rebuilding the wall of Jerusalem under Nehemiah

בענה.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.4.2; ; son of: Rimmon (H7417B); ; brother of: Rechab (H7394); § Baana or Baanah = "in affliction"; 1) a Benjamite, son Rimmon, who with his brother Rechab murdered Ish-bosheth. For this, killed by David, mutilated bodies hung up over the pool at Hebron; 2) a Netophathite, father of Heleb or Heled, one of David's mighty warriors; 3) the head of a family of exiles returning with Zerubbabel; 4) a chief of the people
בענה.grammar_note: from a derivative of H6031 (עָנָה) with prepositional prefix; in affliction

בער.definition: : purge/remove; 1) to burn, consume, kindle, be kindled; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to begin to burn, be kindled, start burning; 1a2) to burn, be burning; 1a3) to burn, consume; 1a4) Jehovah's wrath, human wrath (fig.); 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to kindle, burn; 1b2) to consume, remove (of guilt) (fig.); 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to kindle; 1c2) to burn up; 1c3) to consume (destroy); 1d) (Pual) to burn
בער.grammar_note: a primitive root; also as denominative from H1198 (בַּעַר)

בערא.definition: A womanof the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.8.8; married to Shaharaim (H7842) ; § Baara = "brutish"; one of the wives of Shaharaim, a Benjamite;

בעשא.definition: A king of the Kingdom of Israel, living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.15.16; ; son of: Ahijah (H0281I); ; father of: Elah (H0425H) ; § Baasha = "wicked"; third king of the northern kingdom of Israel and the founder of its second dynasty having killed the second king, Nadab;
בעשא.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to stink; offensiveness;

בעשיה.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.6.40; ; son of: Malchijah (H4441); ; father of: Michael (H4317J) ; § Baaseiah = "in the service of Jehovah"; a Gershonite Levite, one of the forefathers of Asaph the singer;
בעשיה.grammar_note: from H6213 (עָשָׂה) and H3050 (יָהּ) with a prepositional prefix; in (the) work of Jah;

בעשתרה.definition: Beeshterah = "with increase"; a Levitical city in Manasseh, east of the Jordan; probably identical with 'Ashtaroth'; Another name of ash.ta.rot (עַשְׁתָּרוֹת "Ashtaroth" H6252H)
בעשתרה.grammar_note: from H6251 (עַשְׁתְּרָה) (as singular of H6252 (עַשְׁתָּרוֹת)) with a prepositional prefix; with Ashtoreth;

בעת.definition: 1) to terrify, startle, fall upon, dismay, be overtaken by sudden terror; 1a) (Niphal) to be terrified; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to fall upon, overwhelm; 1b2) to terrify

בצי.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.17; § Bezai = "conqueror"; a chief of the returning exiles in the time of Ezra

בצל.grammar_note: from an unused root apparently meaning to peel;

בצלאל.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.31.2; ; son of: Uri (H0221); § Bezaleel = "in the shadow (i.e. protection) of God"; 1) son of Uri and grandson of Hur; a skilled Judahite artisan in all works of metal, wood, and stone and one of the architects of the tabernacle; 2) an Israelite, one of the sons of Pahath-moab, in the time of Ezra who had taken a strange wife
בצלאל.grammar_note: probably from H6738 (צֵל) and H410 (אֵל) with a prepositional prefix; in (the) shadow (i.e. protection) of God;

בצלות.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.52; also called Bazlith at Neh.7.54; ; § Bazlith or Bazluth = "asking"; a head of a family of exiles returning with Zerubbabel;
בצלות.grammar_note: or בַּצְלִית; from the same as H1211 (בֶּצֶל)xlit bᵉtsel corrected to betsel; a peeling;

בצע.definition: : to cut off; 1) to cut off, break off, gain by unrighteous violence, get, finish, be covetous, be greedy; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to cut off; 1a2) to stop; 1a3) to gain wrongfully or by violence; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to cut off, sever; 1b2) to finish, complete, accomplish; 1b3) to violently make gain of
בצע.grammar_note: a primitive root to break off, i.e. (usually) plunder;

בצקת.definition: ; § Bozkath or Boscath = "rocky height"; a city in Judah in the lowlands toward the Philistines, home of Josiah's mother;
בצקת.grammar_note: from H1216 (בָּצֵק); a swell of ground;

בצר.definition: 1) to gather, restrain, fence, fortify, make inaccessible, enclose; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to cut off; 1a2) fortified, cut off, made inaccessible (pass participle); 1a3) secrets, mysteries, inaccessible things (subst); 1b) (Niphal) to be withheld; 1c) (Piel) to fortify
בצר.grammar_note: a primitive root; to clip off; specifically (as denominative from H1210 (בָּצִיר))

בקבוק.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.51 ; § Bakbuk = "bottle"; a head of a family of temple-slaves returning from exile with Zerubbabel;
בקבוק.grammar_note: the same as H1228 (בַּקְבֻּק)xlit baqbûk corrected to baqbuq;

בקבקיה.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Neh.11.17 ; § Bakbukiah = "wasting of Jehovah"; a Levite in the time of Nehemiah;
בקבקיה.grammar_note: from H1228 (בַּקְבֻּק)xlit baqbûk corrected to baqbuq and H3050 (יָהּ); emptying (i.e. wasting) of Jah;

בקבקר.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at 1Ch.9.15 ; § Bakbakkar = "searcher"; a Levite, apparently a descendant of Asaph;

בקי.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.34.22; ; son of: Jogli (H3020); § Bukki = "wasting"; 1) son of Abishua and father of Uzzi, fifth from Aaron in the line of the high priests; 2) son of Jogli, prince of the tribe of Dan, one of the ten men chosen to apportion the land of Canaan between the tribes

בקיה.grammar_note: from H1238 (בָּקַק) and H3050 (יָהּ); wasting of Jah;

בקע.definition: 1) to split, cleave, break open, divide, break through, rip up, break up, tear; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to cleave, cleave open; 1a2) to break through, break into; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be cleft, be rent open, be split open; 1b2) to be broken into; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to cleave, cut to pieces, rend open; 1c2) to break through, break down; 1d) (Pual); 1d1) to be ripped open, be torn open; 1d2) to be rent; 1d3) to be broken into; 1e) (Hiphil); 1e1) to break into; 1e2) to break through; 1f) (Hophal) to be broken into; 1g) (Hithpael) to burst (themselves) open, cleave asunder

בקעה.definition: This name means plain, level valley; Combined with le.va.non (לְבָנוֹן " of Lebanon" H3844I)

בקק.definition: 1) to empty; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to empty, lay waste; 1a2) to make void (fig.); 1b) (Niphal) to be emptied; 1c) (Polel) to empty out, devastate

בקר.definition: 1) morning, break of day; 1a) morning; 1a1) of end of night; 1a2) of coming of daylight; 1a3) of coming of sunrise; 1a4) of beginning of day; 1a5) of bright joy after night of distress (fig.); 1b) morrow, next day, next morning

בקש.definition: 1) to seek, require, desire, exact, request; 1a) (Piel); 1a1) to seek to find; 1a2) to seek to secure; 1a3) to seek the face; 1a4) to desire, demand; 1a5) to require, exact; 1a6) to ask, request; 1b) (Pual) to be sought

בר.definition: field (Aram. usage); Aramaic equivalent: bar (בַּר "field" H1251)
בר.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic *bar- 'son' (Aramaic). Hebrew uses בן from same root family.

ברא.definition: 1) to create, shape, form; 1a) (Qal) to shape, fashion, create (always with God as subject); 1a1) of heaven and earth; 1a2) of individual man; 1a3) of new conditions and circumstances; 1a4) of transformations; 1b) (Niphal) to be created; 1b1) of heaven and earth; 1b2) of birth; 1b3) of something new; 1b4) of miracles; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to cut down; 1c2) to cut out

בראדך בלאדן.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.20.12; ; son of: Baladan (H1081); Also named: me.ro.dakh bal.a.dan (מְרֹדַךְ בַּלְאֲדָן "Merodach-baladan" H4757) ; § Berodach-baladan = "worshipper of Baal"; king of Babylon in the days of Hezekiah;

בראיה.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.8.21; ; son of: Shimei (H8096N); ; brother of: Jakim (H3356), Zichri (H2147H), Zabdi (H2067H), Elienai (H0462), Zillethai (H6769), Eliel (H0447H), Adaiah (H5718H) and Shimrath (H8119) ; § Beraiah = "Jehovah has created"; son of Shimhi, a chief man of Benjamin;
בראיה.grammar_note: from H1254 (בָּרָא) and H8050 (שְׁמוּאֵל); Jah has created;

ברה.definition: 1) to eat, consume; 1a) (Qal) to eat; 1b) (Piel) for eating, devouring; 1c) (Hiphil) to cause to eat
ברה.grammar_note: a primitive root; to select; also (as denominative from H1250 (בָּר)) to feed; also (as equivalent to H1305 (בָּרַר)) to render clear (Ecclesiastes 3:18)

ברוך.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.3.20; ; son of: Zabbai (H2079H); § Baruch = "blessed"; 1) friend, amanuensis, and faithful attendant of Jeremiah; 2) a priest, the son of Zabbai who assisted Nehemiah in rebuilding the walls of Jerusalem; 3) a priest, or family of priests, who signed the covenant with Nehemiah; 4) son of Col-hozeh, a descendant of Perez or Pharez, the son of Judah

ברוש.definition: 1) cypress, fir, juniper, pine; 1a) a noble tree (lit.); 1b) of stateliness (fig.); 1c) material for temple

ברותה.definition: ; § Berothah or Berothai = "cypress grove"; a place near Hamath
ברותה.grammar_note: or בֵּרֹתַי; probably from H1266 (בְּרוֹת)lemma בֻּרוֹת first vowel, corrected to בְּרוֹת; cypress or cypresslike;

ברזות.definition: A man of the tribe of Asher living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at 1Ch.7.31; ; son of: Malchiel (H4439) ; § Birzavith or Birzath = "in leanness: choice olive"; a descendant of Asher;
ברזות.grammar_note: probably feminine plural from an unused root (apparently mean to pierce); holes;

ברזל.definition: 1) iron; 1a) iron; 1a1) iron ore; 1a2) as material of furniture, utensils, implements; 2) tool of iron; 3) harshness, strength, oppression (fig.); Aramaic equivalent: par.zel (פַּרְזֶל "iron" H6523)
ברזל.grammar_note: perhaps from the root of H1269 (בִּרְזוֹת);

ברזלי.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.17.27; § Barzillai = "my iron"; 1) a Gileadite leader who helped David defeat Absalom's rebellion; 2) a priest, son-in-law to Barzillai the Gileadite; 3) an Israelite from Mahalath whose son Adriel married Michal, Saul's daughter

בריה.definition: 1) fat; 2) (TWOT) fat, fatter, fed, firm, plenteous, rank

בריח.definition: 1) bar; 1a) of wood; 1b) of city gates; 2) of tribulation, a fortress, of the earth as a prison (fig.)

בריעי.definition: Someone descended from Beriah who was a man of the tribe of Asher living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.17; ; son of: Asher (H0836); ; brother of: Imnah (H3232), Ishvah (H3438), Ishvi (H3440) and Serah (H8294); ; father of: Heber (H2268) and Malchiel (H4439); also called Beriite at Num.26.44; ; Group of be.ri.ah (בְּרִיעָה "Beriah" H1283) ; § Beriites = "in evil"; one of the family of Beriah;

ברית.definition: 1) covenant, alliance, pledge; 1a) between men; 1a1) treaty, alliance, league (man to man); 1a2) constitution, ordinance (monarch to subjects); 1a3) agreement, pledge (man to man); 1a4) alliance (of friendship); 1a5) alliance (of marriage); 1b) between God and man; 1b1) alliance (of friendship); 1b2) covenant (divine ordinance with signs or pledges); 2) (phrases); 2a) covenant making; 2b) covenant keeping; 2c) covenant violation

ברך.definition: 1) to bless, kneel; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to kneel; 1a2) to bless; 1b) (Niphal) to be blessed, bless oneself; 1c) (Piel) to bless; 1d) (Pual) to be blessed, be adored; 1e) (Hiphil) to cause to kneel; 1f) (Hithpael) to bless oneself; 2) (TWOT) to praise, salute, curse; Aramaic equivalent: be.rakh (בְּרַךְ "to bless" H1289)

ברכאל.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Job.32.2; ; father of: Elihu (H0453K) ; § Barachel = "God blesses"; father of Elihu;
ברכאל.grammar_note: from H1288 (בָרַךְ) and H410 (אֵל), God has blessed;

ברכה.definition: 1) blessing; 2) (source of) blessing; 3) blessing, prosperity; 4) blessing, praise of God; 5) a gift, present; 6) treaty of peace

ברכיה.grammar_note: or בֶּרֶכְיָהוּ; from H1290 (בֶּרֶךְ) and H3050 (יָהּ); knee (i.e. blessing) of Jah;

ברם.grammar_note: (Aramaic) perhaps from H7313 (רוּם) with a prepositional prefix;

ברע.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, only mentioned at Gen.14.2 ; § Bera = "son of evil"; a king of Sodom;

ברק.definition: 1) lightning; 1a) lightnings, lightning flashes; 1b) of flashing arrow-head (fig.)

ברקוס.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.53 ; § Barkos = "the son cut off"; head of a family of temple-slaves who returned from exile with Zerubbabel;

ברקת.definition: a gem, precious stone, emerald (Josephus); Another spelling of ba.re.qet (בָּרֶ֫קֶת "gem" H1304A)

ברר.definition: 1) to purify, select, polish, choose, purge, cleanse or make bright, test or prove; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to purge, purge out, purify; 1a2) to choose, select; 1a3) to cleanse, make shining, polish; 1a4) to test, prove; 1b) (Niphal) to purify oneself; 1c) (Piel) to purify; 1d) (Hiphil); 1d1) to purify; 1d2) to polish arrows; 1e) (Hithpael); 1e1) to purify oneself; 1e2) to show oneself pure, just, kind

ברשע.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, only mentioned at Gen.14.2 ; § Birsha = "with iniquity"; a king of Gomorrah;
ברשע.grammar_note: probably from H7562 (רֶשַׁע) with a prepositional prefix; with wickedness;

ברתי.definition: Berothah or Berothai = "cypress grove"; a city belonging to Hadadezer; Another name of be.ro.tah (בֵּר֫וֹתָה "Berothah" H1268A)

בשור.definition: ; § Besor = "cheerful"; a stream, torrent-bed, or wadi in extreme south of Judah in Philistia; empties into the Mediterranean Sea;

בשורה.definition: glad tidings; by implication, reward forgood news

בשל.definition: 1) to boil, cook, bake, roast, ripen, grow ripe; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to boil, cook; 1a2) to grow ripe, ripen; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to boil; 1b2) to cook; 1c) (Pual); 1c1) to be boiled; 1c2) to be sodden; 1d) (Hiphil); 1d1) to ripen; 1d2) ripen, brought to ripeness

בשלם.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Ezr.4.7 ; § Bishlam = "in peace"; a Persian officer in Palestine in the time of Ezra;

בשם.definition: 1) spice, balsam, balsam tree, perfume; 2) (TWOT) sweet, sweet smell, sweet odour

בשן.definition: ; § Bashan = "fruitful"; a district east of the Jordan known for its fertility which was given to the half-tribe of Manasseh;

בתואל.grammar_note: apparently from the same as H1326 (בָּתָה) and H410 (אֵל); destroyed of God;

בתול.definition: ; § Bethul = "God destroys" or "man of God" or "dweller in God"; a town of Simeon in the south (also spelled 'Bethuel');

בתולה.grammar_note: feminine passive participle of an unused root meaning to separate;

בתולים.grammar_note: masculine plural of the same as H1330 (בְּתוּלָה);

בתיה.definition: A woman of the Egyptians living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.18; ; daughter of: Pharaoh (H6547M); married to Mered (H4778)(?); ; mother of: Miriam (H4813H), Shammai (H8060I) and Ishbah (H3431) ; § Bithiah = "daughter of Jehovah"; a daughter of a Pharaoh and wife of Mered of Judah;
בתיה.grammar_note: from H1323 (בַּת) and H3050 (יָהּ); daughter (i.e. worshipper) of Jah;

בתק.definition: (Piel) to cut, cut up, cut off, cut down

בתר.definition: 1) part, piece; 1a) of the parts of an animal cut in half for a sacrifice

בתרון.definition: ; § Bithron = "division" or "cleft" or "ravine"; a territory or district in the Jordan valley east of the Jordan;
בתרון.grammar_note: from H1334 (בָּתַר); (with the article) the craggy spot;

בתשבע.definition: A woman living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.11.3; ; daughter of: Eliam (H0463); married to David (H1732) and Uriah (H0223A); ; mother of: Shammua (H8051H), Shobab (H7727), Nathan (H5416) and Solomon (H8010); also called Bath-shua at 1Ch.3.5; ; Also named: bat-shu.a (בַּת־שׁוּעַ "Bath-shua" H1340) ; § Bath-sheba = "daughter of an oath"; the wife of Uriah whom David had murdered, having had adulterous relations with her; subsequently wife of David and mother of Solomon, Shimea, Shobab, and Nathan;

בתשוע.definition: A woman living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.11.3; ; daughter of: Eliam (H0463); married to David (H1732) and Uriah (H0223A); ; mother of: Shammua (H8051H), Shobab (H7727), Nathan (H5416) and Solomon (H8010); also called Bath-shua at 1Ch.3.5; ; Another spelling of bat-she.va (בַּת־שֶׁ֫בַע "Bathsheba" H1339) ; § Bath-shua = "daughter of wealth"; 1) the wife of Uriah whom David had murdered, having had adulterous relations with her; subsequently wife of David and mother of Solomon, Shimea, Shobab, and Nathan (alternate spelling to 'Bathsheba'); 2) wife of Judah;
בתשוע.grammar_note: from H1323 (בַּת) and H7771 (שׁוֹעַ); daughter of wealth;  the same as H1339 (בַּת־שֶׁבַע)

גאה.definition: 1) to rise up, grow up, be exalted in triumph; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to rise up; 1a2) to grow up; 1a3) to be lifted up, be raised up, be exalted

גאואל.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.13.15; ; son of: Machi (H4352) ; § Geuel = "majesty of God"; the Gadite chosen to spy out the land, son of Machi;
גאואל.grammar_note: from H1342 (גָּאָה) and H410 (אֵל); majesty of God;

גאוה.definition: 1) pride, majesty, a rising up; 1a) a rising up, swelling (of the sea); 1b) majesty (of Israel); 1c) pride, haughtiness

גאון.definition: 1) exaltation, majesty, pride; 1a) majesty, exaltation, excellence; 1a1) of nations; 1a2) of God; 1a3) of the Jordan; 1b) pride, arrogance (bad sense)
גאון.grammar_note: from H1342 (גָּאָה); the same as H1346 (גַּאֲוָה)xlit gaʻăvâh corrected to gaʼăvâh

גאות.definition: 1) majesty; 1a) a rising up (of column of smoke); 1b) a swelling (of sea); 1c) majesty (of God); 1d) pride
גאות.grammar_note: from H1342 (גָּאָה); the same as H1346 (גַּאֲוָה)xlit gaʻăvâh corrected to gaʼăvâh

גב.definition: 1) convex surface, back; 1a) back (of man); 1b) mound (for illicit worship); 1c) boss (convex projection of shield); 1d) bulwarks, breastworks (of arguments-fig.); 1e) brow, eyebrow; 1f) rim (of wheel); Aramaic equivalent: gav (גַּב "back" H1355)
גב.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to hollow or curve; (compare H1460 (גֵּו) and H1479 (גּוּף))

גבא.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning probably to collect;

גבה.definition: 1) to be high, be exalted; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be high, lofty, tall; 1a2) to be exalted; 1a3) to be lofty; 1a3a) to be lofty (of Jehovah's ways-good sense); 1a3b) to be haughty, be arrogant (bad sense); 1b) (Hiphil) to make high, exalt

גבור.definition: adj; 1) strong, mighty; n m; 2) strong man, brave man, mighty man
גבור.grammar_note: or גִּבֹּר; (shortened) intensive from the same as H1397 (גֶּבֶר);

גבורה.definition: 1) strength, might; 1a) strength; 1b) might, valour, bravery; 1c) might, mighty deeds (of God); Aramaic equivalent: ge.vu.rah (גְּבוּרָה "might" H1370)
גבורה.grammar_note: feminine passive participle from the same as H1368 (גִּבּוֹר);

גבח.definition: to be high, bald (in the forehead), having a bald forehead
גבח.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to be high (in the forehead);

גבחת.definition: bald forehead, bald, a bare spot

גבי.definition: locusts, symbol of Yahweh's judgment on Isr. ; in sim. of disappearance of Assyrian leaders at destruction of Nineveh; Also means: gov (גּוֹב "locust" H1462A)
גבי.grammar_note: from the same as H1354 (גַב); collective

גבים.definition: ; § Gebim = "cisterns"; a village north of Jerusalem apparently between Anathoth (modern Anata) and the ridge on which Nob was situated;

גביע.grammar_note: from an unused root (meaning to be convex);

גביש.grammar_note: from an unused root (probably meaning to freeze);

גבל.definition: 1) to bound, border; 1a) (Qal) to bound, border; 1b) (Hiphil) to set bounds, set bounds for
גבל.grammar_note: a primitive root; also as a denominative from H1366 (גְּבוּל)

גבלי.definition: ; Group of ge.val (גְּבַל "Gebal" H1380) ; § Giblites = "a boundary"; inhabitants of Gebal;

גבן.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to be arched or contracted;

גבנה.grammar_note: feminine from the same as H1384 (גִּבֵּן);

גבע.grammar_note: from the same as H1375 (גְּבִיעַ), a hillock;

גבעא.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.2.49; ; son of: Sheva (H7724); ; brother of: Machbenah (H4343) ; § Gibea = "hill"; son of Sheva and grandson of Caleb (a son of Caleb);
גבעא.grammar_note: by permutation for H1389 (גִּבְעָה); a hill;

גבעה.definition: 1) hill; 1a) hill (lower than a mountain); 1b) as a place of illicit worship; 1c) poetic for mountain; 1d) used in place names
גבעה.grammar_note: feminine from the same as H1387 (גֶּבַע);

גבעון.definition: ; § Gibeon = "hill city"; a Levitical city of Benjamin, modern 'el-Jib', which lies 5 miles or 8 km from Jerusalem;
גבעון.grammar_note: from the same as H1387 (גֶּבַע); hilly;

גבעני.definition: ; Group of giv.on (גִּבְעוֹן "Gibeon" H1391) ; § Gibeonite = "little hill: hilly"; an inhabitant of Gibeon;

גבעת.definition: Gibeath = "hill"; a city of Benjamin; Another spelling of giv.ah (גִּבְעָה "Gibeah" H1390H)
גבעת.grammar_note: from the same as H1375 (גְּבִיעַ); hilliness;

גבעתי.definition: Gibeathite = "hilliness"; an inhabitant of Gibeah; Another spelling of giv.ah (גִּבְעָה "Gibeah" H1390H)

גבר.definition: 1) to prevail, have strength, be strong, be powerful, be mighty, be great; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be strong, mighty; 1a2) to prevail; 1b) (Piel) to make strong, strengthen; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to confirm, give strength; 1c2) to confirm (a covenant); 1d) (Hithpael); 1d1) to show oneself mighty; 1d2) to act proudly (toward God)

גבריאל.grammar_note: from H1397 (גֶּבֶר) and H410 (אֵל); man of God;

גבתון.definition: ; § Gibbethon = "mound"; a Philistine town in Dan allocated to the Kohathite Levites;
גבתון.grammar_note: intensive from H1389 (גִּבְעָה); a hilly spot;

גג.definition: 1) roof, top, housetop; 1a) roof (of house); 1b) top (of altar of incense)

גד.definition: coriander-a plant the seed of which resembles manna
גד.grammar_note: from H1413 (גָּדַד) (in the sense of cutting);

גדגדה.definition: Gudgodah = "the slashing place"; a station or stopping place of Israel in the wilderness wanderings; Another name of chor hag.gid.gad (חֹר הַגִּדְגָּד "Hor-haggidgad" H2735)
גדגדה.grammar_note: by reduplication from H1413 (גָּדַד) (in the sense of cutting) cleft;

גדד.definition: 1) to penetrate, cut, attack, invade; 1a) (Qal) to penetrate, cut into; 1b)(Hithpoel); 1b1) to cut oneself; 1b2) to gather in troops or crowds; Aramaic equivalent: ge.dad (גְּדַד "to chop" H1414)

גדה.definition: a river bank; Also means: gid.yah (גִּדְיָה "bank" H1428)

גדוד.definition: 1) something cut, furrow, cutting; 1a) a furrow; 1b) cuttings (as a sign of mourning); Also means: ge.du.dah (גְּדוּדָה "furrow" H1418)

גדולה.grammar_note: or גְּדֻלָּה; (shortened) or (less accurately) גְּדוּלָּה; feminine of H1419 (גָּדוֹל);

גדוף.grammar_note: or (shortened) גִּדֻּף; and (feminine) גִּדּוּפָהxlit giddûphâh corrected to giddûwphâh; or גִּדֻּפָה; from H1422 (גְּדוּפָה);

גדיאל.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.13.10; ; son of: Sodi (H5476) ; § Gaddiel = "God is my fortune"; the spy from the tribe of Zebulun sent by Moses to spy out the land of Canaan;
גדיאל.grammar_note: from H1409 (גָּד) and H410 (אֵל); fortune of God;

גדיה.definition: river bank, shore; Another spelling of ga.dah (גָּדָה "bank" H1415)
גדיה.grammar_note: or גַּדיָה; the same as H1415 (גָּדָה);

גדיש.grammar_note: from an unused root (meaning to heap up);

גדל.definition: 1) to grow, become great or important, promote, make powerful, praise, magnify, do great things; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to grow up; 1a2) to become great; 1a3) to be magnified; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to cause to grow; 1b2) to make great, powerful; 1b3) to magnify; 1c) (Pual) to be brought up; 1d) (Hiphil); 1d1) to make great; 1d2) to magnify; 1d3) to do great things; 1e) (Hithpael) to magnify oneself
גדל.grammar_note: a primitive root; properly, to twist (compare H1434 (גְּדִל)), i.e.

גדליה.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Ezr.10.18; § Gedaliah = "Jehovah is great"; 1) son of Ahikam, the governor of Judea appointed by Nebuchadnezzar; 2) son of Amariah and grandson of Hezekiah; 3) a priest of the sons of Jeshua in the time of Ezra
גדליה.grammar_note: or (prolonged) גְּדַלְיָהוּ; from H1431 (גָּדַל) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has become great;

גדלתי.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.25.4; ; son of: Heman (H1968I); ; brother of: Bukkiah (H1232), Mattaniah (H4983H), Uzziel (H5816J), Shebuel (H7619H), Jerimoth (H3406L), Hananiah (H2608P), Hanani (H2607H), Eliathah (H0448), Romamti-ezer (H7320), Joshbekashah (H3436), Mallothi (H4413), Hothir (H1956), Mahazioth (H4238) ; § Giddalti = "I make great"; one of the sons of Heman, the king's seer;
גדלתי.grammar_note: from H1431 (גָּדַל); I have made great;

גדע.definition: 1) to cut, hew, chop, cut down, hew down, hew off, cut off, cut in two, shave off; 1a) (Qal) to hew, chop in two; 1b) (Niphal) to be chopped off, be hewn off; 1c) (Piel) to cut off or down in two, hew off or down in two; 1d) (Pual) to chop down, hew down

גדעון.definition: A Judge living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jdg.6.11; ; son of: Joash (H3101); ; father of: Jether (H3500), Abimelech (H0040H) and Jotham (H3147); also called Jerubbaal at Jdg.6.32; 7.1; 8.29,35; 9.1,2,5,16,19,24,28,57; 1xJerubbesheth at 2Sa.11.21; ; § Gideon = "hewer"; youngest son of Joash of the Abiezrites, fifth judge of Israel who led the Israelites against the Midianites;

גדעם.definition: ; § Gidom = "a cutting down"; the place where the Israelites ceased pursuing Benjamin, apparently situated between Gibeah and the cliffs of Rimmon;

גדעני.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.1.11; ; father of: Abidan (H0027) ; § Gideoni = "my hewer"; a Benjamite, father of Abidan;

גדף.definition: 1) to revile men, blaspheme God; 1a) (Piel); 1a1) to revile (between men); 1a2) to blaspheme (God)

גדר.definition: 1) to wall up, wall off, close off, build a wall; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to wall up, shut off; 1a2) masons (participle)

גדרות.definition: ; § Gederoth = "walls"; a town in the low country of Judah;

גדרי.definition: ; Group of ge.de.rah (גְּדֵרָה "Gederah" H1449) ; § Gederite = "a wall"; an inhabitant of Geder;

גדרתי.definition: Gederathite = "a wall"; an inhabitant of Gederah; Another spelling of ge.de.rah (גְּדֵרָה "Gederah" H1449)

גדרתים.definition: ; § Gederothaim = "two walls"; a town in the low country of Judah;

גה.definition: this, such; Aramaic equivalent: da (דָּא "this" H1668)
גה.grammar_note: probably a clerical error for H2088 (זֶה);

גהה.definition: 1) (Qal) to depart; 1a) to be cured, healed (meton)

גו.definition: midst, the midst; Aramaic of gev (גֵּו "midst" H1460B)

גוב.definition: locusts; Another spelling of gi.vay (גֹּבַי "locust" H1462B)

גוג.definition: A man of the tribe of Reuben living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at 1Ch.5.4; ; son of: Shemaiah (H8098D); ; father of: Shimei (H8096L); § Gog = "mountain"; 1) a Reubenite, son of Shemaiah; 2) the prophetic prince of Rosh, Meshech and Tubal, and Magog

גוה.definition: pride, a lifting up; Aramaic equivalent: ge.vah (גֵּוָה "pride" H1467)

גוז.definition: 1) to pass over, pass away; 1a) (Qal) to pass away (of life); 2) (TWOT) to bring, cut off

גוזל.grammar_note: or (shortened) גֹזָלlemma גזָל missing vowel, corrected to גֹזָל; from H1497 (גָּזַל);

גוזן.definition: ; § Gozan = "a cutting off"; the Mesopotamian city on or near the middle of the Euphrates where exiled Israelites were settled;
גוזן.grammar_note: probably from H1468 (גּוּז); a quarry (as a place of cutting stones);

גוי.definition: 1) nation, people; 1a) nation, people; 1a1) usually of non-Hebrew people; 1a2) of descendants of Abraham; 1a3) of Israel; 1b) of swarm of locusts, other animals (fig.); 1c) Goyim? = "nations"; Also named: ethnos (ἔθνος "Gentiles" G1484)
גוי.grammar_note: rarely (shortened) גֹּי; apparently from the same root as H1465 (גֵּוָה) (in the sense of massing);

גויה.definition: 1) a body (of living creatures); 2) a corpse, carcass, dead body

גולה.definition: 1) exiles, exile, captivity; 1a) exiles (coll); 1b) exile, captivity (abstract)
גולה.grammar_note: or (shortened) גֹּלָה; active participle feminine of H1540 (גָּלָה);

גולן.definition: ; § Golan = "their captivity: their rejoicing"; a town of Manasseh in the heights of Bashan east of the Jordan; a city of refuge;

גוני.definition: A man of the tribe of Naphtali living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.24; ; son of: Naphtali (H5321); ; brother of: Jahzeel (H3183), Jezer (H3337) and Shillem (H8006); Also named: gu.ni (גּוּנִי "Gunite" H1477); § Guni = "my defender (?)"; 1) a son of Naphtali and founder of the family of Gunites; 2) a descendant of Gad

גוע.definition: 1) to expire, die, perish, give up the ghost, yield up the ghost, be dead, be ready to die; 1a) (Qal) to expire, die, be about to die

גור.definition: 1) to sojourn, abide, dwell in, dwell with, remain, inhabit, be a stranger, be continuing, surely; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to sojourn, dwell for a time; 1a2) to abide, stay, temporarily dwell; 1b) (Hithpolel); 1b1) to seek hospitality with; 1b2) to assemble oneself

גורבעל.definition: ; § Gur-baal = "dwelling of Baal"; a place in which dwelt Arabians; probably lying between Palestine and the Arabian peninsula;
גורבעל.grammar_note: from H1481 (גּוּר) and H1168 (בַּעַל); dwelling of Baal;

גורל.definition: 1) lot; 1a) lot-pebbles used for systematically making decisions; 2) portion; 2a) lot, portion (thing assigned by casting lots); 2b) recompense, retribution
גורל.grammar_note: or (shortened) גֹּרָל; from an unused root meaning to be rough (as stone);

גוש.grammar_note: or rather (by permutation) גִּישׁ; of uncertain derivation;

גז.definition: 1) a shearing, mowing; 1a) shearing, that sheared off; 1b) a mowing, mown grass

גזה.definition: 1) to cut, cut off, sever; 1a) (Qal) he that severed (participle)

גזוני.definition: Someone descended from Gizon(?), only mentioned at 1Ch.11.34 ; § Gizonite = "shearer: quarryman"; a descendant from or inhabitant of Gizon (otherwise unknown);
גזוני.grammar_note: patrial from the unused name of a place apparently in Palestine;

גזז.definition: 1) to shear, mow; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to shear; 1a2) shearer (participle); 1b) (Niphal) to be cut off, be destroyed

גזל.definition: 1) to tear away, seize, plunder, tear off, pull off, rob, take away by force; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to tear away, rob; 1a2) to seize, plunder (with acc cognate); 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be robbed; 1b2) to be taken away

גזלה.grammar_note: feminine of H1498 (גָּזֵל) and mean the same

גזם.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to devour;

גזע.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to cut down (trees);

גזר.definition: 1) to cut, divide, cut down, cut off, cut in two, snatch, decree; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to cut in two, divide; 1a2) to cut down; 1a3) to cut off, destroy, exterminate; 1a4) to decree; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be cut off, separated, excluded; 1b2) to be destroyed, cut off; 1b3) to be decreed

גזרה.definition: 1) a cutting, polishing, separation; 1a) cutting, polishing; 1b) separation, separate place

גזרי.definition: Someone descended from Girzit(?), only mentioned at 1Sa.27.8 ; § Gezrites = "a piece: a portion (as cut off)"; 1) inhabitants of Gezer; Gerizites = "the cutters off"; 2) inhabitants of Mt Gerizim?;
גזרי.grammar_note: (in the m patrial from H1507 (גֶּזֶר); a Gezerite (collectively) or inhabitants of Gezer; but better (as in the text) bytransposition גִּזְרִיxlit Girzîy corrected to Gizrîy; patrial of H1630 (גְּרִזִים);

גחון.grammar_note: probably from H1518 (גִּיחַ)lemma גּיחַ missing vowel, corrected to גִּיחַ; (compare H1521 (גִּיחוֹן))

גחל.grammar_note: or (feminine) גַּחֶלֶת; from an unused root meaning to glow or kindle;

גחם.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, only mentioned at Gen.22.24; ; son of: Nahor (H5152H) and Reumah (H7208); ; brother of: Tebah (H2875), Tahash (H8477) and Maacah (H4601); ; half-brother of: Uz (H5780H), Buz (H0938), Kemuel (H7055), Chesed (H3777), Hazo (H2375), Pildash (H6394), Jidlaph (H3044) and Bethuel (H1328A) ; § Gaham = "burning"; a son of Abraham's brother Nahor and his concubine Reumah;
גחם.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to burn; flame;

גחר.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.47 ; § Gahar = "hiding place"; the head of a family of temple slaves returning from exile with Zerubbabel;
גחר.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to hide; lurker;

גיא.definition: valley, a steep valley, narrow gorge; Combined with yiph.tach-el (יִפְתַּח־אֵל " of Iphtahel" H3317)
גיא.grammar_note: or (shortened) גַּי; probably (by transmutation) from the same root as H1466 (גֵּוָה) (abbreviated);

גיח.definition: 1) to burst forth; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to burst forth; 1a2) to draw forth; 1a3) to bring forth; 1b) (Hiphil) to break forth; Aramaic equivalent: gi.ach (גִּיחַ "to strive" H1519)

גיחון.definition: ; § Gihon = "bursting forth"; one of the four rivers of the Garden of Eden
גיחון.grammar_note: or (shortened) גִּחוֹן; from H1518 (גִּיחַ)lemma גּיחַ missing vowel, corrected to גִּיחַ; stream;

גיחזי.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.4.12 ; § Gehazi = "valley of vision"; the servant of Elisha;
גיחזי.grammar_note: or גֵּחֲזִי; apparently from H1516 (גַּיְא) and H2372 (חָזָה); valley of a visionary;

גיל.definition: 1) to rejoice, exult, be glad; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to rejoice; 1a2) to tremble (from fear)
גיל.grammar_note: or (by permutation) גּוּל; a primitive root;

גילני.definition: ; Group of gi.loh (גִּלֹה "Giloh" H1542) ; § Gilonite = "gentilic of preceding"; an inhabitant of Giloh;

גינת.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.16.21; ; father of: Tibni (H8402) ; § Ginath = "protection"; father of Tibni;

גיר.definition: chalk, plaster; Aramaic of gir (גִּר "chalk" H1615)

גישן.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.2.47; ; son of Caleb (H3612H) and Jahdai (H3056); ; brother of: Regem (H7276), Jotham (H3147I), Pelet (H6404), Ephah (H5891I) and Shaaph (H8174) ; § Geshan = "lump"; one of the sons of Jahdai, in the genealogy of Judah, in the family of Caleb;
גישן.grammar_note: from the same as H1487 (גּוּשׁ); lumpish;

גל.definition: : heap/pile; 1) heap, spring, wave, billow; 1a) heap (of stones); 1a1) over dead body; 1a2) alone; 1a3) used in ratifying a covenant; 1b) waves (fig. of chastisement of Jehovah); 1c) spring; Also means: gal (גַּל ": wave" H1530H)

גלב.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to shave;

גלבע.definition: ; § Gilboa = "swollen heap"; a mountain-ridge at the southeastern end of the plain of Jezreel, site of the death of Saul and Jonathan
גלבע.grammar_note: from H1530 (גַּל) and H1158 (בָּעָה); fountain of ebullition;

גלגל.definition: 1) wheel, whirl, whirlwind, whirling; 1a) wheel; 1b) whirl (of dust, chaff); Aramaic equivalent: gal.gal (גַּלְגַּל "wheel" H1535)

גלגלת.definition: 1) head, poll, skull; 1a) skull; 1b) head, poll (of census)

גלד.grammar_note: from an unused root probably meaning to polish;

גלות.definition: 1) exile, exiles; 2) (TWOT) captivity; Aramaic equivalent: ga.lut (גָּלוּ "captivity" H1547)

גלח.definition: 1) to poll, shave, shave off, be bald; 1a) (Piel); 1a1) to shave; 1a2) to shave off; 1a3) (fig. of devastation); 1b)(Pual) to be shaven; 1c) (Hithpael) to shave oneself

גליון.definition: table, tablet, mirror, flat shiny ornament

גליל.definition: 1) cylinder, rod; 2) circuit, district (on northern border in Naphtali)

גלילות.definition: Geliloth = "circuits"; a place on Judah and Benjamin's border; Another name of gil.gal (גִּלְגָּל "Gilgal" H1537G)

גלים.definition: ; § Gallim = "springs"; a place north of Jerusalem, home town of the man to whom Michal, Saul's daughter, David's wife, was given as wife by Saul even though she was already married to David;

גלית.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.17.4; ; son of: Rapha (H7497A); ; brother of: Ishbi-benob (H3430), Saph (H5593), Lahmi (H3902), huge_man (H4060A) ; § Goliath = "splendour"; the Philistine giant of Gath slain by David's sling;

גללי.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.12.36; ; son of: Jonathan (H3129K); ; brother of: Zechariah (H2148Z), Shemaiah (H8098V), Azarel (H5832J), Milalai (H4450), Maai (H4597), Nethanel (H5417P), Judah (H3063K) and Hanani (H2607K) ; § Gilalai "weighty"; a Levitical musician, one of the priest's sons at the consecration of the wall of Jerusalem;

גלם.definition: (Qal) to wrap up, fold, fold together

גלמוד.definition: 1) hard, barren, harsh, bleak; 1a) harsh, bleak (of a company of wicked men); 1b) barren (of women)

גלע.definition: 1) to expose, lay bare; 1a) (Hithpael); 1a1) to disclose oneself, break out; 1a2) to break out (in contention)

גלעד.definition: Galeed = "witness heap"; the pile of stones heaped up between Jacob and Laban to certify their covenant; located on Mt Gilead; Another name of ra.mot gi.l.ad (רָמֹת "Ramoth" H7433)
גלעד.grammar_note: from H1530 (גַּל) and H5707 (עֵד); heap of testimony;

גלעדי.definition: Someone from Gilead; Group of gil.ad (גִּלְעָד "Gilead" H1568) ; § Gileadite = "rocky region" ; 1) an inhabitant of Gilead - ; 2) a branch of the tribe of Manasseh, descended of Gilead

גלש.definition: 1) to sit, sit up, (possibly also) recline; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) of flocks of goats; 1a2) of a woman's hair (simile)

גם.definition: 1) also, even, indeed, moreover, yea; 1a) also, moreover (giving emphasis); 1b) neither, neither...nor (with negative); 1c) even (for stress); 1d) indeed, yea (introducing climax); 1e) also (of correspondence or retribution); 1f) but, yet, though (adversative); 1g) even, yea, yea though (with 'when' in hypothetical case); 2) (TWOT) again, alike

גמא.definition: 1) to swallow (liquids); 1a) (Piel) to swallow; 1b) (Hiphil) to drink
גמא.grammar_note: a primitive root (literally or figuratively) to absorb

גמד.definition: 1) cubit; 2) (CLBL) half-cubit-the measure between a cubit and a span-9 in (20 cm)
גמד.grammar_note: from an unused root apparently meaning to grasp;

גמול.definition: 1) dealing, recompense, benefit; 1a) dealing (of one's hand); 1b) recompense; 1c) benefit

גמזו.definition: ; § Gimzo = "fertile in sycamores"; a town in Judah south of the road between Jerusalem and Joppa which with its dependant villages was captured by the Philistines in the reign of Ahaz;

גמל.definition: 1) to deal fully with, recompense; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to deal out to, do to; 1a2) to deal bountifully with; 1a3) to recompense, repay, requite; 2) (Qal) to wean a child (Niphal) to be weaned; 3) (Qal) to ripen, bear ripe (almonds)

גמלי.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.13.12; ; father of: Ammiel (H5988) ; § Gemalli = "camel driver"; the father of Ammiel, the Danite spy;

גמליאל.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.1.10; ; son of: Pedahzur (H6301) ; § Gamaliel = "reward of God"; son of Pedahzur and the leader of the tribe of Manasseh in the wilderness;
גמליאל.grammar_note: from H1580 (גָּמַל) and H410 (אֵל); reward of God;

גמר.definition: 1) to end, come to an end, complete, cease; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to come to an end, be no more; 1a2) to bring to an end, complete; 2) (TWOT) to fail, perfect, perform; Aramaic equivalent: ge.mar (גְּמַר "to complete" H1585)

גמריה.definition: Gemarjah, the name of two Israelites
גמריה.grammar_note: or גְּמַרְיָהוּ; from H1584 (גָּמַר) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has perfected;

גן.definition: 1) garden, enclosure; 1a) enclosed garden; 1a1) (fig. of a bride); 1b) garden (of plants); 1c) Garden of Eden

גנב.definition: 1) to steal, steal away, carry away; 1a) (Qal) to steal; 1b) (Niphal) to be stolen; 1c) (Piel) to steal away; 1d)(Pual) to be stolen away, be brought by stealth; 1e) (Hithpael) to go by stealth, steal away

גנז.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to store;

גנן.definition: 1) to defend, cover, surround; 1a) (Qal) to defend; 1b) (Hiphil) to defend
