ישראלי.definition: Someone descended from Ishmael who was a man of Arabia living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.16.11; ; son of: Abraham (H0085) and Hagar (H1904); ; half-brother of: Isaac (H3327), Zimran (H2175), Jokshan (H3370), Medan (H4091), Midian (H4080), Ishbak (H3435) and Shuah (H7744); ; father of: Nebaioth (H5032), Kedar (H6938), Adbeel (H0110), Mibsam (H4017), Mishma (H4927), Dumah (H1746), Massa (H4854), Hadad (H2301), Tema (H8485), Jetur (H3195), Naphish (H5305), Kedemah (H6929) and Mahalath (H4258); Group of yish.ma.el (יִשְׁמָעֵאל "Ishmael" H3458); § Israelite , of Israel "God prevails"; a descendant or inhabitant of the nation of Israel

ישראלית.definition: An Israelitess , of Israel "God prevails"; a female descendant or inhabitant of the nation of Israel; Group of yis.ra.el (יִשְׂרָאֵל "Israel" H3478)

ישרון.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.25.26; ; son of: Isaac (H3327) and Rebekah (H7259); ; brother of: Esau (H6215); married to Rachel (H7354), Leah (H3812), Zilpah (H2153) and Bilhah (H1090A); ; father of: Reuben (H7205), Simeon (H8095), Levi (H3878), Judah (H3063), Dan (H1835H), Naphtali (H5321), Gad (H1410), Asher (H0836), Issachar (H3485), Zebulun (H2074), Dinah (H1783), Joseph (H3130) and Benjamin (H1144); also called Jacob frequently; Another name of yis.ra.el (יִשְׂרָאֵל "Israel" H3478) ; § Jeshurun = "upright one"; a symbolic name for Israel describing her ideal character;

יששכר.definition: A man of the tribe of Issachar living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.30.18; ; son of: Israel (H3478) and Leah (H3812); ; brother of: Reuben (H7205), Simeon (H8095), Levi (H3878), Judah (H3063), Zebulun (H2074) and Dinah (H1783); ; half-brother of: Dan (H1835H), Naphtali (H5321), Gad (H1410), Asher (H0836), Joseph (H3130) and Benjamin (H1144); ; father of: Tola (H8439), Puah (H6312), Jashub (H3437H) and Shimron (H8110B); Also named: Isachar (Ἰσαχάρ "Issachar" G2466); § Issachar = "there is recompense"; 1) the 9th son of Jacob and the 5th by Leah his first wife and the progenitor of a tribe by his name; 2) a Korahite Levite and the 7th son of Obed-edom and doorkeeper to the temple; 3) the tribe descended from Issachar the son of Jacob; 4) the territory allocated to the descendants of Issachar when they entered the land of Canaan
יששכר.grammar_note: (strictly yis-saws-kawr'); from H5375 (נָשָׂא) and H7939 (שָׂכָר); he will bring a reward;

ישש.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to blanch;

ית.definition: (mark of the direct object or the accusative and not translated); Aramaic of et (אֵת "[Obj.]" H0853)

יתב.definition: 1) to sit, dwell; 1a) (P'al) to sit, be seated; 1b) (Aphel) to cause to dwell
יתב.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √yṯb 'to sit, dwell'. Aramaic cognate of Hebrew ישב.

יתד.definition: 1) pin, stake, peg, nail; 1a) pin, peg, tent pin, tent stake; 1b) nail, pin (fig.); 1c) pin (used in weaving)
יתד.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to pin through or fast;

יתום.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to be lonely;

יתור.definition: 1) to remain over, leave, range over; 2) (BDB) a searching (n m)

יתיר.definition: adj; 1) pre-eminent, surpassing, extreme, extraordinary; adv; 2) exceedingly, extremely

יתלה.definition: ; § Jethlah = "he hangs"; one of the towns in southern Dan;
יתלה.grammar_note: probably from H8518 (תָּלָה); it will hang, i.e. be high;

יתמה.definition: A man of the Moabites living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.11.46 ; § Ithmah = "orphan"; a Moabite, one of David's mighty warriors;
יתמה.grammar_note: from the same as H3490 (יָתוֹם); orphanage;

יתניאל.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.26.2; ; son of: Meshelemiah (H4920); ; brother of: Zechariah (H2148A), Jediael (H3043J), Zebadiah (H2069J), Elam (H5867H), Jehohanan (H3076I) and Eliehoenai (H0454A) ; § Jathniel = "God hires me"; a Korhite Levite and the 4th of the family of Meshelemiah;
יתניאל.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to endure, and H410 (אֵל); continued of God;

יתנן.definition: ; § Ithnan = "hire"; one of the towns in the extreme south of Judah;
יתנן.grammar_note: from the same as H8577 (תַּנִּין); extensive;

יתר.definition: 1) to be left over, remain, remain over, leave; 1a) (Qal) remainder (participle); 1b) (Niphal) to be left over, remain over, be left behind; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to leave over, leave; 1c2) to save over, preserve alive; 1c3) to excel, show pre-eminence; 1c4) to show excess, have more than enough, have an excess

יתרא.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.17.25; married to Abigail (H0026H); ; father of: Amasa (H6021); also called Ithra at 2Sa.17.25;; Another name of ye.ter (יֶ֫תֶר "Jether" H3500H) ; § Ithra = "abundance"; father of Amasa, the commander of Absalom's army; also 'Jether';

יתרו.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.2.18; ; father of: Zipporah (H6855) and Hobab (H2246); also called Reuel (KJV: Raguel) at Num.10.29; ; § Jethro = "his abundance"; father-in-law of Moses; also 'Jether';
יתרו.grammar_note: from H3499 (יֶתֶר) with pron. suffix; his excellence;

יתרי.definition: Someone descended from Ithar(?), first mentioned at 2Sa.23.38 ; § Ithrite = "a remnant: excellence"; a descendant of Jether;

יתרן.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.36.26; ; son of: Dishon (H1787); ; brother of: Hemdan (H2533), Eshban (H0790) and Cheran (H3763); § Ithran = "advantage"; 1) an Edomite, son of Dishon, a Horite, and probably a phylarch of a tribe of the Horim; 2) an descendant of Asher

יתרעם.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.3.5; ; son of: David (H1732) and Eglah (H5698); ; half-brother of: Amnon (H0550), Chileab (H3609), Absalom (H0053), Adonijah (H0138), Shephatiah (H8203), Shammua (H8051H), Shobab (H7727), Nathan (H5416), Solomon (H8010), Ibhar (H2984), Elishua (H0474), Nepheg (H5298H), Japhia (H3309I), Elishama (H0476H), Eliada (H0450), Eliphelet (H0467), Tamar (H8559H), Elpelet (H0467I), Nogah (H5052) and Jerimoth (H3406N) ; § Ithream = "profit of the people"; a son of David by his wife Eglah; the 6th son and born in Hebron;
יתרעם.grammar_note: from H3499 (יֶתֶר) and H5971 (עַם); excellence of people;

יתרת.definition: appendage, overhang, protrusion, the caudate lobe of the liver of a sacrificial animal

יתת.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.36.40 ; § Jetheth = "a nail"; one of the dukes of Edom who came of Esau;

כאב.definition: 1) to be in pain, be sore, have pain, be sorrowful; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be in pain (physical); 1a2) to be in pain (mental); 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to cause pain, hurt, mar; 1b2) pain, mar (participle)

כאה.definition: 1) to be sad, be disheartened ; 1a) (Niphal) to be disheartened, be cowed; 1b) (Hiphil) to make sad

כבד.definition: : dull/dim(hearing/eyesight); 1) to be heavy, be weighty, be grievous, be hard, be rich, be honourable, be glorious, be burdensome, be honoured; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be heavy; 1a2) to be heavy, be insensible, be dull; 1a3) to be honoured; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be made heavy, be honoured, enjoy honour, be made abundant; 1b2) to get oneself glory or honour, gain glory; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to make heavy, make dull, make insensible; 1c2) to make honourable, honour, glorify; 1d) (Pual) to be made honourable, be honoured; 1e) (Hiphil); 1e1) to make heavy; 1e2) to make heavy, make dull, make unresponsive; 1e3) to cause to be honoured; 1f) (Hithpael); 1f1) to make oneself heavy, make oneself dense, make oneself numerous; 1f2) to honour oneself

כבה.definition: 1) to quench, put out, be put out, be quenched, be extinguished; 1a) (Qal) to be quenched, be extinguished; 1b) (Piel) to quench, extinguish

כבוד.definition: 1) glory, honour, glorious, abundance; 1a) abundance, riches; 1b) honour, splendour, glory; 1c) honour, dignity; 1d) honour, reputation; 1e) honour, reverence, glory; 1f) glory

כבודה.grammar_note: irregular feminine passive participle of H3513 (כָּבַד);

כבול.definition: ; § Cabul = "binding"; a city on the border of Asher and located approx 10 miles (16 km) east of Akko; modern 'Kabul'
כבול.grammar_note: from the same as H3525 (כֶּבֶל) in the sense of limitation; sterile;

כבון.definition: ; § Cabbon = "the builder"; a town in the low country of Judah;
כבון.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to heap up; hilly;

כביר.definition: (something) netted, a quilt, fly net, pillow
כביר.grammar_note: from H3527 (כָּבַר) in the original sense of plaiting;

כבל.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to twine or braid together;

כבס.definition: 1) to wash (by treading), be washed, perform the work of a fuller; 1a) (Qal) washer, fuller, treader (participle); 1b) (Piel) to wash (garments, person); 1c) (Pual) to be washed; 1d) (Hothpael) to be washed out

כבר.definition: 1) to be much, be many, be in abundance, intertwine, multiply; 1a) (Hiphil) to make many, make great

כבש.definition: 1) to subject, subdue, force, keep under, bring into bondage; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to bring into bondage, make subservient; 1a2) to subdue, force, violate; 1a3) to subdue, dominate, tread down; 1b) (Niphal) to be subdued; 1c) (Piel) to subdue; 1d) (Hiphil) to bring into bondage
כבש.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to dominate;

כבשן.definition: kiln (pottery or lime), smelting forge, furnace

כד.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to deepen;

כדב.grammar_note: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H3576 (כָּזַב);

כדכד.grammar_note: from the same as H3537 (כַּד) in the sense of striking fire from a metal forged;

כדרלעמר.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.14.1 ; § Chedorlaomer = "handful of sheaves"; the king of Elam defeated by Abraham;

כה.definition: 1) thus, here, in this manner; 1a) thus, so; 1b) here, here and there; 1c) until now, until now...until then, meanwhile; Aramaic equivalent: kah (כָּה "thus" H3542)
כה.grammar_note: from the prefix k and H1931 (הוּא);

כהה.definition: 1) to grow weak, grow dim, grow faint, falter, be weak, be dim, be darkened, be restrained, be faint, fail; 1a) (Qal) to grow dim; 1b) (Piel) to faint, grow weak, grow faint

כהל.definition: 1) to be able; 1a) (P'al) to be able
כהל.grammar_note: (Aramaic) a root corresponding to and H3557 (כּוּל);

כהן.definition: 1) priest, principal officer or chief ruler; 1a) priest-king (Melchizedek, Messiah); 1b) pagan priests; 1c) priests of Jehovah; 1d) Levitical priests; 1e) Zadokite priests; 1f) Aaronic priests; 1g) the high priest; Aramaic equivalent: ka.hen (כָּהֵן "priest" H3549)
כהן.grammar_note: a primitive root, apparently meaning to mediate in religious services; but used only as denominative from H3548 (כֹּהֵן);

כו.grammar_note: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H3854 (לַהַג) in the sense of piercing;

כוב.definition: probably located in northern Africa; maybe same as 'Lybia' or 'Lub'; Another spelling of lu.vi (לוּב "Libyan" H3864)

כובע.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to be high or rounded;

כוה.definition: 1) to burn, scorch, brand; 1a) (Niphal) to be burned, be scorched

כוכב.definition: 1) star; 1a) of Messiah, brothers, youth, numerous progeny, personification, God's omniscience (fig.)
כוכב.grammar_note: probably from the same as H3522 (כַּבּוֹן) (in the sense of rolling) or H3554 (כָּוָה) (in the sense of blazing);

כול.definition: 1) to seize, contain, measure; 1a)(Qal) to measure, calculate; 1b) (Pilpel) to sustain, maintain, contain; 1b1) to sustain, support, nourish; 1b2) to contain, hold in, restrain; 1b3) to support, endure; 1c) (Polpal) to be supplied; 1d) (Hilpil) to contain, hold, hold in, endure; 1d1) to contain; 1d2) to sustain, endure

כומז.definition: 1) ornaments, golden ornament; 1a) maybe-armlets of gold, exact meaning not known; 2) (TWOT) tablets
כומז.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to store away;

כון.definition: : make/found/restore; 1) to be firm, be stable, be established; 1a) (Niphal); 1a1) to be set up, be established, be fixed; 1a1a) to be firmly established; 1a1b) to be established, be stable, be secure, be enduring; 1a1c) to be fixed, be securely determined; 1a2) to be directed aright, be fixed aright, be steadfast (moral sense); 1a3) to prepare, be ready; 1a4) to be prepared, be arranged, be settled; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to establish, set up, accomplish, do, make firm; 1b2) to fix, make ready, prepare, provide, provide for, furnish; 1b3) to direct toward (moral sense); 1b4) to arrange, order; 1c) (Hophal); 1c1) to be established, be fastened; 1c2) to be prepared, be ready; 1d) (Polel); 1d1) to set up, establish; 1d2) to constitute, make; 1d3) to fix; 1d4) to direct; 1e) (Pulal) to be established, be prepared; 1f) (Hithpolel) to be established, be restored

כונניהו.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ch.31.12; ; brother of: Shimei (H8096Q) ; § Cononiah or Conaniah = "Jehovah has established"; 1) a Levite ruler in the time of Hezekiah; 2) a Levite chief in the time of Josiah;
כונניהו.grammar_note: from H3559 (כּוּן) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has sustained;

כוס.definition: a kind of owl (an unclean bird)
כוס.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to hold together;

כור.definition: 1) kor, a measure (usually dry); 1a) a dry or liquid measure equal to 10 ephahs or baths; 1a1) a dry measure containing 6.25 bushels (220 l); 1a2) a liquid measure of 58 gallons (263 l)
כור.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning properly, to dig through;

כור עשן.grammar_note: from H3564 (כּוּר) and H6227 (עָשָׁן); furnace of smoke;

כורש.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ch.36.22; ; son of: Gedaliah (H1436H); Also named: ko.resh (כּ֫וֹרֶשׁ "Cyrus" H3567) ; § Cyrus = "posses thou the furnace"; the king of Persia and conqueror of Babylon; first ruler of Persia to make a decree allowing the Israelite exiles to return to Jerusalem;
כורש.grammar_note: or (Ezra 1:1 (last time),2) כֹּרֶשׁ; from the Persians;

כוש.definition: ; § Cush = "black"; the land occupied by the descendants of Cush located around the southern parts of the Nile (Ethiopia)

כושי.definition: Someone from Ethiopia; Group of kush (כּוּשׁ "Ethiopia" H3568H); § Cushi or Ethiopian, of Cush "their blackness"; inhabitant of Ethiopia, land of one of the descendants of Cush the grandson of Noah

כושית.definition: A woman from Cush woman, Moses' wife so-called by Miriam and Aaron; Group of kush (כּוּשׁ "Cush" H3568A)

כושן.definition: ; § Cushan = "their blackness"; a place in Arabia or Mesopotamia;

כושן רשעתים.definition: A man living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jdg.3.8 ; § Chushan-rishathaim = "twice-wicked Cushan"; a king of Mesopotamia defeated by the judge Othniel the son-in-law of Caleb;
כושן רשעתים.grammar_note: apparently from H3572 (כּוּשָׁן) and the dual of H7564 (רִשְׁעָה); Cushan of double wickedness;

כות.definition: Cuth or Cuthah, a province of Assyria

כזב.definition: 1) to lie, tell a lie, be a liar, be found a liar, be in vain, fail; 1a) (Qal) liar (participle); 1b) (Niphal) to be proven to be lying; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to lie, tell a lie, tell a lie with, deceive; 1c2) to disappoint, fail; 1d) (Hiphil) to make a liar, prove to be a liar

כזבא.definition: Chozeba = "falsehood"; a city in Judah; Another name of akh.ziv (אַכְזִיב "Achzib" H0392G)

כזבי.definition: A woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.25.15; ; daughter of: Zur (H6698) ; § Cozbi = "my lie"; a daughter of Zur, a chief of the Midianites, who was slain by Phinehas because of her adultery;

כזיב.definition: Chezib = "false"; a town in Judah; Another name of akh.ziv (אַכְזִיב "Achzib" H0392G)

כח.definition: 1) strength, power, might; 1a) human strength; 1b) strength (of angels); 1c) power (of God); 1d) strength (of animals); 1e) strength, produce, wealth (of soil)
כח.grammar_note: or (Daniel 11:6) כּוֹחַ; from an unused root meaning to be firm;

כחד.definition: 1) to hide, conceal, cut off, cut down, make desolate, kick; 1a) (Niphal); 1a1) to be hidden; 1a2) to be effaced, be destroyed, be cut off; 1b) (Piel) to cover, hide; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to hide; 1c2) to efface, annihilate

כחש.definition: 1) to deceive, lie, fail, grow lean, be disappointing, be untrue, be insufficient, be found liars, belie, deny, dissemble, deal falsely; 1a) (Qal) to become lean; 1b) (Niphal) to cringe, feign obedience; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to deceive, deny falsely; 1c2) to act deceptively; 1c3) to cringe; 1c4) to disappoint, fail; 1d) (Hithpael) to cringe, feign obedience

כי.definition: 1) that, for, because, when, as though, as, because that, but, then, certainly, except, surely, since; 1a) that; 1a1) yea, indeed; 1b) when (of time); 1b1) when, if, though (with a concessive force); 1c) because, since (causal connection); 1d) but (after negative); 1e) that if, for if, indeed if, for though, but if; 1f) but rather, but; 1g) except that; 1h) only, nevertheless; 1i) surely; 1j) that is; 1k) but if; 1l) for though; 1m) forasmuch as, for therefore
כי.usage: 1. because: כִּי טוֹב; 2. that: יָדַעְתִּי כִּי; 3. when: כִּי תָבֹא; 4. emphatic: כִּי הוּא

כיד.grammar_note: from a primitive root meaning to strike;

כידוד.grammar_note: from the same as H3589 (כִּיד) (compare H3539 (כַּדְכֹּד));

כידון.definition: 1) javelin, short sword, dart; 2) gorget, a piece of armour for the throat (1Sa 17.6)
כידון.grammar_note: from the same as H3589 (כִּיד); (perhaps smaller than H2595 (חֲנִית)lemma חֲניִת second vowel, corrected to חֲנִית)

כיון.definition: ; § Chiun = "an image" or "pillar"; probably a statue of the Assyrian-Babylonian god of the planet Saturn and used to symbolise Israelite apostasy;

כיור.definition: properly, something round (as excavated or bored), i.e. a chafing-dish forcoals or a caldron forcooking; hence (from similarity of form) a washbowl; also (for the same reason) a pulpit or platform
כיור.grammar_note: or כִּיֹּר; from the same as H3564 (כּוּר);

כילי.grammar_note: or כֵּלַי; from H3557 (כּוּל) in the sense of withholding;

כילף.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to clap or strike with noise;

כימה.definition: Pleiades, a constellation of seven stars;

כיר.definition: 1) pot, basin, laver, pan; 1a) pot, caldron; 1b) fire-pot, brazier; 1c) basin, laver; 1d) platform, stage
כיר.grammar_note: a form for H3564 (כּוּר) (only in the dual);

ככר.definition: 1) round; 1a) a round district (environs of the Jordan valley); 1b) a round loaf (of bread); 1c) a round weight, talent (of gold, silver, bronze, iron); Aramaic equivalent: kik.ker (כִּכֵּר "talent" H3604)

כל.definition: 1) all, the whole; 1a) all, the whole of; 1b) any, each, every, anything; 1c) totality, everything; Aramaic equivalent: kol (כֹּל "all" H3606)

כלא.definition: 1) to restrict, restrain, withhold, shut up, keep back, refrain, forbid; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to shut up; 1a2) to restrain; 1a3) to withhold; 1b) (Niphal) to be restrained; 1c) (Piel) to finish

כלאב.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.3.3; ; son of: David (H1732) and Abigail (H0026); ; half-brother of: Amnon (H0550), Absalom (H0053), Adonijah (H0138), Shephatiah (H8203), Ithream (H3507), Shammua (H8051H), Shobab (H7727), Nathan (H5416), Solomon (H8010), Ibhar (H2984), Elishua (H0474), Nepheg (H5298H), Japhia (H3309I), Elishama (H0476H), Eliada (H0450), Eliphelet (H0467), Tamar (H8559H), Elpelet (H0467I), Nogah (H5052) and Jerimoth (H3406N); also called Daniel at 1Ch.3.1; ; Also named: da.niy.yel (דָּנִיֵּאל, דָּנִאֵל "Daniel" H1840H) ; § Chileab = "like his father"; the 2nd son of David, by Abigail;
כלאב.grammar_note: apparently from H3607 (כָּלָא) and H1 (אָב); restraint of (his) father;

כלאים.definition: 1) two kinds, mixture; 1a) forbidden practice among cattle (cross breeding), seeds (sowing), and cloth garments (material)
כלאים.grammar_note: dual of H3608 (כֶּלֶא) in the original sense of separation;

כלב.definition: 1) dog; 1a) dog (literal); 1b) contempt or abasement (fig.); 1c) of pagan sacrifice; 1d) of male cult prostitute (fig.)
כלב.grammar_note: from an unused root means. to yelp, or else to attack;

כלב אפרתה.definition: ; § Caleb-ephratah = "dog or ash heap"; a place in Gilead;

כלבו.grammar_note: probably by erroneous transcription for כָּלֵבִי; patronymically from H3612 (כָּלֵב);

כלה.definition: : decides/determines/longs; 1) to accomplish, cease, consume, determine, end, fail, finish, be complete, be accomplished, be ended, be at an end, be finished, be spent; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be complete, be at an end; 1a2) to be completed, be finished; 1a3) to be accomplished, be fulfilled; 1a4) to be determined, be plotted (bad sense); 1a5) to be spent, be used up; 1a6) to waste away, be exhausted, fail; 1a7) to come to an end, vanish, perish, be destroyed; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to complete, bring to an end, finish; 1b2) to complete (a period of time); 1b3) to finish (doing a thing); 1b4) to make an end, end; 1b5) to accomplish, fulfil, bring to pass; 1b6) to accomplish, determine (in thought); 1b7) to put an end to, cause to cease; 1b8) to cause to fail, exhaust, use up, spend; 1b9) to destroy, exterminate; 1c) (Pual) to be finished, be ended, be completed

כלובי.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at 1Ch.2.9; ; son of: Hezron (H2696H); ; brother of: Ram (H7410), Jerahmeel (H3396), Segub (H7687H) and Ashhur (H0806); married to Azubah (H5806H), Jerioth (H3408), Ephrathah (H0672), Ephah (H5891H) and Maacah (H4601L); ; father of: Hur (H2354), Jesher (H3475), Shobab (H7727H), Ardon (H0715), Mareshah@1Ch.2.42 (H4337), Haran (H2771B), Moza (H4162), Gazez (H1495), Jahdai (H3056), Sheber (H7669), Tirhanah (H8647), Shaaph (H8174H), Sheva (H7724) and Achsah (H5915H); also called Carmi (NIV: Karmi) at 1Ch.4.1(?); Chelubai at 1Ch.2.9; ; Another name of ka.lev (כָּלֵב "Caleb" H3612H) ; § Chelub ai = "my caged one"; son of Hezron of Judah; also 'Caleb';

כלולה.grammar_note: denominative passive participle from H3618 (כַּלָּה)lemma כַּלָה missing dagesh, corrected to כַּלָּה;

כלח.definition: full strength, firm or rugged strength, vigour
כלח.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to be complete;

כלחזה.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.3.15; ; father of: Shallum (H7968); § Col-hozeh = "all-seeing"; father of a repairer of Jerusalem's walls during the time of Nehemiah
כלחזה.grammar_note: from H3605 (כֹּל) and H2374 (חֹזֶה); every seer;

כלי.definition: 1) article, vessel, implement, utensil; 1a) article, object (general); 1b) utensil, implement, apparatus, vessel; 1b1) implement (of hunting or war); 1b2) implement (of music); 1b3) implement, tool (of labour); 1b4) equipment, yoke (of oxen); 1b5) utensils, furniture; 1c) vessel, receptacle (general); 1d) vessels (boats) of paper-reed

כליה.definition: 1) kidneys; 1a) of physical organ (lit.); 1b) of seat of emotion and affection (fig.); 1c) of sacrificial animals; 2) (TWOT) reins
כליה.grammar_note: feminine of H3627 (כְּלִי) (only in the plural);

כליון.definition: 1) completion, destruction, consumption, annihilation; 2) failing, pining

כליל.definition: adj; 1) entire, all, perfect; adv; 2) entirety; subst; 3) whole, whole burnt offering, holocaust, entirety

כלכל.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.4.31; ; son of: Mahol (H4235); ; brother of: Ethan (H0387), Heman (H1968) and Darda (H1862); § Calcol or Chalcol = "sustaining"; son or descendant of Zerah of Judah and one of the wise men with whom Solomon was compared

כלל.definition: 1) to finish, complete; 1a) (Shaphel) to finish; 1b) (Ishtaphel) to be completed

כלם.definition: 1) to insult, shame, humiliate, blush, be ashamed, be put to shame, be reproached, be put to confusion, be humiliated; 1a) (Niphal); 1a1) to be humiliated, be ashamed; 1a2) to be put to shame, be dishonoured, be confounded; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to put to shame, insult, humiliate, cause shame to; 1b2) to exhibit shame; 1c) (Hophal); 1c1) to be insulted, be humiliated; 1c2) to be put to shame, be dishonoured, be confounded

כלמד.definition: ; § Chilmad = "enclosure"; a city of Assyria mentioned in conjunction with Sheba and Asshur;

כלמה.definition: 1) disgrace, reproach, shame, confusion, dishonour, insult, ignominy; 1a) insult, reproach; 1b) reproach, ignominy

כלנה.definition: ; § Calneh or Calno = "fortress of Anu"; a city of Babylonia named among the cities of Nimrod; maybe modern 'Niffer'
כלנה.grammar_note: or כַּלְנֵה; also כַּלְנוֹ; of foreign derivation;

כמה.definition: (Qal) to long for, faint, faint with longing

כמהם.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.19.37 ; § Chimham = "their longing"; 1) a follower and probably a son of Barzillai the Gileadite who returned from beyond Jordan with David; apparently David bestowed on him a possession in Bethlehem on which in later times an inn was standing; 2) apparently the inn in Bethlehem located on the possession given by David to Chimham the follower or son of Barzillai the Gileadite;

כמו.definition: adv; 1) like, as, the like of which; conj; 2) when, according as, as it were

כמוש.definition: ; § Chemosh = "subduer"; the national deity of the Moabites and a god of the Ammonites; also identified with 'Baal-peor', 'Baal-zebub', 'Mars' and 'Saturn'; 1b) worship of this god was introduced into Jerusalem by Solomon and abolished by king Josiah of Judah;
כמוש.grammar_note: or (Jeremiah 48:7) כְּמִישׁ; from an unused root meaning to subdue; the powerful;

כמן.definition: 1) cummin, cumin; 1a) a seed used as a condiment
כמן.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to store up or preserve;

כמס.definition: 1) to store up, save; 1a) (Qal) stored up (participle)

כמר.definition: 1) to yearn, be kindled, be black (hot), grow warm and tender, be or grow hot, become hot, become emotionally agitated; 1a) (Niphal); 1a1) to grow warm and tender; 1a2) to be or grow hot

כן.definition: adv; 1) so, therefore, thus; 1a) thus, so; 1b) just so; 1c) therefore; 1d) so...as (paired with adv); 1e) then; 1f) forasmuch as (in phrase); 1g) (with prep); 1g1) therefore, this being so (specific); 1g2) hitherto; 1g3) therefore, on this ground (general); 1g4) afterwards; 1g5) in such case; Aramaic equivalent: ken (כֵּן "thus" H3652)

כנה.definition: 1) to title, surname, be surnamed, give an epithet or cognomen, give a flattering title; 1a) (Piel) to call by name, give a title, betitle

כנור.grammar_note: from a unused root meaning to twang;

כניהו.definition: A king of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.24.6; ; son of: Jehoiakim (H3079) and Nehushta (H5179); ; father of: Zedekiah (H6667I)(?) and Shealtiel (H7597A); also called Jeconiah at 1Ch.3.16,17; 2x27.20; 28.4; 29.2; Coniah at Jer.22.24,28; 37.1; Shallum at Jer.22.11; Jechoniah (KJV: Jechonias; NIV: Jeconiah) inMat.1.11; 1x; Another name of ye.ho.ya.khin (יְהוֹיָכִין "Jehoiachin" H3078) ; § Coniah = "Jehovah will establish"; another name for king Jehoiachin of Judah, the next to last king on the throne before the captivity;

כנן.definition: (Qal) root, support (of tree), shoot, stock; Also spelled: kan.nah (כַּנָּה "shoot" H3657)

כנני.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.9.4 ; § Chenani = "my station"; one of the Levites who assisted at the solemn purification of the people under Ezra;

כנניה.grammar_note: or כְּנַנְיָהוּ; from H3661 (כָּנַן) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has planted;

כנס.definition: 1) to gather, collect, wrap; 1a) (Qal) to gather; 1b) (Piel) to gather; 1c) (Hithpael) to gather together, wrap oneself up; Aramaic equivalent: ka.nash (כְּנַשׁ "to gather" H3673)

כנע.definition: 1) to be humble, be humbled, be subdued, be brought down, be low, be under, be brought into subjection; 1a) (Niphal); 1a1) to humble oneself; 1a2) to be humbled, be subdued; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to humble; 1b2) to subdue

כנעה.grammar_note: from H3665 (כָּנַע) in the sense of folding (compare H3664 (כָּנַס));

כנען.definition: ; § Canaan = "lowland"; the land west of the Jordan peopled by the descendants of Canaan and subsequently conquered by the Israelites under Joshua

כנענה.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.22.11; ; father of: Zedekiah (H6667); § Chenaanah = "trader"; 1) father of Zedekiah the false prophet of Ahab; 2) son of Bilhan, grandson of Jediael, and great grandson of Benjamin and the founder of a house of Benjamin

כנעני.definition: a merchant, trader; Group of ke.na.an (כְּנַ֫עַן "merchant" H3667B)

כנף.definition: 1) wing, extremity, edge, winged, border, corner, shirt; 1a) wing; 1b) extremity; 1b1) skirt, corner (of garment)

כנרות.definition: Kinneroth or Kinnereth, a place in Palestine
כנרות.grammar_note: or כִּנֶּרֶתlemma כִּנֶרֶת missing dagesh, corrected to כִּנֶּרֶת; respectively plural and singular feminine from the same as H3658 (כִּנּוֹר); perhaps harp-shaped;

כנת.definition: associate, colleague, companion; Aramaic equivalent: ke.nat (כְּנָת "associate" H3675)

כס.definition: seat (of honour), throne, seat, stool; Another spelling of kis.se (כִּסֵּא ": throne" H3678)
כס.grammar_note: apparently a contraction for H3678 (כִּסֵּא), but probably by erroneous transcription for H5251 (נֵס)

כסא.definition: 1) seat (of honour), throne, seat, stool; 1a) seat (of honour), throne; 1b) royal dignity, authority, power (fig.)

כסדי.definition: {a Kasdite, or descendant of Kesed; by implication, a Chaldaean (as if so descended); also an astrologer (as if proverbial of that people}

כסה.definition: 1) to cover, conceal, hide; 1a) (Qal) conceal, covered (participle); 1b) (Niphal) to be covered; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to cover, clothe; 1c2) to cover, conceal; 1c3) to cover (for protection); 1c4) to cover over, spread over; 1c5) to cover, overwhelm; 1d) (Pual); 1d1) to be covered; 1d2) to be clothed; 1e) (Hithpael) to cover oneself, clothe oneself

כסות.definition: 1) covering, clothing; 1a) covering, clothing; 1b) covering (for concealment)

כסח.definition: 1) to cut down, cut away, cut off (of plants); 1a) (Qal) cut away (pass participle); 1a1) of judgment (fig.)

כסיל.definition: fool, stupid fellow, dullard, simpleton, arrogant one

כסל.definition: 1) loins, flank; 2) stupidity, folly; 3) confidence, hope

כסלו.definition: ; § Chisleu = "his confidence"; the 9th month of the calendar corresponding to Nov-Dec;

כסלון.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.34.21; ; father of: Elidad (H0449) ; § Chislon = "confidence"; father of Elidad, the prince selected to assist in the division of the land of Canaan among the tribes;

כסלות.definition: ; § Chesulloth = "flanks"; a town in Issachar near Jezreel; also 'Chisloth-tabor' kis.lot ta.vor (כִּסְלֹת תָּבֹר "Chisloth-tabor" H3696);
כסלות.grammar_note: feminine plural of passive participle of H3688 (כָּסַל); fattened;

כסלחים.definition: People descended from Casluch(?) of the Egyptians, first mentioned at Gen.10.14; descended from Egypt (H4714); along with Ludim (H3866), Anamim (H6047), Lehabim (H3853), Naphtuhim (H5320), Pathrusim (H6625) and Caphtorim (H3732); ; progenitors of: the Philistine (H6430); ; § Casluhim = "fortified"; a people or tribe descended from Mizraim (Egypt) progenitors of the Philistines and Caphtorim;
כסלחים.grammar_note: a plural probably of foreign derivation;

כסלת תבר.definition: Chisloth-tabor = "flanks of Tabor"; a town of Issachar on the slopes of Mount Tabor; also 'Chesulloth' ke.sul.lot (כְּסֻלּוֹת "Chesulloth" H3694); Another name of ke.sul.lot (כְּסֻלּוֹת "Chesulloth" H3694)
כסלת תבר.grammar_note: from the feminine plural of H3689 (כֶּסֶל) and H8396 (תָּבוֹר); flanks of Tabor;

כסמת.definition: spelt-a wheat-like crop planted and harvested in the fall or spring

כסף.definition: 1) to long for, yearn for, long after; 1a) (Qal) to long for; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to long for (deeply); 1b2) being longed for (participle)

כספיא.definition: ; § Casiphia = "silvery"; a place in Babylonia on the road between Babylon and Jerusalem; site uncertain;

כסת.definition: 1) band, fillet, covered amulets, false phylacteries; 1a) used by false prophetesses in Israel to support their demonic fortune-telling schemes

כען.definition: now, at this time, until now; Aramaic equivalent: ke.e.net (כְּעֶ֫נֶת "now" H3706)

כענת.definition: now, and now; Aramaic of ke.an (כְּעַן "now" H3705)

כעס.definition: 1) to be angry, be vexed, be indignant, be wroth, be grieved, provoke to anger and wrath; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be vexed, be indignant; 1a2) to be angry; 1b) (Piel) to provoke to anger; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to vex; 1c2) to vex, provoke to anger

כף.definition: : dish/socket; 1) palm, hand, sole, palm of the hand, hollow or flat of the hand; 1a) palm, hollow or flat of the hand; 1b) power; 1c) sole (of the foot); 1d) hollow, objects, bending objects, bent objects; 1d1) of thigh-joint; 1d2) pan, vessel (as hollow); 1d3) hollow (of sling); 1d4) hand-shaped branches or fronds (of palm trees); 1d5) handles (as bent)

כפה.definition: branch, leaf, frond, palm frond, palm branch

כפיס.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to connect;

כפירה.definition: ; § Chephirah = "lioness"; a city of the Gibeonites subsequently assigned to the tribe of Benjamin;
כפירה.grammar_note: feminine of H3715 (כְּפִיר); the village (always with the art.);

כפל.definition: 1) to double, fold double, double over; 1a) (Qal) to double over; 1b) (Niphal) to be doubled

כפן.definition: 1) (Qal) to hunger, be hungry, hungrily desire; 2) (CLBL) to twist, bend

כפף.definition: 1) to bend, bend down, bow down, be bent, be bowed; 1a) (Qal) to bend down, bow down; 1b) (Niphal) to bow oneself down

כפר.definition: 1) to cover, purge, make an atonement, make reconciliation; 1a) (Piel); 1a1) to cover over, pacify, propitiate; 1a2) to cover over, atone for sin, make atonement for; 1a3) to cover over, atone for sin and persons by legal rites; 1b) (Pual); 1b1) to be covered over; 1b2) to be atoned for; 1c) (Hithpael) to be covered
כפר.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √kpr 'to cover, atone'. Source of כפרה, יום כיפור.

כפר העמוני.grammar_note: from H3723 (כָּפָר) and H5984 (עַמּוֹנִי), with the article interposed; village of the Ammonite;

כפרת.definition: 1) mercy-seat, place of atonement; 1a) the golden plate of propitiation on which the High Priest sprinkled the seat 7 times on the Day of Atonement symbolically reconciling Jehovah and His chosen people; 1a1) the slab of gold on top of the ark of the covenant which measured 2.5 by 1.5 cubits; on it and part of it were the two golden cherubim facing each other whose outstretched wings came together above and constituted the throne of God

כפש.definition: 1) (Hiphil) to make bent, press or bend together; 2) (CLBL) to bend down; 2a) (Hiphil) to cause to bend down, trample

כפת.definition: 1) to bind; 1a) (P'il) to be bound; 1b) (Pael) to bind

כפתר.definition: Caphtor (i.e. a wreath-shaped island), the original seat of the Philistines
כפתר.grammar_note: or (Amos 9:1) כַּפְתּוֹר; probably from an unused root meaning to encircle;

כפתרי.definition: Someone from Caphtor (Crete) of the Egyptians, first mentioned at Gen.10.14; descended from Egypt (H4714); along with Ludim (H3866), Anamim (H6047), Lehabim (H3853), Naphtuhim (H5320), Pathrusim (H6625) and Casluhim (H3695) ; § Caphtorim, of Caphtor "a crown"; Cretans as the inhabitants of Caphtor as distinct from the Philistines;

כר.definition: 1) kor, a measure (usually dry); 1a) a dry or liquid measure equal to 10 ephahs or baths; 1a1) a dry measure containing 6.25 bushels (220 l); 1a2) a liquid measure of 58 gallons (263 l); Aramaic equivalent: kor (כּוֹר "kor" H3734B)
כר.grammar_note: from H3769 (כָּרַר) in the sense of plumpness;

כרא.grammar_note: (Aramaic) probably corresponding to H3738 (כָּרָה) in the sense of piercing(figuratively);

כרבל.definition: 1) to put a mantle on, be-mantle, bind around; 1a) (Pual) bemantled (participle); 1b) (Pael) be bound; Also means: ke.phat (כְּפַת "to bind" H3729)

כרבלא.grammar_note: (Aramaic) from a verb corresponding to that of H3736 (כַּרְבֵּל);

כרה.definition: cistern, cave, water meadow or something else that is hollow where shepherds might rest

כרוב.definition: 1) cherub, cherubim (pl); 1a) an angelic being; 1a1) as guardians of Eden; 1a2) as flanking God's throne; 1a3) as an image form hovering over the Ark of the Covenant; 1a4) as the chariot of Jehovah (fig.)

כרי.definition: A group, first mentioned at 2Sa.8.18; also called Carite at 2Ki.11.4,19; ; Group of ke.re.ti (כְּרֵתִי "Cherethite" H3774H) ; a group of foreign mercenary soldiers serving as a bodyguard for king David; also executioners;
כרי.grammar_note: perhaps an abridged plural of H3733 (כַּר) in the sense of leader (of the flock);

כרית.definition: ; § Cherith = "cutting"; the brook where Elijah was hidden during a drought; east of Jordan;

כרכב.grammar_note: expanded from the same as H3522 (כַּבּוֹן);

כרכם.definition: 1) saffron; 1a) an orange-yellow flower of the crocus family, used for flavouring in drinks and confections in order to promote perspiration for cooling of the body

כרכמיש.definition: ; § Carchemish = "fortress of Chemosh"; a Hittite capital northeast of Israel on the Euphrates river captured by Pharaoh Necho and then from him by Nebuchadnezzar;

כרכס.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Est.1.10 ; § Carcas = "severe"; the 7th of the 7 eunuchs of king Ahasuerus;

כרם.definition: 1) to tend vines or vineyards, to dress vines or vineyards; 1a) (Qal) vinedressers (participle)
כרם.grammar_note: from an unused root of uncertain meaning;

כרמי.definition: A man of the tribe of Reuben living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.9; ; son of: Reuben (H7205); ; brother of: Pallu (H6396), Hezron (H2696) and Hanoch (H2585J); Also named: kar.mi (כַּרְמִי "Carmite" H3757); § Carmi = "my vineyard"; 1) the 4th son of Reuben and progenitor of the Carmites; 2) a Judaite, father of Achan, the 'troubler of Israel' in the time of Joshua

כרמל.definition: 1) plantation, garden-land, orchard, fruit orchard; 2) fruit, garden-growth (meton)

כרמלי.definition: Carmelite, of Carmel "garden-land"; an inhabitant of Carmel; Another spelling of kar.mel (כַּרְמֶל "Carmel" H3760)

כרמלית.definition: Carmelitess, of Carmel "garden-land"; 1) a female inhabitant of Carmel; 2) Abigail, the wife of David, who came from Carmel

כרן.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.36.26; ; son of: Dishon (H1787); ; brother of: Eshban (H0790), Ithran (H3506) and Hemdan (H2533) ; § Cheran = "lyre"; an Edomite, one of the sons of Dishon, the Horite duke;

כרסא.definition: throne, royal chair; Aramaic of kis.se (כִּסֵּא ": throne" H3678)

כרסם.definition: (Piel) to tear apart, ravage, tear off

כרע.definition: 1) to bend, kneel, bow, bow down, sink down to one's knees, kneel down to rest (of animals), kneel in reverence; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to bow; 1a2) to bow down, crouch; 1a3) to bow down over; 1a4) to tilt, lean; 1b) (Hiphil) to cause to bow

כרשנא.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Est.1.14 ; § Carshena = "illustrious"; one of the 7 princes of Persia and Media under king Ahasuerus;

כרת.definition: : eliminate/destroy; 1) to cut, cut off, cut down, cut off a body part, cut out, eliminate, kill, cut a covenant; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to cut off; 1a1a) to cut off a body part, behead; 1a2) to cut down; 1a3) to hew; 1a4) to cut or make a covenant; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be cut off; 1b2) to be cut down; 1b3) to be chewed; 1b4) to be cut off, fail; 1c) (Pual); 1c1) to be cut off; 1c2) to be cut down; 1d) (Hiphil); 1d1) to cut off; 1d2) to cut off, destroy; 1d3) to cut down, destroy; 1d4) to take away; 1d5) to permit to perish; 1e) (Hophal) cut off

כרתי.definition: A group, first mentioned at 2Sa.8.18; also called Carite at 2Ki.11.4,19; ; Also named: ka.ri (כָּרִי "Carite" H3746); § Cherethites = "executioners"; 1) a group of foreign mercenary soldiers serving as a bodyguard for king David; also executioners; 2) either Cretans or proto-Philistines (in general)
כרתי.grammar_note: probably from H3772 (כָּרַת) in the sense of executioner; (compare H2876 (טַבָּח)) (only collectively in the singular as plural)

כשד.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, only mentioned at Gen.22.22; ; son of: Nahor (H5152H) and Milcah (H4435); ; brother of: Uz (H5780H), Buz (H0938), Kemuel (H7055), Hazo (H2375), Pildash (H6394), Jidlaph (H3044) and Bethuel (H1328A); ; half-brother of: Tebah (H2875), Gaham (H1514), Tahash (H8477) and Maacah (H4601) ; § Chesed = "increase"; the 4th son of Nahor, the nephew of Abraham;
כשד.grammar_note: from an unused root of uncertain meaning;

כשדי.definition: ; Aramaic of kas.di (כַּשְׂדִּים "Chaldea" H3778) ; § Chaldean, of Chaldea "clod-breakers"; 1) a group of people usually associated with the area around Babylonia; 2) the learned class of priests, magicians, or astronomers
כשדי.grammar_note: (occasionally with enclitic) כַּשְׂדִּימָה; towards the Kasdites into Chaldea), patronymically from H3777 (כֶּשֶׂד) (only in the plural);

כשה.definition: (Qal) to become sated, be gorged with food

כשל.definition: 1) to stumble, stagger, totter; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to stumble; 1a2) to totter; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to stumble; 1b2) to be tottering, be feeble; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to cause to stumble, bring injury or ruin to, overthrow; 1c2) to make feeble, make weak; 1d) (Hophal) to be made to stumble; 1e) (Piel) bereave

כשלון.definition: a stumbling, a fall, a calamity

כשף.definition: 1) (Piel) to practice witchcraft or sorcery, use witchcraft; 1a) sorcerer, sorceress (participle)

כשר.definition: 1) to succeed, please, be suitable, be proper, be advantageous, be right and proper to; 1a) (Qal) to please, be proper; 1b) (Hiphil) to give success
כשר.grammar_note: a primitive root properly, to be straight or right;

כשרון.definition: 1) success, skill, profit; 1a) skill; 1b) success, profit

כתב.definition: 1) to write, record, enrol; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to write, inscribe, engrave, write in, write on; 1a2) to write down, describe in writing; 1a3) to register, enrol, record; 1a4) to decree; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be written; 1b2) to be written down, be recorded, be enrolled; 1c) (Piel) to continue writing; Aramaic equivalent: ke.tav (כְּתַב "to write" H3790)
כתב.pattern: Qal: to write; Niphal: to be written; Piel: to write much

כתבת.definition: 1) impression, inscription, mark; 1a) in the flesh, perhaps a tattoo

כתי.definition: Someone descended from Kittim of the Greeks, first mentioned at Gen.10.4; descended from Javan (H3120); along with Elishah (H0473), Tarshish (H8659) and Dodanim (H1721); § Chittim or Kittim = "bruisers"; 1) a general term for all islanders of the Mediterranean Sea; 2) the descendants of Javan, the son of Japheth and grandson of Noah
כתי.grammar_note: or כִּתִּיִּי; patrial from an unused name denoting Cyprus (only in the plural);

כתית.definition: 1) beaten out, pure, pounded fine (in a mortar), costly; 1a) of olive oil

כתל.definition: wall (of house); Aramaic equivalent: ke.tal (כְּתַל "wall" H3797)
כתל.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to compact;

כתליש.definition: ; one of the lowland towns of Judah;
כתליש.grammar_note: from H3796 (כֹּתֶל) and H376 (אִישׁ); wall of a man;

כתם.definition: (Niphal) to be stained, be defiled, be deeply stained

כתנת.definition: 1) tunic, under-garment; 1a) a long shirt-like garment usually of linen
כתנת.grammar_note: or כֻּתֹּנֶת; from an unused root meaning to cover (compare H3802 (כָּתֵף));

כתף.definition: 1) shoulder, shoulder-blade, side, slope; 1a) shoulder, shoulder-blade (of man); 1b) shoulder, shoulder-pieces (of animals); 1c) side, slope (of mountain); 1d) supports (of laver)
כתף.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to clothe;

כתר.definition: 1) to surround; 1a) (Piel) to surround; 1b) (Hiphil) to surround, encircle

כתרת.definition: capital crown, capital of a pillar

כתש.definition: (Qal) to pound, mix by pounding, pound fine, bray

כתת.definition: 1) to beat, crush by beating, crush to pieces, crush fine; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to beat or crush fine; 1a2) to beat, hammer; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to beat or crush fine; 1b2) to beat, hammer; 1c) (Pual) to be beaten; 1d) (Hiphil) to beat in pieces, shatter; 1e) (Hophal) to be beaten, be crushed

לא.definition: 1) not, no; 1a) not (with verb-absolute prohibition); 1b) not (with modifier-negation); 1c) nothing (subst); 1d) without (with particle); 1e) before (of time); Aramaic equivalent: la (לָא "not" H3809)
לא.grammar_note: Negates indicative statements; compare אַל for jussive/imperative
לא.usage: לֹא אֵלֵךְ - I will not go

לא דבר.definition: Lo-debar = "not a pasture"; a town in Manasseh in Gilead east of the Jordan; Also named: lid.vir (לִדְבִר "Debir" H1688B)
לא דבר.grammar_note: or לוֹ דבַר; (Samuel 9:4,5), or לִדְבִר; (Joshua 13:26), (probably rather לֹדְבַר ); from H3808 (לֹא) and H1699 (דֹּבֶר); pastureless;

לאה.definition: 1) to be weary, be impatient, be grieved, be offended; 1a) (Qal) to be weary, be impatient; 1b) (Niphal) to be tired of something, weary oneself; 1c) (Hiphil) to weary, make weary, exhaust

לאט.definition: 1) secrecy, mystery; 1a) secrecy, secretly; 1b) mystery, enchantment

לאל.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.3.24; ; father of: Eliasaph (H0460H) ; § Lael = "belonging to God"; a Levite, father of Eliasaph and descendant of Gershon;
לאל.grammar_note: from the prepositional prefix and H410 (אֵל); (belonging) to God;

לאם.grammar_note: or לְאוֹם; from an unused root meaning to gather;

לאמים.definition: People descended from Leumm(?) of the Patriarchs, only mentioned at Gen.25.3; descended from Dedan (H1719C); along with Asshurim (H0805A) and Letushim (H3912) ; § Leummim = "peoples"; son of Dedan and grandson of Jokshan;

לא עמי.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at Hos.1.9; ; son of: Hosea (H1954J) and Gomer (H1586H); ; brother of: Jezreel (H3157K), Lo-ruhamah (H3819) ; § Lo-ammi = "not my people"; symbolic name given by the prophet Hosea to his second son by Gomer;
לא עמי.grammar_note: from H3808 (לֹא) and H5971 (עַם) with pronominal suffix; not my people;

לא רחמה.definition: A woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at Hos.1.6; ; daughter of: Hosea (H1954J) and Gomer (H1586H); ; sister of: Jezreel (H3157K), Lo-ammi lo am.mi (לֹא עַמִּי "Not My People" H3818)) ; § Lo-ruhamah = "no mercy"; (Pual) symbolic name given by the prophet Hosea to his daughter;
לא רחמה.grammar_note: from H3808 (לֹא) and H7355 (רָחַם); not pitied;

לב.definition: 1) inner man, mind, will, heart, understanding; 1a) inner part, midst; 1a1) midst (of things); 1a2) heart (of man); 1a3) soul, heart (of man); 1a4) mind, knowledge, thinking, reflection, memory; 1a5) inclination, resolution, determination (of will); 1a6) conscience; 1a7) heart (of moral character); 1a8) as seat of appetites; 1a9) as seat of emotions and passions 1a10) as seat of courage

לבאות.definition: ; § Lebaoth = "witness"; a town in southern Judah;

לבב.definition: 1) inner man, mind, will, heart, soul, understanding; 1a) inner part, midst; 1a1) midst (of things); 1a2) heart (of man); 1a3) soul, heart (of man); 1a4) mind, knowledge, thinking, reflection, memory; 1a5) inclination, resolution, determination (of will); 1a6) conscience; 1a7) heart (of moral character); 1a8) as seat of appetites; 1a9) as seat of emotions and passions 1a10) as seat of courage; Aramaic equivalent: le.vav (לְבַב "heart" H3825)
לבב.grammar_note: a primitive root; properly, to be enclosed (as if with fat); by implication (as denominative from H3824 (לֵבָב));  to unheart;  also as denominative from H3834 (לָבִיבָה) i.e.

לבה.definition: 1) flame; 2) tip of weapon, point, head of spear

לבונה.definition: ; § Lebonah = "frankincense"; a town in Ephraim 3 miles (5 km) west northwest of Shiloh;

לבוש.definition: clothing, garment, apparel, raiment; Aramaic equivalent: le.vush (לְבוּשׁ "garment" H3831)

לבט.definition: 1) to throw down, thrust down, thrust out, thrust away; 1a) (Niphal) to be thrust down, be thrust away, be thrown down, be cast aside

לביא.definition: lioness; Another spelling of la.vi (לָבִיא "lion" H3833C)
לביא.grammar_note: or (Ezekiel 19:2) לְבִיָּא; irregular masculine plural לְבָאִים; irregular feminine plural לְבָאוֹת; from an unused root meaning;  compare H738 (אֲרִי)

לביבה.grammar_note: or rather לְבִבָה; from H3823 (לָבַב) in its original sense of fatness (or perhaps of folding);

לבן.definition: 1) to be white; 1a) (Hiphil); 1a1) to make white, become white, purify; 1a2) to show whiteness, grow white; 1b) (Hithpael) to become white, be purified (ethical)
לבן.grammar_note: a primitive root; also as denominative from H3843 (לְבֵנָה)

לבנא.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.45; also called Lebana at Neh.7.48; ; § Lebanah or Lebana = "moon-white"; head of a family of exiles who returned with Zerubbabel;
לבנא.grammar_note: or לְבָנָה; the same as H3842 (לְבָנָה);

לבנה.definition: 1) frankincense; 1a) a white resin burned as fragrant incense; 1a1) ceremonially; 1a2) personally; 1a3) used in compounding the holy incense

לבנון.definition: ; § Lebanon = "whiteness"; a wooded mountain range on the northern border of Israel
לבנון.grammar_note: from H3825 (לְבַב); (the) white mountain (from its snow);

לבני.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.6.17; ; son of: Gershon (H1648); ; brother of: Shimei (H8096G); ; father of: Jehieli= Jehiel (H3171H), Zetham (H2241), Joel (H3100O); also called Jahath at 1Ch.6.43; Ladan (KJV: Laadan) at 1Ch.23.7,9; 26.21; ; § Libni = "white"; the eldest son of Gershon and grandson of Levi

לבש.definition: 1) to dress, wear, clothe, put on clothing, be clothed; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to put on clothes, be clothed, wear; 1a2) to put on, be clothed with (fig.); 1b) (Pual) to be fully clothed; 1c) (Hiphil) to clothe, array with, dress; Aramaic equivalent: le.vash (לְבֵשׁ "to clothe" H3848)

לג.definition: 1) log; 1a) a liquid measure equal to about one half litre
לג.grammar_note: from an unused root apparently meaning to deepen or hollow (like H3537 (כַּד));

לד.definition: Lod = "travail"; a city approx 11 miles (17 km) southeast of Joppa in the plain of Sharon in the territory of Benjamin; Also named: Ludda (Λύδδα "Lydda" G3069)
לד.grammar_note: from an unused root of uncertain signification;

להב.definition: 1) flame, blade; 1a) flame; 1b) of flashing point of spear or blade of sword
להב.grammar_note: from an usused root meaning to gleam;

להבה.definition: 1) flame; 2) tip of weapon, point, head of spear
להבה.grammar_note: or לַהֶבֶת; feminine of H3851 (לַהַב), and meaning the same

להבים.definition: People descended from Egypt (H4714), first mentioned at Gen.10.13; along with Ludim (H3866), Anamim (H6047), Naphtuhim (H5320), Pathrusim (H6625), Casluhim (H3695) and Caphtorim (H3732) ; § Lehabim = "flames"; an Egyptian tribe descended from Mizraim;

להג.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to be eager;

להד.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.2; ; son of: Jahath (H3189); ; brother of: Ahumai (H0267) ; § Lahad = "oppression"; son of Jahath, a descendant of Judah;
להד.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to glow (compare H3851 (לַהַב)) or else to be earnest (compare H3854 (לַהַג));

להה.grammar_note: a primitive root meaning properly, to burn, i.e. (by implication)

להט.definition: 1) to burn, blaze, scorch, kindle, blaze up, flame; 1a) (Qal) blazing (participle); 1b)(Piel) to scorch, burn, blaze

להם.definition: 1) to gulp, swallow greedily; 1a) (Hithpael) to be gulped

להן.definition: 1) therefore; 2) except, but; 2a) except (with negative); 2b) however, but
להן.grammar_note: from the prepositional prefix meaning to or for and H2005 (הֵן);

להקה.grammar_note: probably from an unused root meaning to gather;

לוא.definition: conditional particle; if; by implication (interj. as a wish) would that!

לובי.definition: Libyan or inhabitant of interior Africa (only in plural)
לובי.grammar_note: or לֻבִּי; (Daniel 11:43), partrial from a name probably derived from an unused root meaning to thirst, i.e. a dry region; apparently

לוד.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.10.22; ; son of: Shem (H8035); ; brother of: Asshur (H0804H), Elam (H5867C), Arpachshad (H0775) and Aram (H0758); Also named: lu.di (לוּדִי "Lydian" H3866H) ; § Lud or Lydia = "strife"; 1) the 4th listed son of Shem and supposed progenitor of the Lydians; n patr; 2) descendants of Lud the son of Shem who settled in northern Africa;

לודי.definition: Someone descended from Egypt (H4714), first mentioned at Gen.10.13; along with Anamim (H6047), Lehabim (H3853), Naphtuhim (H5320), Pathrusim (H6625), Casluhim (H3695) and Caphtorim (H3732); § Ludim or Lydians = "to the firebrands: travailings"; the descendants of Lud the son of Shem

לוה.definition: 1) to join, be joined; 1a) (Qal) to join, be joined, attend; 1b) (Niphal) to join oneself to, be joined unto

לוז.definition: 1) to depart, turn aside; 1a) (Qal) to depart; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to go wrong, go crooked; 1b2) devious, perverse (participle); 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to be lost from view; 1c2) to become devious
לוז.grammar_note: a primitive root; (compare H3867 (לָוָה), H3874 (לוּט) and H3885 (לוּן))

לוח.definition: 1) board, slab, tablet, plank; 1a) tablets (of stone); 1b) boards (of wood); 1c) plate (of metal)
לוח.grammar_note: or לֻחַ; from a primitive root;

לוחית.definition: ; § Luhith = "tablets"; a town of Moab, south of the Arnon River;
לוחית.grammar_note: or לֻחוֹת; (Jeremiah 48:5), from the same as H3871 (לוּחַ); floored;

לוט.definition: 1) to wrap closely or tightly, enwrap, envelop; 1a) (Qal) to wrap tightly; 1b) (Hiphil) to envelop, wrap

מטר.definition: 1) to rain; 1a) (Niphal) to be rained on or upon; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to rain, send rain; 1b2) to rain hail, send hail

מטרא.definition: jail (as a guard-house); also an aim (as being closely watched)

מטרד.definition: A woman living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.36.39; ; daughter of: Mezahab (H4314); ; mother of: Mehetabel (H4105) ; § Matred = "pushing forward"; daughter of Mezahab and mother of Mehetabel, the wife of Hadar (Hadad) of Pau, king of Edom;

מטרי.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Sa.10.21 ; § Matri = "rain of Jehovah"; a family of the tribe of Benjamin to which king Saul belonged;

מי.definition: 1) water, waters; 1a) water; 1b) water of the feet, urine; 1c) of danger, violence, transitory things, refreshment (fig.)
מי.grammar_note: an interrogative pronoun of persons, as H4100 (מָה) is of things,

מידבא.definition: ; § Medeba = "water of rest"; a town in Moab assigned to Reuben and located 4 miles (6 km) southwest of Heshbon; still extant;
מידבא.grammar_note: from H4325 (מַיִם) and H1679 (דֹּבֶא); water of quiet;

מידד.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.11.26 ; § Medad = "love"; one of the 70 elders to whom was communicated the prophetic power of Moses and who prophesied in the camp of the Israelites in the wilderness;
מידד.grammar_note: from H3032 (יָדַד) in the sense of loving; affectionate;

מי הירקון.definition: ; § Me-jarkon = "waters of yellowness"; a town in Dan near Joppa;
מי הירקון.grammar_note: from H4325 (מַיִם) and H3420 (יֵרָקוֹן) with the art. interposed; water of the yellowness;

מי זהב.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.36.39; ; father of: Matred (H4308) ; § Mezahab = "waters of gold"; father of Matred and grandfather of Mehetabel, the wife of Hadad, the last named king of Edom;
מי זהב.grammar_note: from H4325 (מַיִם) and H2091 (זָהָב), water of gold;

מיכא.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at 1Ch.9.15; ; son of: Zichri (H2147K); ; father of: Mattaniah (H4983); Also named: mi.khah (מִיכָה "Mica" H4318L); § Micha = "who is like God"; 1) son of Mephibosheth; 2) a Levite who signed the covenant with Nehemiah; 3) father of Mattaniah, a Gershonite Levite and descendant of Asaph

מיכאל.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.13.13; ; father of: Sethur (H5639); § Michael = "who is like God"; 1) one of, the chief, or the first archangel who is described as the one who stands in time of conflict for the children of Israel; 2) an Asherite, father of Sethur, one of the 12 spies of Israel; 3) one of the Gadites who settled in the land of Bashan; 4) another Gadite, ancestor of Abihail; 5) a Gershonite Levite, ancestor of Asaph; 6) one of the 5 sons of Izrahiah of the tribe of Issachar; 7) a Benjamite of the sons of Beriah; 8) one of the captains from Manasseh who joined David at Ziklag; 9) father or ancestor of Omri, chief of the tribe of Issachar in the reign of David; 10) one of the sons of Jehoshaphat who were murdered by their elder brother, Jehoram; 11) father or ancestor of Zebadiah, of the sons of Shephatiah
מיכאל.grammar_note: from H4310 (מִי) and (the prefix derivative from) H3588 (כִּי) and H410 (אֵל); who (is) like God?;

מיכה.definition: A man living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jdg.17.1; Also named: mi.kha.ye.hu (מִיכָֽיְהוּ "Micah" H4321I); § Micah or Micaiah or Michah = "who is like God"; 1) the 6th in order of the minor prophets; a native of Moresheth, he prophesied during the reigns of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah of Judah, and was contemporary with the prophets Hosea, Amos, and Isaiah; 2) an Ephraimite during the period of the judges; 3) a descendant of Joel the Reubenite; 4) son of Meribbaal and grandson of Jonathan; 5) a Kohathite Levite, the eldest son of Uzziel the brother of Amram; 6) father of Abdon, a man of high station in the reign of Josiah; 7) son of Imlah and a prophet of Samaria who predicted the defeat and death of king Ahab of Israel

מיכהו.definition: A prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.22.8; ; son of: Imlah (H3229); Another name of mi.kha.ye.hu (מִיכָֽיְהוּ "Micaiah" H4321G) ; § Michaiah = "who is like God"; son of Imlah and a prophet of Samaria who predicted the defeat and death of king Ahab of Israel;

מיכיה.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.22.12; ; father of: Achbor (H5907H); also called Micah at 2Ch.34.20;; Also named: mi.khah (מִיכָה "Micah" H4318M); § Micah or Michaiah = "who is like God"; 1) the 6th in order of the minor prophets; a native of Moresheth, he prophesied during the reigns of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah of Judah, and was contemporary with the prophets Hosea, Amos, and Isaiah; 2) father of Achbor, a man of high station in the reign of Josiah; 3) one of the priests at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem
מיכיה.grammar_note: from H4310 (מִי) and (the prefix derivative from) H3588 (כִּי) and H3050 (יָהּ); who (is) like Jah?;

מיכיהו.definition: A prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.22.8; ; son of: Imlah (H3229); § Micah or Micaiah or Michaiah = "who is like God"; 1) an Ephraimite during the period of the judges; 2) son of Imlah and a prophet of Samaria who predicted the defeat and death of king Ahab of Israel; 3) son of Gemariah in the time of Jeremiah
מיכיהו.grammar_note: or מִכָיְהוּ; (Jeremiah 36:11), abbreviated form for H4322 (מִיכָיָהוּ);

מים.definition: water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen
מים.grammar_note: Plural form only (plurale tantum); takes dual endings but plural meaning

מימן.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.24.9; § Miamin or Mijamin = "from the right hand"; 1) chief of the 6th course of priests established by David; 2) a priest who signed the covenant with Nehemiah; 3) a priest who went up with Zerubbabel; 4) a priest who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra

מין.definition: kind, sometimes a species (usually of animals)
מין.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to portion out;

מיסדה.definition: 1) to be founded, be laid; 1a) foundation (participle)
מיסדה.grammar_note: properly, feminine passive participle of H3245 (יָסַד);

מישא.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.8.9; ; son of: Shaharaim (H7842) and Hodesh (H2321); ; brother of: Jobab (H3103J), Zibia (H6644), Malcam (H4445A), Jeuz (H3263), Sachia (H7634), Mirmah (H4821), Abitub (H0036) and Elpaal (H0508) ; § Mesha = "freedom"; a Benjamite, son of Shaharaim by his wife Hodesh who bore him in the land of Moab;

מישאל.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.6.22; ; son of: Uzziel (H5816); ; brother of: Elizaphan (H0469), Sithri (H5644), Micah (H4318J) and Isshiah (H3449I); § Mishael = "who is what God is"; 1) the godly friend of Daniel who Nebuchadnezzar renamed Meshach; one of the three friends who with Daniel refused to make themselves unclean by eating food from the king's table which went against the dietary laws which God had given the Jews; also one of the three who were thrown into the fiery furnace for refusing to bow down to a graven image of Nebuchadnezzar and who were saved by the angel of the Lord; 2) a son of Uzziel and a cousin of Moses and Aaron; 3) one of those who stood at the left hand of Ezra when he read the law to the people
מישאל.grammar_note: from H4310 (מִי) and H410 (אֵל) with the abbreviated form insep. relatively (see H834 (אֲשֶׁר)) interposed; who (is) what God (is) ?;

מישור.definition: 1) level place, uprightness; 1a) level country, table-land, plain; 1b) level place; 1c) uprightness

מישך.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Dan.1.6; also called Meshach at Dan.1.7; 2.49; 3.12,13,14,16,19,20,22,23,26,28,29,30; ; Another name of mi.sha.el (מִישָׁאֵל "Mishael" H4332I) ; § Meshach = "guest of a king"; 1) the godly friend of Daniel who Nebuchadnezzar renamed Meshach; one of the three friends who with Daniel refused to make themselves unclean by eating food from the king's table which went against the dietary laws which God had given the Jews; also one of the three who were thrown into the fiery furnace for refusing to bow down to a graven image of Nebuchadnezzar and who were saved by the angel of the Lord; 1a) original name 'Mishael';

מישע.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at 1Ch.2.42a; ; son of: Caleb (H3612H); ; brother of: Hur (H2354), Jesher (H3475), Shobab (H7727H), Ardon (H0715), Haran (H2771B), Moza (H4162), Gazez (H1495), Jahdai (H3056), Sheber (H7669), Tirhanah (H8647), Shaaph (H8174H), Sheva (H7724) and Achsah (H5915H); ; father of: Ziph (H2128I) and Hebron (H2275I) ; § Mesha = "deliverance"; the eldest son of Caleb by his wife Azubah and grandson of Hezron;

מישר.definition: 1) evenness, uprightness, straightness, equity; 1a) evenness, level, smoothness; 1b) uprightness, equity; 1c) rightly (as adv)

מכאב.grammar_note: sometimes מַכְאוֹב; also (feminine Isaiah 53:3) מַכְאֹבָה; from H3510 (כָּאַב);

מכבנא.definition: Macbena, a place in Palestine settled by him
מכבנא.grammar_note: from the same as H3522 (כַּבּוֹן); knoll;

מכבני.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.12.13 ; § Machbanai = "bond of the Lord"; a Gadite and one of David's mighty warriors who joined him at Ziklag;

מכבר.grammar_note: from H3527 (כָּבַר) in the sense of covering (compare H3531 (כְּבָרָה));

מכה.definition: 1) blow, wound, slaughter; 1a) blow, stripe; 1b) beating, scourging; 1c) wound; 1d) slaughter; 1e) defeat, conquest; 1f) plague
מכה.grammar_note: or (masculine) מַכֶּה; (plural only) from H5221 (נָכָה); a blow (in 2 Chronicles 2:10, of the flail); by implication,

מכון.definition: 1) fixed or established place, foundation; 1a) fixed place; 1b) foundation

מכונה.definition: fixed resting place, base, pedestal; Also means: me.khu.nah (מְכֻנָה "base" H4369)

מכורה.grammar_note: or מְכֹרָה; from the same as H3564 (כּוּר) in the sense of dipping;

מכי.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.13.15; ; father of: Geuel (H1345) ; § Machi = "decrease"; father of Geuel the Gadite who was one of the 12 spies of Israel;

מכיר.definition: A man of the tribe of Manasseh living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.50.23; ; son of: Manasseh (H4519) and Aramitess (H0761); ; brother of: Asriel (H0844H); married to Maacah (H4601M); ; father of: Gilead (H1568H), daughter_of_Machir (H4353I), Peresh (H6570), Sheresh (H8329) and Hammolecheth (H4447); also called in NIV: Makir; Also named: ma.khi.ri (מָכִירִי "Machirite" H4354); § Machir = "sold"; 1) eldest son of Manasseh by an Aramite or Syrian concubine and progenitor of a large family; 2) son of Ammiel, a powerful chief of one of the Transjordanic tribes who rendered essential services to Saul and to David

מכירי.definition: Someone descended from Machir who was a man of the tribe of Manasseh living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.50.23; ; son of: Manasseh (H4519) and Aramitess (H0761); ; brother of: Asriel (H0844H); married to Maacah (H4601M); ; father of: Gilead (H1568H), daughter_of_Machir (H4353I), Peresh (H6570), Sheresh (H8329) and Hammolecheth (H4447); also called in NIV: Makir; Group of ma.khir (מָכִיר "Machir" H4353) ; § Machirites = "a salesman"; the descendants of Machir the father of Gilead;

מכך.definition: 1) to be low, be humiliated; 1a) (Qal) to be low, be humiliated; 1b) (Niphal) to sink; 1c) (Hophal) to be brought low

מכלול.definition: 1) perfection, gorgeous attire; adv; 2) perfectly, most gorgeously

מכלל.definition: 1) a thing made perfect, perfect thing, gorgeous garment or stuff; 2) (TWOT) all sorts of things

מכמן.grammar_note: from the same as H3646 (כַּמֹּן) in the sense of hiding;

מכמס.definition: Mikmas or Mikmash, a place in Palestine
מכמס.grammar_note: (Ezra 2:2 or מִכְמָשׁ; or מִכְמַשׁ; (Nehemiah 11:31), from H3647 (כָּמַס); hidden;

מכמר.definition: net, snare; Another spelling of makh.mar (מִכְמָר "net" H4364A)
מכמר.grammar_note: or מִכְמֹר; from H3648 (כָּמַר) in the sense of blackening by heat;

מכמרת.definition: net, fishing net; Another spelling of mikh.me.ret (מִכְמֶ֫רֶת "net" H4365A)

מכמתת.definition: ; § Michmethah = "hiding place"; a place in northeast Ephraim near the border of Manasseh between Shechem and Taanath-shilo;
מכמתת.grammar_note: apparently from an unused root meaning to hide; concealment;

מכנדבי.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Ezr.10.40 ; § Machnadebai = "he brought low my willing ones"; one of the sons of Bani who put away his foreign wife at Ezra's command;
מכנדבי.grammar_note: from H4100 (מָה) and H5068 (נָדַב) with a particle interposed; what (is) like (a) liberal (man) ?;

מכנה.definition: resting place, base; Another spelling of me.kho.nah (מְכוֹנָה "base" H4350)
מכנה.grammar_note: the same as H4350 (מְכוֹנָה); a base;

מכנס.definition: 1) underwear, drawers, trousers; 1a) a priestly undergarment of linen
מכנס.grammar_note: from H3647 (כָּמַס) in the sense of hiding;

מכס.definition: computation, proportion to be paid, tribute, tax
מכס.grammar_note: probably from an unused root meaning to enumerate;

מכסה.definition: 1) a covering; 1a) covering (of the ark); 1b) covering (of the skins of the tabernacle)

מכפלה.definition: ; § Machpelah = "double" or "portion"; the location of a burial cave for the patriarchs, near Hebron;

מכר.definition: 1) to sell; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to sell; 1a2) seller (participle); 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be sold; 1b2) to sell oneself; 1b3) to be given over to death; 1c) (Hithpael) to sell oneself

מכרי.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at 1Ch.9.8; ; father of: Uzzi (H5813J) ; § Michri = "worthy of price"; ancestor of Elah, one of the heads of Benjamin;

מכרתי.definition: Someone descended from Mecherath(?), only mentioned at 1Ch.11.36 ; § Mecherathite = "he of the dug-out" or "he of the digging tool"; a native or inhabitant of Mecherah;
מכרתי.grammar_note: patrial from an unused name (the same as H4380 (מְכֵרָה)) of a place in Palestine;

מכשול.definition: 1) a stumbling, means or occasion of stumbling, stumbling block; 1a) stumbling, fall; 1b) means or occasion of stumbling, stumbling block

מכשלה.definition: 1) overthrown mass, stumbling-block, something overthrown, decay, ruin; 1a) thing overthrown (figurative of kingdom); 1b) stumbling-block (of idols)

מכתב.definition: 1) writing, thing written; 1a) handwriting; 1b) thing written; 1c) writing

מכתם.definition: ; michtam; a technical term found in psalm titles; meaning uncertain;

מלא.definition: 1) to fill, be full; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be full; 1a1a) fulness, abundance (participle); 1a1b) to be full, be accomplished, be ended; 1a2) to consecrate, fill the hand; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be filled, be armed, be satisfied; 1b2) to be accomplished, be ended; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to fill; 1c2) to satisfy; 1c3) to fulfil, accomplish, complete; 1c4) to confirm; 1d) (Pual) to be filled; 1e) (Hithpael) to mass themselves against; Aramaic equivalent: me.la (מְלָא "to fill" H4391)
מלא.pattern: Stative Qal: to be full; Piel: to fill

מלאך.definition: : messenger; 1) messenger, representative; 1a) messenger; 1b) angel; 1c) the theophanic angel
מלאך.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to despatch as a deputy;

מלאכה.definition: 1) occupation, work, business; 1a) occupation, business; 1b) property; 1c) work (something done or made); 1d) workmanship; 1e) service, use; 1f) public business; 1f1) political; 1f2) religious

מלאכי.definition: A prophet living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Mal.1.1 ; § Malachi = "My messenger"; the prophet who wrote the last book of the Old Testament; nothing else is known;
מלאכי.grammar_note: from the same as H4397 (מֲלְאָךְ); ministrative;

מלאת.definition: 1) fulness, setting, border, rim; 1a) meaning uncertain

מלבן.definition: 1) brick mold, brick kiln, quadrangle; 1a) brick mould, brick kiln; 1b) quadrangle

מלה.definition: word, speech, utterance; Aramaic equivalent: mil.lah (מִלָּה "word" H4406)
מלה.grammar_note: from H4448 (מָלַל) (plural masculine as if from מִלֶּה;

מלוא.definition: ; § Millo = "rampart" or "mound"; This name is used for a part of the fortifications of Jerusalem;

מלוח.definition: 1) mallow; 1a) a plant that grows in salt marshes

מלוך.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.10.27; § Malluch or Melicu = "counsellor"; 1) a Merarite Levite, son of Hashabiah; 2) a descendant of Bani who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra; 3) a descendant of Harim who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra; 4) a priest who signed the covenant with Nehemiah; 5) one of the leaders of the people who signed the covenant with Nehemiah

מלותי.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.25.4; ; son of: Heman (H1968I); ; brother of: Bukkiah (H1232), Mattaniah (H4983H), Uzziel (H5816J), Shebuel (H7619H), Jerimoth (H3406L), Hananiah (H2608P), Hanani (H2607H), Eliathah (H0448), Giddalti (H1437), Romamti-ezer (H7320), Joshbekashah (H3436), Hothir (H1956), Mahazioth (H4238) ; § Mallothi = "I have uttered"; one of the 14 sons of Heman, the singer in the time of David;
מלותי.grammar_note: apparently from H4448 (מָלַל); I have talked (i.e. loquacious)

מלח.definition: 1) to salt, season; 1a) (Qal) to salt, season; 1b) (Pual) to be salted; 1c) (Hophal) to be rubbed or washed with salt; Aramaic equivalent: me.lach (מְלַח "to eat salt" H4415)
מלח.grammar_note: a primitive root; also as denominative from H4417 (מֶלַח)

מלחה.grammar_note: from H4414 (מָלַח) (in its denominative sense); understood as land (H776 (אֶרֶץ))

מלחמה.grammar_note: from H3898 (לָחַם) (in the sense of fighting);

מלט.definition: 1) to slip away, escape, deliver, save, be delivered; 1a)(Niphal); 1a1) to slip away; 1a2) to escape; 1a3) to be delivered; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to lay, let slip out (of eggs); 1b2) to let escape; 1b3) to deliver, save (life); 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to give birth to; 1c2) to deliver; 1d) (Hithpael); 1d1) to slip forth, slip out, escape; 1d2) to escape

מלטיה.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.3.7 ; § Melatiah = "Jehovah delivered"; a Gibeonite who assisted in rebuilding the wall of Jerusalem;
מלטיה.grammar_note: from H4423 (מֶלֶט) and H3050 (יָהּ); (whom) Jah has delivered;

מלילה.grammar_note: from H4449 (מְלַל) (in the sense of cropping (compare H4135 (מוּל)));

מליצה.definition: satire, mocking poem, mocking song, taunting, figure, enigma

מלך.definition: 1) to be or become king or queen, reign; 1a) (Qal) to be or become king or queen, reign; 1b) (Hiphil) to make one king or queen, cause to reign; 1c) (Hophal) to be made king or queen

מלכה.definition: A queen of the country Sheba (H7614J) living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.10.1 ; Combined with she.va (שְׁבָא " of Sheba" H7614J); § queen

מלכו.definition: 1) royalty, reign, kingdom; 1a) royalty, kingship, kingly authority; 1b) kingdom; 1c) realm (of territory); 1d) reign (of time)

מלכות.definition: 1) royalty, royal power, reign, kingdom, sovereign power; 1a) royal power, dominion; 1b) reign; 1c) kingdom, realm; Aramaic equivalent: mal.khu (מַלְכוּ "kingdom" H4437)
מלכות.grammar_note: or מַלְכֻת; or (in plural) מַלְכֻיָּה; from H4427 (מָלַךְ);

מלכיאל.definition: A man of the tribe of Asher living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.17; ; son of: Beriah (H1283); ; brother of: Heber (H2268); ; father of: Birzaith (H1269); Also named: mal.ki.e.li (מַלְכִּיאֵלִי "Malchielite" H4440) ; § Malchiel = "my king is God"; the son of Beriah and grandson of Asher;
מלכיאל.grammar_note: from H4428 (מֶלֶךְ) and H410 (אֵל); king of (i.e. appointed by) God;

מלכיאלי.definition: Someone descended from Malchiel who was a man of the tribe of Asher living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.17; ; son of: Beriah (H1283); ; brother of: Heber (H2268); ; father of: Birzaith (H1269); Group of mal.ki.el (מַלְכִּיאֵל "Malchiel" H4439) ; § Malchielites = Malchiel "my king is God"; an Asherite and a descendant of Malchiel, the grandson of Asher;

מלכיה.definition: Malkijah, the name of ten Israelites
מלכיה.grammar_note: or מַלְכִּיָּהוּlemma מַלְכִּיָהוּ missing dagesh, corrected to מַלְכִּיָּהוּ; (Jeremiah [38:6), from H4428 (מֶלֶךְ) and H3050 (יָהּ); king of (i.e. appointed by) Jah;

מלכיצדק.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.14.18; Also named: Melchisedek (Μελχισεδέκ "Melchizedek" G3198) ; § Melchizedek = "my king is Sedek"; king of Salem and priest of the Most High God to whom Abram paid tithe after the battle he fought to free Lot; 'the order of Melchizedek' the order of the priesthood to which Christ belongs;
מלכיצדק.grammar_note: from H4428 (מֶלֶךְ) and H6664 (צֶדֶק); king of right;

מלכירם.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.3.18; ; son of: Shealtiel (H7597A)(?); ; brother of: Pedaiah (H6305H), Shenazzar (H8137), Jekamiah (H3359H), Hoshama (H1953) and Nedabiah (H5072) ; § Malchiram = "my king is high"; son of king Jehoiachin of Judah;
מלכירם.grammar_note: from H4428 (מֶלֶךְ) and H7311 (רוּם); king of a high one (i.e. of exaltation);

נהי.definition: 1) wailing, lamentation, mourning song; 1a) wailing; 1b) mourning song

נהיר.grammar_note: (Aramaic) or נְהִירוּ; (Aramaic), from the same as H5105 (נְהָרָה);

נהל.definition: 1) to lead, give rest, lead with care, guide to a watering place or station, cause to rest, bring to a station or place of rest, guide, refresh; 1a) (Piel); 1a1) to lead to a watering-place or station and cause to rest there; 1a2) to lead or bring to a station or goal; 1a3) to lead, guide; 1a4) to give rest to; 1a5) to refresh (with food); 1b) (Hithpael); 1b1) to lead on; 1b2) to journey by stations or stages

נהלל.grammar_note: or נַהֲלֹל; the same as H5097 (נַהֲלֹל);

נהם.definition: 1) to growl, groan; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to growl (of lion); 1a2) to groan (of sufferer)

נהר.definition: 1) to shine, beam, light, burn; 1a) (Qal) to beam, be radiant; Aramaic equivalent: ne.hi.ru (נְהִירוּ "illumination" H5094B)

נהרה.grammar_note: from H5102 (נָהַר) in its original sense;

נוא.definition: 1) to hinder, hold back, forbid, disallow, restrain, frustrate; 1a) (Qal) to hinder, hold back; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to restrain, forbid, frustrate; 1b2) to restrain, make averse, discourage

נוב.definition: 1) to bear fruit; 1a) (Qal) to bear fruit; 1b) (Pilel) to make to flourish (fig.)

נובי.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.10.19 ; § Nebai = "fruitful"; a family of the heads of the people who signed the covenant with Nehemiah;

נוד.definition: 1) to shake, waver, wander, move to and fro, flutter, show grief, have compassion on; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to move to and fro, wander (aimlessly), take flight; 1a2) to flutter; 1a3) to waver, wave, shake; 1a4) to show grief; 1a4a) to lament, condole, show sympathy; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to cause to wander (aimlessly); 1b2) to make a wagging, wag (with the head); 1c) (Hithpolel); 1c1) to move oneself to and fro, sway, totter; 1c2) to shake oneself; 1c3) to bemoan oneself

נודב.definition: A man of the Arabs living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.25.15; ; son of: Ishmael (H3458); ; brother of: Nebaioth (H5032), Kedar (H6938), Adbeel (H0110), Mibsam (H4017), Mishma (H4927), Dumah (H1746), Massa (H4854), Hadad (H2301), Tema (H8485), Jetur (H3195), Naphish (H5305) and Mahalath (H4258); also called Nodab at 1Ch.5.19; ; Another name of qe.de.mah (קֵ֑דְמָה "Kedemah" H6929) ; § Nodab = "nobility"; an Arab tribe probably descended from Nodab, son of Ishmael and grandson of Abraham;

נוה.definition: 1) abode, habitation, abode of shepherds or flocks, pasture; 1a) abode (of sheep); 1b) abode (of shepherds); 1c) meadow; 1d) habitation

נוח.definition: 1) to rest; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to rest, settle down and remain; 1a2) to repose, have rest, be quiet; 1b) (Hiph); 1b1) to cause to rest, give rest to, make quiet; 1b2) to cause to rest, cause to alight, set down; 1b3) to lay or set down, deposit, let lie, place; 1b4) to let remain, leave; 1b5) to leave, depart from; 1b6) to abandon; 1b7) to permit; 1c) (Hoph); 1c1) to obtain rest, be granted rest; 1c2) to be left, be placed; 1c3) open space (subst); Also means: ya.nach (יָנַח "to rest" H3240)

נוחה.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.21; ; son of: Benjamin (H1144); ; brother of: Bela (H1106A), Becher (H1071), Ashbel (H0788), Gera (H1617), Ehi (H0278), Rosh (H7220), Muppim (H4649), Huppim (H2650H), Ard (H0714), Ahiram (H0297) and Jediael (H3043); also called Nohah at 1Ch.8.2; ; Another name of na.a.man (נַעֲמָן "Naaman" H5283G) ; § Nohah = "rest"; the 4th son of Benjamin;

נוית.definition: ; § Naioth = "habitations"; a dwelling place of prophets in the time of Samuel;
