עוית.definition: ; § Avith = "ruins"; the city of Hadad Ben-Bedad, one of the kings of Edom;
עוית.grammar_note: or perhaps (עַיּוֹת (as if plural of H5857 (עַי)) (עַיוּת; from H5753 (עָוָה); ruin;

עול.definition: injustice, unrighteousness; Another spelling of av.lah (עַוְלָה "injustice" H5766B)

עולם.definition: : enduring/eternal; 1) long duration, antiquity, futurity, for ever, ever, everlasting, evermore, perpetual, old, ancient, world; 1a) ancient time, long time (of past); 1b) (of future); 1b1) for ever, always; 1b2) continuous existence, perpetual; 1b3) everlasting, indefinite or unending future, eternity

עון.definition: : punishment; 1) perversity, depravity, iniquity, guilt or punishment of iniquity; 1a) iniquity; 1b) guilt of iniquity, guilt (as great), guilt (of condition); 1c) consequence of or punishment for iniquity

עונה.grammar_note: from an unused root apparently meaning to dwell together;

עוף.definition: v; 1) to fly, fly about, fly away; 1a)(Qal); 1a1) to fly, hover; 1a2) to fly away; 1b) (Hiphil) to cause to fly, light upon; 1c) (Polel); 1c1) to fly about or to and fro; 1c2) to cause to fly to and fro, brandish; 1d) (Hithpolel) to fly away; 2) (Qal) to cover, be dark
עוף.grammar_note: a primitive root; to cover (with wings or obscurity); hence (as denominative from H5775 (עוֹף))

עופרת.grammar_note: or עֹפֶרֶת; feminine participle active of H6080 (עָפַר);

עופי.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at Jer.40.8 ; § Ephai = "gloomy"; a Netophathite, whose sons were among the captains of the forces left in Judah after the deportation to Babylon;

עוק.definition: 1) (Hiphil) to totter, cause to totter, crush; 1a) meaning uncertain

עור.definition: 1) to rouse oneself, awake, awaken, incite; 1a) (Qal) to rouse oneself, awake; 1b) (Niphal) to be roused; 1c) (Polel) to stir up, rouse, incite; 1d) (Hithpolel) to be excited, be triumphant; 1e) (Hiphil); 1e1) to rouse, stir up; 1e2) to act in an aroused manner, awake
עור.grammar_note: a primitive root (rather identical with through the idea of opening the eyes);

עוש.definition: (Qal) to lend aid, come to help, hasten

עות.definition: 1) to be bent, be crooked, bend, make crooked, pervert; 1a)(Piel); 1a1) to make crooked, falsify, pervert, subvert; 1a2) to bend, make crooked; 1b) (Pual) thing bent (participle); 1c) (Hithpael) to bend oneself

עותי.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at 1Ch.9.4; ; son of: Ammihud (H5989K); § Uthai = "helpful"; 1) son of Ammihud and a descendant of Pharez of Judah; 2) one of the sons of Bigvai who returned from exile with the 2nd caravan with Ezra

עז.definition: 1) might, strength; 1a) material or physical; 1b) personal or social or political

עזא.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.6.3; ; son of: Abinadab (H0041); ; brother of: Eleazar (H0499H) and Ahio (H0283); also called Perez-uzzah at 2Sa.6.8; ; Also named: pe.rets uz.za (פֶּרֶץ עֻזָּא "Perez-uzzah" H6560H); § Uzza or Uzzah = "strength"; 1) a man slain by Jehovah for touching the sacred ark; 2) a Benjamite of the sons of Ehud; 3) ancestor of a family of temple slaves who returned from exile with Zerubbabel; 4) the garden where kings Manasseh and Amon of Judah were buried
עזא.grammar_note: or עֻזָּה; feminine of H5797 (עֹז); strength;

עזאזל.definition: 1) entire removal, scapegoat; 1a) refers to the goat used for sacrifice for the sins of the people; 1b) meaning uncertain ; Azazel

עזב.definition: 1) to leave, loose, forsake; 1a) (Qal) to leave; 1a1) to depart from, leave behind, leave, let alone; 1a2) to leave, abandon, forsake, neglect, apostatise; 1a3) to let loose, set free, let go, free; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be left to; 1b2) to be forsaken; 1c) (Pual) to be deserted

עזבון.grammar_note: from H5800 (עָזַב) in the sense of letting go (for a price, i.e. selling);

עזבוק.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.3.16; ; father of: Nehemiah (H5166I) ; § Azbuk = "strong devastation"; father of Nehemiah, leader of half the district of Beth Zur, and a repairer of the walls of Jerusalem under another Nehemiah;
עזבוק.grammar_note: from H5794 (עַז) and the root of H950 (בּוּקָה); stern depopulator;

עזגד.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.12; § Azgad = "Gad is mighty"; 1) ancestor of a family of laymen who returned from exile with Zerubbabel; 2) a man who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah
עזגד.grammar_note: from H5794 (עַז) and H1409 (גָּד); stern troop;

עזה.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.6.29; ; son of: Shimei (H8096M); ; father of: Shimea (H8092); § Uzza or Uzzah = "strength"; a Merarite Levite

עזור.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.10.17; § Azur or Azzur = "he that assists"; 1) a Benjamite of Gibeon, father of the false prophet Hananiah; 2) father of Jaazaniah, one of the princes against whom Ezekiel was commanded to prophecy

עזז.definition: 1) to be strong; 1a) (Qal) to be strong, prevail; 1b) (Hiphil) to make firm, strengthen

עזזיהו.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.15.21; § Azaziah = "Jehovah is mighty"; 1) a Levite musician in the reign of David who played the harp in the procession which brought the ark from Obed-edom to Jerusalem; 2) a Levite in the reign of king Hezekiah of Judah in charge of the tithes; 3) father of Hoshea, prince of the tribe of Ephraim when David took the census
עזזיהו.grammar_note: from H5810 (עָזַז) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has strengthened;

עזי.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.6.5; ; son of: Bukki (H1231H); ; father of: Zerahiah (H2228); § Uzzi = "strong"; 1) a Levite, son of Bukki and father of Zerahiah in the line of the high priest although apparently never high priest himself; 2) son of Tola and grandson of Issachar; 3) a Benjamite, son of Bela and head of a family of Benjamin; 4) son of Michri and father of Elah and an ancestor of a family of returned exiles settling in Jerusalem. Maybe same as 3; 5) a Levite, son of Bani, and an overseer of the Levites in Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah; 6) a priest, chief of the father's house of Jedaiah, in the time of Joiakim the high priest; 7) one of the priests who helped Ezra in the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem. Maybe same as 6

עזיא.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.11.44 ; § Uzzia = "strength of Jehovah"; one of David's mighty warriors;

עזיאל.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.15.18; also called Aziel at 1Ch.15.20; ; Another name of ya.a.zi.el (יַעֲזִיאֵל "Jaaziel" H3268) ; § Aziel = "whom God comforts"; a Levite; also 'Jaaziel';
עזיאל.grammar_note: from H5756 (עוּז) and H410 (אֵל); strengthened of God;

עזיאלי.definition: Someone descended from Uzziel who was a man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.6.18; ; son of: Kohath (H6955); ; brother of: Amram (H6019), Izhar (H3324) and Hebron (H2275B); ; father of: Mishael (H4332), Elizaphan (H0469), Sithri (H5644), Micah (H4318J) and Isshiah (H3449I); Group of uz.zi.el (עֻזִּיאֵל "Uzziel" H5816) ; § Uzzielites, of Uzziel "my strength is God"; descendants of Uzziel;

עזיה.definition: Uzzijah, the name of five Israelites
עזיה.grammar_note: or עֻזִּיָּהוּ; from H5797 (עֹז) and H3050 (יָהּ); strength of Jah;

עזיזא.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Ezr.10.27 ; § Aziza = "strong"; a layman of the family of Zattu who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra;

עזמות.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.23.31; § Azmaveth = "strong unto death"; 1) one of David's mighty warriors; 2) a descendant of Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan and grandson of king Saul; 3) a Benjamite, father of Jeziel and Pelet who were two of David's men who joined him at Ziklag; 4) overseer of the royal treasures in the reign of David; 5) a place in Benjamin; also 'Beth-azmeveth'
עזמות.grammar_note: from H5794 (עַז) and H4194 (מָוֶת); strong one of death;

עזן.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.34.26; ; father of: Paltiel (H6409) ; § Azzan = "very strong"; father of Paltiel prince of the tribe of Issachar who represented his tribe in the division of the promised land;

עזניה.definition: 1) an unclean bird of prey; 1a) osprey, black eagle, buzzard; 1b) perhaps an extinct bird, exact meaning unknown

עזקא.grammar_note: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H5823 (עָזַק);

עזר.definition: 1) to help, succour, support; 1a) (Qal) to help; 1b) (Niphal) to be helped; 1c) (Hiphil) to help

עזרא.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.7.1; ; son of: Seraiah (H8304H); ; brother of: Jehozadak (H3087); Also named: ez.ra (עֶזְרָא "Ezra" H5831); § Ezra = "help"; 1) the priest and scribe who led the reforms of the returned exiles in Jerusalem; co-worker with Nehemiah; 2) a priest with Zerubbabel; 3) another post-exilic Jew

עזראל.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.12.6; § Azarael or Azareel = "God has helped"; 1) a Korhite warrior of David who joined him at Ziklag; 2) a Levite musician of the family of Heman in the time of David; 3) a Danite, son of Jeroham and a prince of the tribe at the census of David; 4) one of the sons of Bani who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra; 5) a priest, ancestor of Maasiai or Amashai, a priest in Jerusalem after the return from exile; 6) a priest and musician in the time of Nehemiah
עזראל.grammar_note: from H5826 (עָזַר) and H410 (אֵל); God has helped;

עזרה.definition: 1) enclosure; 1a) ledge (surrounding Ezekiel's altar); 1b) court (outer one of temple)
עזרה.grammar_note: or עֶזְרָת; (Psalm 60:11 (13); Psalm 108:12 (13)), feminine of H5828 (עֵזֶר);

עזרי.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.27.26; ; son of: Chelub (H3620H) ; § Ezri = "help of Jehovah"; son of Chelub and superintendent of king David's farm labourers;

עזריאל.definition: A man of the tribe of Manasseh living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.5.24; § Azriel = "my help is God"; 1) a head of a house of the half-tribe of Manasseh beyond the Jordan; 2) a Naphtalite, ancestor of Jerimoth, the head of the tribe at the time of the census of David; 3) father of Seraiah, an officer of king Jehoiakim of Judah
עזריאל.grammar_note: from H5828 (עֵזֶר) and H410 (אֵל); help of God;

עזריה.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.2.8; ; son of: Ethan (H0387H); § Azariah = "Jehovah has helped"; 1) son of king Amaziah of Judah and king of Judah himself for 52 years; also 'Uzziah'; 2) the godly friend of Daniel who Nebuchadnezzar renamed Abednego; one of the three friends who with Daniel refused to make themselves unclean by eating food from the king's table which went against the dietary laws which God had given the Jews; also one of the three who were thrown into the fiery furnace for refusing to bow down to a graven image of Nebuchadnezzar and who were saved by the angel of the Lord; 2a) also, 'Abednego' (H5664 or H5665); 3) son of Nathan and an officer of Solomon; perhaps David's grandson and Solomon's nephew; 4) a prophet in the days of king Asa of Judah; 5) son of king Jehoshaphat of Judah and brother to 5; 6) another son of king Jehoshaphat of Judah and brother to 4; 7) a priest, son of Ahimaaz, grandson of Zadok and high priest in the reign of king Solomon; 8) the high priest in the reign of king Uzziah of Judah; 9) a priest who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah; probably same as 18; 10) a Kohathite Levite, father of Joel in the reign of king Hezekiah of Judah; 11) a Merarite Levite, son of Jehalelel in the reign of king Hezekiah of Judah; 12) a Kohathite Levite, son of Zephaniah and ancestor of Samuel the prophet; 13) a Levite who helped Ezra in instructing the people in the law; 14) son of Jeroham and one of the temple captains of Judah in the time of queen Athaliah; probably the same as 21; 15) son of Maaseiah who repaired part of the wall of Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah; 16) one of the leaders who returned from Babylon with Zerubbabel; 17) a man who assisted in the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah; probably the same as 10; 18) son of Johanan, one of the captains of Ephraim in the reign of king Ahaz of Judah; 19) a Judaite, son of Ethan of the sons of Zerah; 20) a Judaite, son of Jehu of the family of the Jerahmeelites and descended from Jarha the Egyptian slave of Sheshan; probably one of the captains of the time of queen Athaliah and the same as 15; 21) a priest, son of Hilkiah; 22) a priest, son of Johanan; 23) son of king Jehoram of Judah; probably clerical error for 'Ahaziah'; 24) son of Meraioth; 25) son of Hoshaiah and one of the proud men who confronted Jeremiah
עזריה.grammar_note: or עֲזַרְיָהוּ; from H5826 (עָזַר) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has helped;

עזריקם.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.3.23; ; son of: Neariah (H5294); ; brother of: Elioenai (H0454B) and Hizkiah (H2396H); § Azrikam = "help against the enemy"; 1) son of Neariah and descendant of Zerubbabel of the royal line of Judah; 2) a Benjamite, eldest son of Azel and descendant of Saul; 3) a Levite, ancestor of Shemaiah in the time of Nehemiah; 4) governor of the palace of king Ahaz of Judah and victim of murder by Zichri
עזריקם.grammar_note: from H5828 (עֵזֶר) and active participle of H6965 (קוּם); help of an enemy;

עזתי.definition: Gazathites or Gazites, of Gaza "the strong"; an inhabitant of the city of Gaza; Another name of az.zah (עַזָּה "Gaza" H5804)

עט.definition: 1) stylus; 1a) iron stylus with diamond tip used to write on stone or metal; 1b) reed pen used on a roll
עט.grammar_note: from H5860 (עִיט) (contracted) in the sense of swooping, i.e. side-long stroke;

עטה.definition: 1) to cover, enwrap, wrap oneself, envelop oneself; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to wrap, envelop oneself; 1a2) to cover (the beard in mourning); 1a3) mourner, one who covers (participle); 1b) (Hiphil) to cover, enwrap, envelop

עטין.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning apparently to contain;

עטישה.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to sneeze;

עטף.definition: 1) to be feeble, be faint, grow weak; 1a) (Qal) to be feeble, be faint; 1b) (Niphal) to faint; 1c) (Hiphil) to show feebleness; 1d) (Hithpael) to faint, faint away

עטר.definition: 1) to crown, give a crown; 1a) (Piel) to crown; 1b) (Hiphil) crown-bestower (participle)

עטרות.definition: ; § Ataroth = "crowns"; a town east of the Jordan in Gilead, taken and built by the tribe of Gad

עטרות אדר.definition: ; § Ataroth-adar or Ataroth-addar = "crowns of glory"; a Gadite town on the west border of Benjamin;
עטרות אדר.grammar_note: from the same as H5852 (עֲטָרוֹת) and H146 (אַדָּר); crowns of Addar;

עטרות בית יואב.definition: ; § Ataroth = "the crowns of"; the house of Joab, a place in Judah;
עטרות בית יואב.grammar_note: from the same as H5852 (עֲטָרוֹת) and H1004 (בַּיִת) and H3097 (יוֹאָב); crowns of the house of Joab;

עטרות שופן.definition: ; § Atroth-shophan = "crowns of their rapine"; a town in the territory of Gad;
עטרות שופן.grammar_note: from the same as H5852 (עֲטָרוֹת) and a name otherwise unused (being from the same as H8226 (שָׂפַן)) meaning hidden; crowns of Shophan;

עי.definition: ruin, heap of ruins; Also means: be.i (בְּעִי "ruins" H1164)

עיבל.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.10.28; ; son of: Joktan (H3355); ; brother of: Almodad (H0486), Sheleph (H8026), Hazarmaveth (H2700), Jerah (H3392), Hadoram (H1913A), Uzal (H0187), Diklah (H1853), Abimael (H0039), Sheba (H7614H), Ophir (H0211), Havilah (H2341I) and Jobab (H3103); Another spelling of o.val (עוֹבָל "Obal" H5745); § Ebal = "stone" or "bare mountain"; Arabian people, descended from Joktan
עיבל.grammar_note: perhaps from an unused root probably meaning to be bald; bare;

עיון.definition: Ijon = "a ruin"; a place in the north of Palestine belonging to the tribe of Naphtali; Also named: dan ya.an (יַעַן "Jaan" H1842)

עיט.definition: 1) to dart greedily, swoop upon, rush upon; 1a) (Qal) to dart greedily

עיטם.definition: ; § Etam = "lair of wild beasts"; a cliff; site uncertain

עיי העברים.definition: ; § Ije-abarim = "ruins of Abarim"; a station of Israel in the wilderness on the southeast side of Moab
עיי העברים.grammar_note: from the plural of H5856 (עִי) and the plural of the active participle of H5674 (עָבַר) with the article interposed; ruins of the passers;

עיים.definition: ; § Iim = "ruins"; a station of Israel in the wilderness on the southeast side of Moab

עילום.definition: for ever, ever, everlasting, evermore, perpetual, old, ancient, world

עילי.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.23.28; also called Ilai at 1Ch.11.29; ; Another name of tsal.mon (צַלְמוֹן "Zalmon" H6756B) ; § Ilai = "exalted"; an Ahohite, one of David's mighty warriors;

עילם.definition: ; § Elam = "eternity"; a province east of Babylon and northeast of the lower Tigris
עילם.grammar_note: or עוֹלָם; (Ezra 10:2; Jeremiah 49:36), probably from H5956 (עָלַם); hidden, i.e. distant;

עין.definition: : before(the_eyes); 1) eye; 1a) eye; 1a1) of physical eye; 1a2) as showing mental qualities; 1a3) of mental and spiritual faculties (fig.)

עין גדי.definition: En-gedi = "fount of the kid"; a town in the wilderness of Judah on the western shore of the Dead Sea; Also named: chats.tson ta.mar (חַצֲצֹן תָּמָר "Hazazon-tamar" H2688)
עין גדי.grammar_note: from H5869 (עַיִן) and H1423 (גְּדִי); fountain of a kid;

עין גנים.definition: ; § En-gannim = "fountain of the garden"; a city in the low country of Judah
עין גנים.grammar_note: from H5869 (עַיִן) and the plural of H1588 (גַּן); fountain of gardens;

עיןדאר.grammar_note: or עֵין דּוֹר; or עֵין־דֹּר; from H5869 (עַיִן) and H1755 (דּוֹר); fountain of dwelling;

עין הקורא.definition: ; § En-hakkore = "spring of One calling"; the spring which the Lord brought forth in response to Samson's complaint of being thirsty after he had just killed 1000 men with the jawbone of an ass;
עין הקורא.grammar_note: from H5869 (עַיִן) and the active participle of H7121 (קָרָא); fountain of One calling;

עין חדה.definition: ; § En-haddah = "swift fountain"; one of the cities on the border of Issachar;
עין חדה.grammar_note: from H5869 (עַיִן) and the feminine of a derivative from H2300 (חָדַד); fountain of sharpness;

עין חצור.definition: ; § En-hazor = "fount of Hazor"; one of the fenced cities in the territory of Naphtali;
עין חצור.grammar_note: from H5869 (עַיִן) and the same as H2674 (חָצוֹר); fountain of a village;

עין חרד.definition: ; § En-harod = "spring of Herod"; a camping place of Gideon and Israel near the hill of Moreh;
עין חרד.grammar_note: from H5869 (עַיִן) and a derivative of H2729 (חָרַד); fountain of trembling;

עינים.definition: Enajim or Enam, a place in Palestine
עינים.grammar_note: or עֵינָם; dual of H5869 (עַיִן); double fountain;

עין משפט.definition: En-mishpat = "spring of judgment"; a place near southern Palestine coincident or the same place as Kadesh; Another name of qa.desh (קָדֵשׁ "Kadesh" H6946G)
עין משפט.grammar_note: from H5869 (עַיִן) and H4941 (מִשְׁפָּט); fountain of judgment;

עינן.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.1.15; ; father of: Ahira (H0299) ; § Enan = "having eyes"; a prince of the tribe of Naphtali at the census at Mount Sinai;

עין עגלים.definition: ; § En-eglaim = "fountain of the two calves"; a place on the Dead Sea; site uncertain;
עין עגלים.grammar_note: עַיִן and the dual of H5695 (עֵגֶל); fountain of two calves;

עין רגל.definition: ; § En-rogel = "fount of the fuller"; a place near Jerusalem on the border between Judah and Benjamin and from which the permanent source of the pool of Siloam comes;
עין רגל.grammar_note: from H5869 (עַיִן) and the active participle of H7270 (רָגַל); fountain of a traveller;

עין רמון.definition: En-rimmon = "fount of the pomegranate"; one of the places that the returning exiles reinhabited in Judah; Another name of a.yin (עַ֫יִן "Ain" H5871H)
עין רמון.grammar_note: from H5869 (עַיִן) and H7416 (רִמּוֹן); fountain of a pomegranate;

עין שמש.definition: ; § En-shemesh = "fountain of the sun"; a spring on the boundary of Judah on the south and Benjamin on the north;
עין שמש.grammar_note: from H5869 (עַיִן) and H8121 (שֶׁמֶשׁ); fountain of the sun;

עין תנים.definition: En-tannim = "fountain of the jackal"; a spring near Jerusalem
עין תנים.grammar_note: from H5869 (עַיִן) and the plural of H8565 (תַּן); fountain of jackals;

עין תפוח.definition: En-tappuah = "fountain of the apple-city"; a place on the border between Ephraim and Manasseh; Another name of tap.pu.ach (תַּפּוּחַ "Tappuah" H8599B)
עין תפוח.grammar_note: from H5869 (עַיִן) and H8598 (תַּפּוּחַ); fountain of an apple-tree;

עיף.definition: 1) to be faint, be weary; 1a) (Qal) to be faint, be weary

עיר.definition: #A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.12; ; son of: Tehinnah (H8468)
עיר.grammar_note: or (in the plural) עָר; or עָיַר; (Judges 10:4), from H5782 (עוּר)

עירא.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Sa.20.26; § Ira = "watchful of a city"; 1) the Jairite, one of David's great officers; 2) one of David's mighty warriors; 3) a Tekoite, son of Ikkesh, and another of David's mighty warriors

עירד.definition: A man living at the time before the Flood, first mentioned at Gen.4.18; ; son of: Enoch (H2585); ; father of: Mehujael (H4232) ; § Irad = "fleet"; son of Enoch, grandson of Cain, and father of Mehujael;
עירד.grammar_note: from the same as H6166 (עֲרָד); fugitive;

עיר המלח.grammar_note: from H5892 (עִיר) and H4417 (מֶלַח) with the article of substance interp.; city of (the) salt;

עיר התמרים.definition: Ir-hatmarim = "the city of palmtrees"; another name for 'Jericho'
עיר התמרים.grammar_note: from H5892 (עִיר) and the plural of H8558 (תָּמָר) with the article interpolated; city of the palmtrees;

עירו.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living before Israel's Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.15; ; son of: Caleb (H3612); ; brother of: Achsah (H5915), Elah (H0425J) and Naam (H5277) ; § Iru = "watch"; son of Caleb and grandson of Jephunneh;

עירי.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at 1Ch.7.7; ; son of: Bela (H1106A); ; brother of: Ard (H0714H), Naaman (H5283H), Ezbon (H0675H), Uzzi (H5813I), Uzziel (H5816I), Jerimoth (H3406), Addar (H0146H), Gera (H1617I), Abihud (H0031), Abishua (H0050H) and Ahoah (H0265) ; § Iri = "belonging to a city"; a Benjamite, son of Bela;

עיר נחש.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.12; ; son of: Tehinnah (H8468) ; § Ir-nahash = "city of a serpent"; city founded by a Judaite;
עיר נחש.grammar_note: from H5892 (עִיר) and H5175 (נָחָשׁ); city of a serpent;

עיר שמש.definition: Ir-shemesh = "city of the sun-god"; a city in Dan; probably the same as 'Beth-shemesh'; Another spelling of bet she.mesh (בֵּית שֶׁ֫מֶשׁ "Beth-shemesh" H1053)
עיר שמש.grammar_note: from H5892 (עִיר) and H8121 (שֶׁמֶשׁ); city of the sun;

עיש.definition: The constellation 1a) Great Bear, Ursa Major; 1b) (TWOT) Arcturus;

עכבור.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.36.38; ; father of: Baal-hanan (H1177) ; § Achbor = "mouse"; 1) father of king Baal-hanan of Edom; 2) son of Michaiah and contemporary of king Josiah of Judah

עכביש.grammar_note: probably from an unused root in the literal sense of entangling;

עכבר.grammar_note: probably from the same as H5908 (עַכָּבִישׁ) in the secondary sense of attacking;

עכו.definition: Accho = "his straitness"; a seaport town in Asher north of Mount Carmel and south or Tyre; Also named: Ptolemais (Πτολεμαΐς "Ptolemais" G4424)
עכו.grammar_note: apparently from an unused root meaning to hem in;

עכור.definition: ; Combined with e.meq (עֵ֫מֶק " Valley" H6010) ; the valley of trouble where Achan and his family were stoned ; This name means trouble, disturbance; ;

עכן.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jos.7.1; ; son of: Carmi (H3756H); Also named: a.khar (עָכָר "Achan" H5917) ; § Achan = "troubler"; a Judaite who violated God's specific ban on taking any loot from the captured city of Jericho and was stoned to death along with his family for this violation;
עכן.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to trouble; troublesome;

עכס.grammar_note: a primitive root; properly, to tie, specifically, with fetters; but used only as denominative from H5914 (עֶכֶס);

עכסה.definition: A woman living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jos.15.16; ; daughter of: Caleb (H3612); ; sister of: Iru (H5900), Elah (H0425J) and Naam (H5277); married to Othniel (H6274); § Achsah = "ankle chain" or "anklet"; the daughter of Caleb and wife of Caleb's brother Othniel to whom she was given as a reward for capturing Debir

עכר.definition: 1) to trouble, stir up, disturb, make (someone) taboo; 1a) (Qal) to disturb, trouble; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be disturbed, be stirred up; 1b2) disturbance, calamity (participle)

עכרן.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.1.13; ; father of: Pagiel (H6295) ; § Ocran = "troubled"; an Asherite, father of Pagiel;

עכשוב.definition: 1) asp, viper; 1a) asp, viper; 1b) perhaps spider
עכשוב.grammar_note: probably from an unused root meaning to coil;

על.definition: prep; 1) upon, on the ground of, according to, on account of, on behalf of, concerning, beside, in addition to, together with, beyond, above, over, by, on to, towards, to, against; 1a) upon, on the ground of, on the basis of, on account of, because of, therefore, on behalf of, for the sake of, for, with, in spite of, notwithstanding, concerning, in the matter of, as regards; 1b) above, beyond, over (of excess); 1c) above, over (of elevation or pre-eminence); 1d) upon, to, over to, unto, in addition to, together with, with (of addition); 1e) over (of suspension or extension); 1f) by, adjoining, next, at, over, around (of contiguity or proximity); 1g) down upon, upon, on, from, up upon, up to, towards, over towards, to, against (with verbs of motion); 1h) to (as a dative)
על.grammar_note: Wide range of meanings; takes pronominal suffixes

עלג.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to stutter;

עלה.definition: : establish/raise/bring; 1) to go up, ascend, climb; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to go up, ascend; 1a2) to meet, visit, follow, depart, withdraw, retreat; 1a3) to go up, come up (of animals); 1a4) to spring up, grow, shoot forth (of vegetation); 1a5) to go up, go up over, rise (of natural phenomenon); 1a6) to come up (before God); 1a7) to go up, go up over, extend (of boundary); 1a8) to excel, be superior to; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be taken up, be brought up, be taken away; 1b2) to take oneself away; 1b3) to be exalted; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to bring up, cause to ascend or climb, cause to go up; 1c2) to bring up, bring against, take away; 1c3) to bring up, draw up, train; 1c4) to cause to ascend; 1c5) to rouse, stir up (mentally); 1c6) to offer, bring up (of gifts); 1c7) to exalt; 1c8) to cause to ascend, offer; 1d) (Hophal); 1d1) to be carried away, be led up; 1d2) to be taken up into, be inserted in; 1d3) to be offered; 1e) (Hithpael) to lift oneself
עלה.pattern: Qal: go up; Niphal: be exalted; Hiphil: bring up; Hophal: be brought up

עלוה.definition: injustice, unrighteousness, iniquity; Another spelling of av.lah (עַוְלָה "injustice" H5766B)

עלום.definition: (only in plural as abstract) adolescence; figuratively, vigor
עלום.grammar_note: passive participle of H5956 (עָלַם) in the denominative sense of H5958 (עֶלֶם);

עלוקה.grammar_note: feminine passive participle of an unused root meaning to suck;

עלטה.grammar_note: feminine from an unused root meaning to cover;

עלי.definition: highest, the Most High; Aramaic of il.li (עִלִּי "upper" H5942)

עליון.definition: ; Aramaic of ye.ho.vah (יהוה "LORD" H3068) ; This name means the Highest,

עליל.grammar_note: from H5953 (עָלַל) in the sense of completing;

עלילה.definition: 1) wantonness, deed, doing; 1a) wantonness; 1b) deed; 1c) practices, evil deeds
עלילה.grammar_note: or עֲלִלָה; from H5953 (עָלַל) in the sense of effecting;

עלל.definition: 1) to act severely, deal with severely, make a fool of someone; 1a) (Poel) to act severely; 1b) (Poal) to be severely dealt with; 1c) (Hithpael) to busy oneself, divert oneself, deal wantonly, deal ruthlessly, abuse (by thrusting through); 1d) (Hithpoel) to practise practices, thrust forth (in wickedness)
עלל.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √ʿll 'to enter'. Aramaic verb for 'enter' (Hebrew בוא).

עללה.definition: only in plural gleanings; by extension gleaning-time

עלם.definition: 1) to conceal, hide, be hidden, be concealed, be secret; 1a) (Qal) secret (participle); 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be concealed; 1b2) concealed, dissembler (participle); 1c) (Hiphil) to conceal, hide; 1d) (Hithpael) to hide oneself

עלמה.definition: 1) virgin, young woman; 1a) of marriageable age; 1b) maid or newly married

עלמון.definition: Almon = "concealed"; a town in Benjamin allotted to the priests; Another name of a.le.met (עָלֶ֫מֶת "Alemeth" H5964G)
עלמון.grammar_note: from H5956 (עָלַם); hidden; See also H5963 (עַלְמֹן דִּבְלָתָיְמָה).

עלמות.definition: ; young women, soprano?; a term in psalm heading-Alamoth;

עלמי.grammar_note: (Aramaic) patrial from a name corresponding to H5867 (עֵילָם) contracted;

עלמן דבלתימה.definition: Almon-diblathaim = "concealing the two cakes"; a station of the Israelites in the wilderness of Moab; Also named: bet div.la.ta.yim (בֵּית דִּבְלָתָ֑יִם "Beth-diblathaim" H1015)
עלמן דבלתימה.grammar_note: from the same as H5960 (עַלְמוֹן) and the dual of H1960 (הֻיְּדָה) (compare H1015 (בֵּית דִּבְלָתַיִם)) with enclitic of direction; Almon towards Diblathajim;

עלמת.definition: Alameth or Alemeth = "covering"; a town in Benjamin; Also named: al.mon (עַלְמוֹן "Almon" H5960)

עלס.definition: 1) to rejoice; 1a) (Qal) to rejoice; 1b) (Niphal) to exult; 1b1) to flap joyously (of ostrich); 1c) (Hithpael) to delight oneself

עלע.definition: 1) to suck up (meaning uncertain); 1a) (Piel) to drink

עלף.definition: 1) to cover; 1a) (Pual) covered, encrusted (participle); 1b) (Hithpael) to enwrap oneself, disguise oneself, faint

עם.definition: : people/nation; 1) nation, people; 1a) people, nation; 1b) persons, members of one's people, compatriots, country-men

עמד.definition: : stand/stop/establish; 1) to stand, remain, endure, take one's stand; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to stand, take one's stand, be in a standing attitude, stand forth, take a stand, present oneself, attend upon, be or become servant of; 1a2) to stand still, stop (moving or doing), cease; 1a3) to tarry, delay, remain, continue, abide, endure, persist, be steadfast; 1a4) to make a stand, hold one's ground; 1a5) to stand upright, remain standing, stand up, rise, be erect, be upright; 1a6) to arise, appear, come on the scene, stand forth, appear, rise up or against; 1a7) to stand with, take one's stand, be appointed, grow flat, grow insipid; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to station, set; 1b2) to cause to stand firm, maintain; 1b3) to cause to stand up, cause to set up, erect; 1b4) to present (one) before (king); 1b5) to appoint, ordain, establish; 1c) (Hophal) to be presented, be caused to stand, be stood before

עמה.definition: 1) juxtaposition; 1a) used only as a prep; 1a1) close by, side by side with, alongside of, parallel with; 1a2) agreeing with, corresponding to, exactly as, close beside; 1a3) correspondingly to

עמוד.definition: 1) pillar, column; 1a) pillar; 1b) column, upright; 1c) column (of smoke)

עמון.definition: ; § Ammon = "tribal"; a people dwelling in Transjordan descended from Lot through Ben-ammi;

עמוני.definition: Someone descended from Meunit(?) of the Canaanites, first mentioned at 1Ch.4.41; Group of me.u.ni (מְעוּנִים "Meunite" H4586); § Ammonite, of Ammon "tribal"; descendants of Ammon and inhabitants of Ammon

עמונית.definition: A woman from Ammon, an Ammonitess, of Ammon "tribal"; a woman of Ammon; Group of am.mon (עַמּוֹן "Ammon" H5983)

עמוס.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at Amo.1.1 ; § Amos = "burden"; a prophet of the Lord who prophesied in the northern kingdom; native of Tekoa in Judah near Bethlehem and a shepherd by trade; author of the prophetic book by his name;

עמוק.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Neh.12.7 ; § Amok = "to be deep"; a priest who returned with Zerubbabel;

עמיאל.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.13.12; ; son of: Gemalli (H1582); § Ammiel = "my kinsman is God"; 1) the spy from the tribe of Dan who perished in the plague for his evil report; 2) father of Machir of Lo-debar; 3) father of Bathsheba; also 'Eliam'; 4) the 6th son of Obed-edom and doorkeeper of the temple
עמיאל.grammar_note: from H5971 (עַם) and H410 (אֵל); people of God;

עמיהוד.definition: A man of the tribe of Ephraim living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.1.10; ; son of: Ladan (H3936); ; father of: Elishama (H0476); § Ammihud = "my kinsman is majesty"; 1) an Ephraimite, father of Elishama, the chief of the tribe at the time of the exodus; 2) a Simeonite, father of Shemuel; 3) father of Pedahel, prince of the tribe of Naphtali; 4) father of king Talmai of Geshur; 5) a descendant of Judah through his son Pharez
עמיהוד.grammar_note: from H5971 (עַם) and H1935 (הוֹד); people of splendor;

עמיזבד.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.27.6; ; son of: Benaiah (H1141) ; § Ammizabad = "my people have bestowed"; son of Benaiah, who commanded the 3rd division of David's army;
עמיזבד.grammar_note: from H5971 (עַם) and H2064 (זָבַד); people of endowment;

עמיחור.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Sa.13.37; ; father of: Talmai (H8526H); Another name of am.mi.hud (עַמִּיהוּד "Ammihud" H5989J) ; § Ammihud = "people of majesty"; a ruler of Syria;
עמיחור.grammar_note: from H5971 (עַם) and H2353 (חוּר); people of nobility;

עמינדב.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.6.23; ; son of: Ram (H7410); ; father of: Elisheba (H0472) and Nahshon (H5177); Also named: Aminadab (Ἀμιναδάβ "Amminadab" G0284); § Amminadab = "my kinsman is noble"; 1) son of Ram or Aram and father of Nahshon or Naasson and an ancestor of Jesus; father-in-law of Aaron; 2) a Kohathite Levite and chief of the sons of Uzziel; 3) a Levite, son of Kohath; also 'Izhar'
עמינדב.grammar_note: from H5971 (עַם) and H5068 (נָדַב); people of liberality;

עמי נדיב.definition: Amminadib = "my people are willing"; 1) an unknown person noted for the swiftness of his chariots; 1a) possibly not a person but should be translated 'my willing people' ; Combined with am (עַם "Ammi" H5971)
עמי נדיב.grammar_note: from H5971 (עַם) and H5081 (נָדִיב); my people (is) liberal;

עמיק.definition: adj; 1) deep; subst; 2) deep things, deep mysteries

עמיר.definition: swath, a row of fallen grain

עמישדי.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.1.12; ; father of: Ahiezer (H0295) ; § Ammishaddai = "my kinsman is Almighty"; father of Ahiezer, prince of the tribe of Dan at the time of the exodus;
עמישדי.grammar_note: from H5971 (עַם) and H7706 (שַׁדַּי); people of (the) Almighty;

עמית.grammar_note: from a primitive root meaning to associate;

עמל.definition: 1) toil, trouble, labour; 1a) trouble; 1b) trouble, mischief; 1c) toil, labour

עמלק.definition: Amalek = "dweller in a valley"; people in southern Canaan; 2) descendants of Amalek; Also named: a.ma.le.qi (עֲמָלֵקִי "Amalekite" H6003)

עמלקי.definition: Someone descended from Amekek ; Group of a.ma.leq (עֲמָלֵק "Amalek" H6002) ; § Amalekite, of Amalek "people of lapping"; descendants of Amalek, the grandson of Esau;

עמם.definition: 1) to dim, darken, grow dark; 1a) (Qal) to dim, eclipse, be held dark; 1b) (Hophal) to be dimmed, grow dark

עמנואל.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at Isa.7.14; ; son of: Joseph (G2501) and Mary (G3137); ; brother of: James (G2385I), Joseph (G2500), Simon (G4613H) and Jude (G2455I); Also named: Emmanouēl (Ἐμμανουήλ "Immanuel" G1694) ; § Immanuel = "God with us" or "with us is God"; symbolic and prophetic name of the Messiah, the Christ, prophesying that He would be born of a virgin and would be 'God with us';
עמנואל.grammar_note: from H5973 (עִם) and with a pronominal suffix inserted; with us (is) God;

עמס.definition: 1) to load, carry, carry a load; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to load; 1a2) to carry a load; 1b)(Hiphil) to lay a load on

עמסיה.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Ch.17.16; ; son of: Zichri (H2147N) ; § Amasiah = "Jehovah is strength"; son of Zichri and captain of 200,000 warriors of Judah in the reign of king Jehoshaphat of Judah;
עמסיה.grammar_note: from H6006 (עָמַס) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has loaded;

עמעד.definition: ; § Amad = "enduring"; a town in Asher on the border between Alammelech and Misheal;
עמעד.grammar_note: from H5971 (עַם) and H5703 (עַד); people of time;

עמק.definition: 1) deep, unfathomable; 1a) unintelligible (of speech); Aramaic equivalent: a.miq (עֲמִיק "deep" H5994)

עמר.definition: 1) to manipulate, deal tyrannically with; 1a) (Hithpael) to treat as a slave
עמר.grammar_note: a primitive root; properly, apparently to heap; figuratively, to chastise (as if piling blows); specifically (as denominative from H6016 (עֹמֶר))

עמרה.definition: Gomorrah = "submersion"; the twin-city in evil with Sodom, both destroyed in judgment by God with fire from heaven; Also named: Gomorra (Γόμορρα "Gomorrah" G1116)

עמרי.definition: A king of the Kingdom of Israel, living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.16.16; ; father of: Ahab (H0256); § Omri = "pupil of Jehovah"; 1) king of the northern kingdom of Israel, successor to king Elah for whom he was the captain of the army; ruled for 12 years and succeeded by his infamous son Ahab; 2) one of the sons of Becher the son of Benjamin; 3) a descendant of Pharez the son of Judah; 4) son of Michael and chief of the tribe of Issachar in the time of David

עמרם.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.6.18; ; son of: Kohath (H6955); ; brother of: Izhar (H3324), Hebron (H2275B) and Uzziel (H5816); married to Jochebed (H3115); ; father of: Moses (H4872), Aaron (H0175) and Miriam (H4813); Also named: am.ra.mi (עַמְרָמִי "Amramite" H6020); § Amram = "exalted people"; 1) a descendant of Kohath and Levi and father of Moses; 2) one of the sons of Bani who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
עמרם.grammar_note: probably from H5971 (עַם) and H7311 (רוּם); high people;

עמרמי.definition: Someone descended from Amram who was a man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.6.18; ; son of: Kohath (H6955); ; brother of: Izhar (H3324), Hebron (H2275B) and Uzziel (H5816); married to Jochebed (H3115); ; father of: Moses (H4872), Aaron (H0175) and Miriam (H4813); Group of am.ram (עַמְרָם "Amram" H6019) ; § Amramites, of Aram "exalted"; a branch of the Kohathite family of the tribe of Levi and descendants of Amram, the father of Moses;

עמשא.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.17.25; ; son of: Jether (H3500H) and Abigail (H0026H) ; § Amasa = "burden"; 1) son of Ithra or Jether by Abigail the sister of David and general of the army of Absalom; 2) son of Hadlai and a prince of Ephraim in the reign of king Ahaz

עמשי.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.6.25; ; son of: Elkanah (H0511I); ; father of: Ahimoth (H0287); § Amasai = "burdensome"; 1) a warrior and chief of the captains of Judah and Benjamin who joined David at Ziklag; 2) a Kohathite Levite, father of Mahath and ancestor of Samuel; 3) a priest who blew the trumpet before the ark; 4) another Kohathite Levite in the reign of king Hezekiah of Judah

עמשסי.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at 1Ch.9.12; ; son of: Adiel (H5717H); also called Amashsai (KJV: Amashai) at Neh.11.13; ; Another name of ma.a.say (מַעֲשַׂי "Maasai" H4640) ; § Amashai = "burdensome"; a priest, son of Azareel in the time of Nehemiah;

ענב.grammar_note: from the same as H6025 (עֵנָב); fruit;

ענג.definition: 1) to be soft, be delicate, be dainty; 1a) (Pual) to be delicate; 1b) (Hithpael); 1b1) to be of dainty habit, be pampered; 1b2) to be happy about, take exquisite delight; 1b3) to make merry over, make sport of

ענד.definition: 1) to bind, tie up, bind around or upon; 1a) (Qal) to tie up

ענה.definition: 1) to afflict, oppress, humble, be afflicted, be bowed down; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be put down, become low; 1a2) to be depressed, be downcast; 1a3) to be afflicted; 1a4) to stoop; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to humble oneself, bow down; 1b2) to be afflicted, be humbled; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to humble, mishandle, afflict; 1c2) to humble, be humiliated; 1c3) to afflict; 1d4) to humble, weaken oneself; 1d) (Pual); 1d1) to be afflicted; 1d2) to be humbled; 1e) (Hiphil) to afflict; 1f) (Hithpael); 1f1) to humble oneself; 1f2) to be afflicted; Aramaic equivalent: a.nah (עֲנָי "to afflict" H6033)
ענה.grammar_note: III-He verb; homograph with ענה II 'to be afflicted'

ענו.definition: 1) poor, humble, afflicted, meek; 1a) poor, needy; 1b) poor and weak; 1c) poor, weak and afflicted; 1d) humble, lowly, meek
ענו.grammar_note: or (by intermixture with H6041 (עָנִי)) עָנָיו; from H6031 (עָנָה);

ענוב.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.8; ; son of: Koz (H6976); ; brother of: Zobebah (H6637) and Harum (H2037) ; § Anub = "confederate"; son of Coz, descendant of Judah and Caleb through Ashur, the father of Tekoa;
ענוב.grammar_note: passive participle from the same as H6025 (עֵנָב); borne (as fruit);

ענוה.definition: humility, meekness; Also means: an.vah (עַנְוָה "gentleness" H6037)

עני.definition: 1) poor, afflicted, humble, wretched; 1a) poor, needy; 1b) poor and weak; 1c) poor, weak, afflicted, wretched; 1d) humble, lowly

עניה.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.8.4; § Anaiah = "Jehovah has answered"; a priest who helped Ezra and signed the covenant with Nehemiah

ענים.definition: ; § Anim = "fountains"; a town in the mountains of southern Judah;

ענם.definition: Anem = "fountains"; a Levitical city in Issachar allotted to the Gershonites; Another name of en gan.nim (עֵין גַּנִּים "En-gannim" H5873H)
ענם.grammar_note: from the dual of H5869 (עַיִן); two fountains;

ענמים.definition: People descended from Anam(?) of the Egyptians, first mentioned at Gen.10.13; descended from Egypt (H4714); along with Ludim (H3866), Lehabim (H3853), Naphtuhim (H5320), Pathrusim (H6625), Casluhim (H3695) and Caphtorim (H3732) ; § Anamim = "affliction of the waters"; a tribe of Egyptians;
ענמים.grammar_note: as if plural of some Egyptian word;

ענמלך.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 2Ki.17.31 ; § Anammelech = "image of the king"; an Assyrian false god introduced to Israel during the monarchy; worshipped with rites resembling those of Molech; companion god of 'Adrammelech';

ענן.definition: 1) (Poel) to practise soothsaying, conjure; 1a) to observe times, practice soothsaying or spiritism or magic or augury or witchcraft; 1b) soothsayer, enchanter, sorceress, diviner, fortuneteller, barbarian, Meonenim (participle)
ענן.grammar_note: a primitive root; to cover; used only as a denominative from H6051 (עָנָן), to cloud over;

ענני.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.3.24; ; son of: Elioenai (H0454B); ; brother of: Hodaviah (H1938), Eliashib (H0475), Pelaiah (H6411B), Akkub (H6126), Johanan (H3110I) and Delaiah (H1806) ; § Anani = "my cloud"; the 7th son of Elioenai, descendant of David;

ענניה.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.3.23; ; father of: Maaseiah (H4641P); § Ananiah = "Jehovah clouds"; 1) ancestor of Azariah who assisted in rebuilding the city wall in the time of Nehemiah; 2) a city northwest of Jerusalem to which some Benjamite exiles returned
ענניה.grammar_note: from H6049 (עָנַן) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has covered;

ענף.definition: bough, branch; Aramaic equivalent: a.naph (עֲנַף "bough" H6056)

ענק.definition: 1) to serve as a necklace, adorn with a neck ornament; 1a) (Qal) to serve as a necklace; 1b) (Hiphil) to make a necklace
ענק.grammar_note: a primitive root; properly, to choke; used only as denominative from H6060 (עָנָק),

ענקי.definition: Someone descended from Anak who was a man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Num.13.22; ; father of: Ahiman (H0289), Sheshai (H8344) and Talmai (H8526); also called Anakim at Deu.1.28; 2.10,11,21; 9.2; 1x,22; 14.12,15;; Group of a.naq (עֲנָק "Anak" H6061) ; § Anakims = "long-necked"; a tribe of giants, descendants of Anak, which dwelled in southern Canaan;

ענר.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.14.13; ; brother of: Mamre (H4471H) and Aner (H6063); § Aner = "boy"; 1) one of the Amorite chiefs who aided Abraham in the pursuit of the 4 invading kings; 2) a Levitical city west of the Jordan in Manasseh allotted to the Kohathite Levites

ענש.definition: 1) to fine, amerce, punish, condemn, mulct; 1a) (Qal) to fine, punish; 1b) (Niphal) to be fined, be punished, be mulcted

ענת.definition: A man living before Israel's Monarchy, first mentioned at Jdg.3.31; ; father of: Shamgar (H8044) ; § Anath = "answer"; father of Shamgar;

פעור.definition: ; § Peor = "cleft"; a mountain peak in Moab belonging to the Abarim range and near Pisgah

פצה.definition: 1) to part, open, separate, set free; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to open (mouth), utter; 1a2) to snatch away, set free

פתי.grammar_note: or פֶּתִי; or פְּתָאִי; from H6601 (פָּתָה);

צפעה.grammar_note: feminine from the same as H6848 (צֶפַע);
