צפצפה.definition: a kind of willow, willow tree

צפר.definition: 1) (Qal) to go early, depart early; 1a) meaning uncertain

צפרדע.grammar_note: from H6852 (צָפַר) and a word elsewhere unused meaning a swamp;

צפרה.definition: A woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.2.21; ; daughter of: Jethro (H3503); ; sister of: Eliasaph (H0460) and Hobab (H2246); married to Moses (H4872); ; mother of: Gershom (H1647) and Eliezer (H0461H) ; § Zipporah = "bird"; daughter of Reuel or Jethro, wife of Moses, and mother of Gershom and Eliezer;

צפרן.definition: 1) fingernail, stylus point; 1a) finger-nail; 1b) point (of a diamond); Aramaic equivalent: te.phar (טְפַר "nail/claw" H2953)
צפרן.grammar_note: from H6852 (צָפַר) (in the denominative sense (from H6833 (צִפּוֹר)) of scratching);

צפתה.definition: ; § Zephathah = "watch-tower"; a valley in western Judah;

צקלג.definition: ; § Ziklag = "winding"; a town in the south of Judah, later allotted to Simeon; noted for its having been the city of David given to him by king Achish of Gath and his residence when he was joined by many of his mighty warriors and when he received word of the death of Saul;
צקלג.grammar_note: or צִיקלַג; (1 Chronicles 12:1,20), of uncertain derivation;

צקלן.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to wind;

צר.definition: 1) flint, hard pebble; 1a) used as a knife
צר.grammar_note: or צָר; from H6887 (צָרַר); compare as in H6864 (צֹר)

צרב.definition: 1) to burn, scorch; 1a) (Niphal) to be scorched

צרדה.definition: ; § Zereda or Zeredathah = "fortress"; a town or territory in Manasseh and the home of Jeroboam
צרדה.grammar_note: or צְרֵדָתָה; apparently from an unused root meaning to pierce; puncture;

צרויה.definition: A woman living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.26.6; ; daughter of: Jesse (H3448) and Nahash (H5176I); ; sister of: David (H1732), Eliab (H0446I), Abinadab (H0041I), Nethanel (H5417H), Raddai (H7288), Ozem (H0684), Abigail (H0026H)(?) and Elihu (H0453J), Shimeah (H8093) ; § Zeruiah = "balsam"; sister of David and mother of the 3 leading heroes of David's army-Abishai, Joab, and Asahel;
צרויה.grammar_note: feminine passive participle from the same as H6875 (צְרִי); wounded;

צרועה.definition: A woman of the Kingdom of Israel, living at the time of United Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ki.11.26; married to Nebat (H5028); ; mother of: Jeroboam (H3379) ; § Zeruah = "full breasted"; wife of Nebat and mother of king Jeroboam I of the northern kingdom of Israel;
צרועה.grammar_note: feminine passive participle of H6879 (צָרַע); leprous;

צרח.definition: 1) to cry, roar, make a shrill or clear sound; 1a) (Qal) to roar; 1b) (Hiphil) to utter a roar, cry out (a battle cry)

צרי.definition: 1) a kind of balsam, balm, salve; 1a) as merchandise; 1b) as medicine

צריח.definition: 1) excavation, underground chamber, cellar, underground room; 1a) meaning uncertain
צריח.grammar_note: from H6873 (צָרַח) in the sense of clearness of vision;

צרך.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to need;

צרע.definition: 1) to be diseased of skin, be leprous; 1a) (Qal) to be a leper; 1b) (Pual) to have leprosy

צרעי.definition: Tsorite or Tsorathite, i.e. inhabitants of Tsorah

צרעת.definition: 1) leprosy; 1a) in people, malignant skin disease (Le 13:1-14:57); 1b) in clothing, a mildew or mould (Le 13:47-52); 1c) in buildings, a mildew or mould (Le 14:34-53)

צרף.definition: 1) to smelt, refine, test; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to smelt, refine; 1a2) to test; 1a3) to test (and prove true); 1a4) smelter, refiner, goldsmith (participle); 1b) (Niphal) to be refined; 1c) (Piel) to be a refiner; 1c1) refiner (participle)

צרפת.definition: Zarephath = "refinery"; a city on the coast south of Sidon and the residence of Elijah during the last part of the drought; modern 'Sura-fend'; Also named: Sarepta (Σάρεπτα "Zarephath" G4558)

צרר.definition: 1) to bind, be narrow, be in distress, make narrow, cause distress, besiege, be straitened, be bound; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to bind, tie up, shut up; 1a2) to be scant, be cramped, be in straits; 1b) (Pual) to be bound, be tied up; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to make narrow for, cause distress to, press hard upon

צררה.definition: Zererath = "oppression"; a town or territory in Manasseh and the home of Jeroboam; same as tse.re.dah (צְרֵדָה "Zeredah" H6868); Another name of tsa.re.tan (צָֽרְתָן "Zarethan" H6891)
צררה.grammar_note: apparently by erroneous transcription for H6868 (צְרֵדָה);

צרת.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.7; ; son of: Ashhur (H0806) and Helah (H2458); ; brother of: Haahashtari (H0326), Izhar (H3328), Ethnan (H0869) and Koz (H6976); ; half-brother of: Ahuzzam (H0275), Hepher (H2660) and Temeni (H8488) ; § Zereth = "splendour"; son of Ashur, the founder of Tekoa, by his wife Helah;

צרת השחר.definition: ; § Zareth-shahar = "splendour of the dawn"; a town in Reuben;
צרת השחר.grammar_note: from the same as H6889 (צֶרֶת) and H7837 (שַׁחַר) with the article interposed; splendor of the dawn;

צרתן.definition: ; § Zarthan or Zaretan = "their distress"; a place in the Jordan valley where the river parted for Israel to pass over for the conquest of Canaan;

קא.definition: vomit, what is vomited up; Another spelling of qi (קִיא "vomit" H6892B)

קאת.definition: 1) a ceremonially unclean bird; 1a) perhaps pelican or cormorant; 1b) perhaps an extinct bird, exact meaning unknown

קב.definition: 1) a dry measure-cab, kab; 1a) about 1.5 litres, 1/6 of a seah, or 1/18 of an ephah

קבב.definition: 1) to curse, utter a curse against; 1a) (Qal) to curse

קבה.definition: 1) stomach, belly, maw; 1a) stomach (of sacrificial victim); 1b) belly (of woman)

קבורה.grammar_note: or קְבֻרָה; feminine passive participle of H6912 (קָבַר);

קבל.definition: 1) to take, receive, be before; 1a) (Piel); 1a1) to take, choose, receive; 1a2) to accept; 1a3) to accept, assume; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to show oppositeness; 1b2) to correspond, receive one to the other; Aramaic equivalent: qe.val (קַבֵּל "to receive" H6902)
קבל.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √qbl 'to receive, accept'. Common in Rabbinic texts.

קבץ.definition: 1) to gather, assemble; 1a) (Qal) to gather, collect, assemble; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to assemble, gather; 1b2) to be gathered; 1c) (Piel) to gather, gather together, take away; 1d) (Pual) to be gathered together; 1e) (Hithpael) to gather together, be gathered together

קבצאל.definition: ; § Kabzeel = "God gathers"; the most remote city of Judah; located in southern Judah on the border of Edom;
קבצאל.grammar_note: from H6908 (קָבַץ) and H410 (אֵל); God has gathered;

קבצים.definition: Kibzaim = "two gatherings"; a Kohathite Levitical city in Ephraim at Mount Ephraim; Also named: yoq.me.am (יׇקְמְעָם "Jokmeam" H3361H)
קבצים.grammar_note: dual from H6908 (קָבַץ); a double heap;

קבר.definition: 1) to bury; 1a) (Qal) to bury; 1b) (Niphal) to be buried; 1c) (Piel) to bury, bury (in masses); 1d) (Pual) to be buried

קברות התאוה.definition: ; § Kibroth-hattaavah = "graves of lust"; a station of Israel in the wilderness 3 campsites away from Sinai near the gulf of Akabah;
קברות התאוה.grammar_note: from the feminine plural of H6913 (קֶבֶר) and H8378 (תַּאֲוָה) with the article interposed; graves of the longing;

קדוש.definition: : saint/priest; sacred, holy, Holy One, saint, set apart; A sub-meaning of qa.dosh (קָדוֹשׁ ": holy" H6918)

קדח.definition: 1) to kindle, be kindled; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to kindle; 1a2) to be kindled

קדים.definition: 1) east, east wind; 1a) east (of direction); 1b) east wind

קדם.definition: 1) to meet, come or be in front, confront, go before; 1a) (Piel); 1a1) to meet, confront, come to meet, receive; 1a2) to go before, go in front, be in front; 1a3) to lead, be beforehand, anticipate, forestall; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to come in front; 1b2) to confront, anticipate
קדם.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √qdm 'to be in front, precede'.

קדמה.definition: 1) antiquity, former state or estate or situation, before, origin; 1a) antiquity, beginning, origin; 1b) former state or situation conj; 1c) before; Aramaic equivalent: qad.mah (קַדְמָה "previously" H6928)

קדמות.definition: ; § Kedemoth = "eastern"; one of the towns in the district east of the Dead Sea allotted to the tribe of Reuben and given to the Merarite Levites;

קדמי.grammar_note: (Aramaic) from a root corresponding to H6923 (קָדַם);

קדמיאל.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.40; ; father of: Jeshua (H3442N) ; § Kadmiel = "God is the ancient one"; a Levite, descendant of Hodaviah, and head of a family of returning exiles; also oversaw the work on the temple and also was one of the leaders of the people who led the people in the public confession;
קדמיאל.grammar_note: from H6924 (קֶדֶם) and H410 (אֵל); presence of God;

קדמני.definition: : eastern; 1) former, ancient, eastern; 1a) former, ancient; 1b) eastern; Also means: qad.mo.ni (קַדְמֹנִי ": older" H6931H)
קדמני.grammar_note: the same as H6931 (קַדְמוֹנִי); ancient, i.e. aboriginal;

קדקד.definition: head, crown of head, top of head, hairy crown, scalp

קדר.definition: 1) to mourn, be dark; 1a) (Qal) to be dark; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to darken; 1b2) to cause to mourn; 1c) (Hithpael) to grow dark

קדרון.definition: ; § Kidron = "dark"; a stream east of Jerusalem;

קדש.definition: : consecate/sanctify; 1) to consecrate, sanctify, prepare, dedicate, be hallowed, be holy, be sanctified, be separate; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be set apart, be consecrated; 1a2) to be hallowed; 1a3) consecrated, tabooed; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to show oneself sacred or majestic; 1b2) to be honoured, be treated as sacred; 1b3) to be holy; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to set apart as sacred, consecrate, dedicate; 1c2) to observe as holy, keep sacred; 1c3) to honour as sacred, hallow; 1c4) to consecrate; 1d) (Pual); 1d1) to be consecrated; 1d2) consecrated, dedicated; 1e) (Hiphil); 1e1) to set apart, devote, consecrate; 1e2) to regard or treat as sacred or hallow; 1e3) to consecrate; 1f) (Hithpael); 1f1) to keep oneself apart or separate; 1f2) to cause Himself to be hallowed (of God); 1f3) to be observed as holy; 1f4) to consecrate oneself

קדש ברנע.definition: Kadesh-barnea = "holy"; a city in the extreme south of Judah; same as 'Kedesh' and 'Kadesh'; Another name of qa.desh (קָדֵשׁ "Kadesh" H6946G)
קדש ברנע.grammar_note: from the same as H6946 (קָדֵשׁ) and an otherwise unused word (apparently compounded of a correspondent to H1251 (בַּר) and a derivative of H5128 (נוּעַ)) meaning desert of a fugitive; Kadesh of (the) Wilderness of Wandering;

קהה.definition: 1) to be blunt, be dull; 1a) (Qal) to be blunt, be dull; 1b) (Piel) to be blunt

קהל.definition: 1) to assemble, gather; 1a) (Niphal) to assemble; 1a1) for religious reasons; 1a2) for political reasons; 1b) (Hiphil) to summon an assembly; 1b1) for war, judgment; 1b2) for religious purposes; Also means: qa.lah (קָלַהּ "to gather" H7035)

קהלת.definition: collector (of sentences), preacher, public speaker, speaker in an assembly, Qoheleth
קהלת.grammar_note: feminine of active participle from H6950 (קָהַל);

קהלתה.definition: ; § Kehelathah = "assembly"; a station of the Israelites during their wilderness wanderings;

קהת.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.11; ; son of: Levi (H3878); ; brother of: Gershon (H1648), Merari (H4847) and Jochebed (H3115); ; father of: Amram (H6019), Izhar (H3324), Hebron (H2275B) and Uzziel (H5816); Also named: qo.ha.ti (קְהָתִי "Kohathite" H6956) ; § Kohath = "assembly"; the 2nd of the 3 sons of Levi and progenitor of a family in the tribe of Levi;
קהת.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to ally oneself; allied;

קהתי.definition: Someone descended from Kohath who was a man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.11; ; son of: Levi (H3878); ; brother of: Gershon (H1648), Merari (H4847) and Jochebed (H3115); ; father of: Amram (H6019), Izhar (H3324), Hebron (H2275B) and Uzziel (H5816); Group of qe.hat (קְהָת "Kohath" H6955) ; § Kohathites, of Kohath "assembly"; the descendants of Kohath, the 2nd son of Levi;

קו.definition: 1) line, measuring-line; 2) (BDB) onomatapoetic mimicry of Isaiah's words, perhaps senseless

קוה.definition: 1) to wait, look for, hope, expect; 1a) (Qal) waiting (participle); 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to wait or look eagerly for; 1b2) to lie in wait for; 1b3) to wait for, linger for

קוט.definition: 1) to loathe, be grieved, feel a loathing; 1a) (Qal) to feel a loathing; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to feel loathing against self; 1b2) to detest; 1c) (Hithpolel) to loathe oneself; Also means: na.qat (נָקַט "to tire" H5354)

קול.definition: : [sound_of](THING); 1) voice, sound, noise; 1a) voice; 1b) sound (of instrument)
קול.grammar_note: or קֹל; from an unused root meaning to call aloud;

קוליה.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.11.7; ; son of: Maaseiah (H4641U); ; father of: Pedaiah (H6305L); § Kolaiah = "voice of Jehovah"; 1) father of the false prophet Ahab; 2) a Benjamite whose descendants settled in Jerusalem after the return from captivity; 3) a Levite in the time of Ezra
קוליה.grammar_note: from H6963 (קוֹל) and H3050 (יָהּ); voice of Jah;

קום.definition: : establish/stand_firm/confirm/fulfill/fix; 1) to rise, arise, stand, rise up, stand up; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to arise; 1a2) to arise (hostile sense); 1a3) to arise, become powerful; 1a4) to arise, come on the scene; 1a5) to stand; 1a5a) to maintain oneself; 1a5b) to be established, be confirmed; 1a5c) to stand, endure; 1a5d) to be fixed; 1a5e) to be valid; 1a5f) to be proven; 1a5g) to be fulfilled; 1a5h) to persist; 1a5i) to be set, be fixed; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to fulfil; 1b2) to confirm, ratify, establish, impose; 1c) (Polel) to raise up; 1d) (Hithpael) to raise oneself, rise up; 1e) (Hiphil); 1e1) to cause to arise, raise; 1e2) to raise, set up, erect, build; 1e3) to raise up, bring on the scene; 1e4) to raise up, rouse, stir up, investigate; 1e5) to raise up, constitute; 1e6) to cause to stand, set, station, establish; 1e7) to make binding; 1e8) to carry out, give effect to; 1f) (Hophal) to be raised up
קום.pattern: Qal: rise; Hiphil: raise up, establish; Polel: raise up

קון.definition: to strike a musical note, i.e. chant or wail (at a funeral)

קוע.definition: ; § Koa = "he-camel"; a territory in Mesopotamia, east of the Tigris, on border of Elam and Media;
קוע.grammar_note: probably from H6972 (קוּץ) in the original sense of cutting off; curtailment;

קוץ.definition: 1) to be grieved, loathe, abhor, feel a loathing or abhorrence or sickening dread; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to feel a loathing at, abhor; 1a2) to feel a sickening dread; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to cause sickening dread; 1b2) to cause loathing
קוץ.grammar_note: a primitive root; to clip off; used only as denominative from H7019 (קַיִץ);

קוצה.grammar_note: feminine passive participle of H6972 (קוּץ) in its original sense;

קוקו.grammar_note: from H6957 (קַו) (in the sense of a fastening);

קור.definition: (Qal) to bore, dig, dig for water
קור.grammar_note: a primitive root; also denominative from H7023 (קִיר)

קורא.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at 1Ch.9.19; ; son of: Ebiasaph (H0043); ; brother of: Assir (H0617H); also called Korahite at 1Ch.26.19; 1x; § Kore = "crier"; 1) a Korahite Levite, ancestor of Shallum and Meshelemiah, chief porters in the reign of David; 2) a Levite, son of Imnah, in the reign of king Hezekiah of Judah
קורא.grammar_note: or קֹרֵא; (1 Chronicles 26:1), active participle of H7121 (קָרָא); crier;

קוש.definition: (Qal) to lay bait or lure, lay a snare, lure
קוש.grammar_note: a primitive root; to bend; used only as denominative for H3369 (יָקֹשׁ),

קושיהו.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.6.44; ; son of: Abdi (H5660); ; father of: Jeduthun (H3038); also called Kushaiah at 1Ch.15.17; ; Another name of qi.shi (קִישִׁי "Kishi" H7029) ; § Kushaiah = "bow of Jehovah"; 1) father of Ethan the Merarite; 1a) same as 'Kish' or 'Kishi';
קושיהו.grammar_note: from the passive participle of H6983 (קוֹשׁ) and H3050 (יָהּ); entrapped of Jah;

קט.definition: 1) a small thing, little, merely (adv); 1a) meaning uncertain
קט.grammar_note: from H6990 (קָטַט) in the sense of abbreviation;

קטב.definition: destruction; Another spelling of qe.tev (קֶ֫טֶב "destruction" H6986)
קטב.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to cut off;

קטל.definition: 1) to slay, kill; 1a) (P'al) to be slain; 1b) (Pael) to slay; 1c) (Ithp'al) to be slain; 1d) (Ithpael) to be slain
קטל.grammar_note: Used as paradigm for strong verb conjugation
קטל.pattern: Qal perfect paradigm: קָטַל, קָטְלָה, קָטַלְתָּ, etc.

קטן.definition: 1) to be small, be insignificant; 1a) (Qal) to be insignificant; 1b) (Hiphil) to make small, reduce significantly
קטן.grammar_note: a primitive root (rather denominative from H6996 (קָטָן));

קטף.definition: 1) to pluck off or out, cut off; 1a) (Qal) to pluck off; 1b) (Niphal) to be plucked off

קטר.definition: : perfume; v; 1) to sacrifice, burn incense, burn sacrifices, make sacrifices smoke; 1a) (Piel); 1a1) to make sacrifices smoke; 1a2) to sacrifice; 1b) (Pual) to smoke a sacrifice; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to make sacrifices smoke; 1c2) to cause incense to smoke, offer incense; 1c3) to make smoke upon; 1d) (Hophal) to be made to smoke
קטר.grammar_note: a primitive root (identical with through the idea of fumigation in a close place and perhaps thus driving out the occupants);

קטרת.definition: 1) incense, smoke, odour of (burning) sacrifice; 1a) sweet smoke of sacrifice; 1b) incense; 1c) perfume

קטת.definition: Kattath = "small"; a town in Zebulun; Another name of qit.ron (קִטְרוֹן "Kitron" H7003)

קין.grammar_note: from H6969 (קוּן) in the original sense of fixity;

קיני.definition: Ancestors of Heber (H2268H) or Hobab (H2246), first mentioned at Gen.15.19; Also named: qa.yin (קַ֫יִן "Kenite" H7014) ; § Kenite = "smiths"; the tribe from which the father-in-law of Moses was a member and which lived in the area between southern Palestine and the mountains of Sinai;
קיני.grammar_note: or קִינִי; (1 Chronicles 2:55), patronymic from H7014 (קַיִן);

קינן.definition: 1) to chant a dirge, chant, wail, lament; 1a) (Polel) to lament
קינן.grammar_note: from the same as H7064 (קֵן); fixed;

קיץ.definition: 1) summer, summer-fruit; 1a) summer; 1b) summer-fruit; Aramaic equivalent: qa.yit (קַ֫יִט "summer" H7007)

קיקיון.definition: 1) a plant; 1a) perhaps a gourd, castor-oil plant, bottle-gourd

קיר.definition: 1) wall, side; 1a) wall (of house or chamber); 1b) the sides (of the altar)
קיר.grammar_note: or קִר; (Isaiah 22:5), or (feminine) קִירָה; from H6979 (קוּר);

קיר חרש.definition: Kir-hareseth or Kir-hares or Kir-haresh = "wall of potsherds"; one of the two chief strongholds of Moab; Another name of qir (קִיר "Kir" H7024B)
קיר חרש.grammar_note: or (feminine of the latter word) קִיר חֲרֶשֶׂת; from H7023 (קִיר) and H2789 (חֶרֶשׂ); fortress of earthenware;

קירס.grammar_note: or קֵרֹס; from the same as H7166 (קַרְסֹל); ankled;

קיש.definition: A man of the tribe of Benjamin living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Sa.9.1; ; son of: Abiel (H0022) and Maacah (H4601N); ; brother of: Ner (H5369), Abdon (H5658J), Zur (H6698I), Baal (H1168B), Nadab (H5070J), Gedor (H1446I), Ahio (H0283I), Zecher (H2144) and Mikloth (H4732); ; father of: Saul (H7586G); Also named: Kis (Κίς "Kish" G2797); § Kish = "bent"; 1) a Benjamite of the family of Matri, father of king Saul; 2) an ancestor of Mordecai; 3) son of Gibeon and brother of Abdon, Zur, Baal, Ner, Nadab, Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth; uncle of Kish the father of king Saul; 4) a Merarite Levite, son of Mahli and grandson of Merari the progenitor of the family; 5) a Merarite Levite, son of Abdi in the time of king Hezekiah of Judah

קישון.definition: ; § Kishon = "winding"; a river in central Palestine; scene of the defeat of Sisera by the Israelites in the time of the judges and the destruction of the prophets of Baal by Elijah;

קישי.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.6.44; ; son of: Abdi (H5660); ; father of: Jeduthun (H3038); also called Kushaiah at 1Ch.15.17; ; Also named: qu.sha.ya.hu (קוּשָׁיָ֫הוּ "Kushaiah" H6984) ; § Kishi = "bow of Jehovah"; a Merarite Levite, father or ancestor of Ethan the minstrel in the time of David;

קל.definition: : sound; voice, sound; Aramaic of qol (קוֹל ": sound" H6963H)

קלה.definition: 1) to disgrace, dishonour, be lightly esteemed, be dishonoured, be despised; 1a) (Niphal) to be dishonoured, be despised, be lightly esteemed; 1b) (Hiphil) to treat with contempt, dishonour, treat shamefully
קלה.grammar_note: a primitive root (rather identical with H7034 (קָלָה) through the idea of shrinkage by heat);

קלון.definition: 1) shame, disgrace, dishonour, ignominy; 1a) ignominy (of nation); 1b) dishonour, disgrace (personal)

קלחת.grammar_note: apparently but a form for H6747 (צַלַּחַת);

קלט.definition: (Qal) to be stunted, be handicapped, be deformed (of a sacrificial animal lacking body parts)

קלי.definition: 1) parched grain, roasted grain; 1a) a common food

קליה.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Ezr.10.23; also called Kelita at Ezr.10.23; ; Also named: qe.li.ta (קְלִיטָא "Kelita" H7042H) ; § Kelaiah = "Jehovah has dishonoured"; 1) a Levite who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra; 1a) also 'Kelita';

קליטא.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Neh.8.7; § Kelita = "crippled"; 1) a Levite who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra; 1a) also 'Kelaiah'

קלל.definition: 1) to be slight, be swift, be trifling, be of little account, be light; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be slight, be abated (of water); 1a2) to be swift; 1a3) to be trifling, be of little account; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be swift, show oneself swift; 1b2) to appear trifling, be too trifling, be insignificant; 1b3) to be lightly esteemed; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to make despicable; 1c2) to curse; 1d) (Pual) to be cursed; 1e) (Hiphil); 1e1) to make light, lighten; 1e2) to treat with contempt, bring contempt or dishonour; 1f) (Pilpel); 1f1) to shake; 1f2) to whet; 1g) (Hithpalpel) to shake oneself, be moved to and fro
קלל.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √qll 'to be light; to curse'. Opposite of כבד.

קלס.definition: 1) to mock, scoff; 1a) (Piel) to scoff at; 1b) (Hithpael) to mock, deride, make fun of

קלע.definition: 1) to sling, hurl forth; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to sling; 1a2) slinger (participle); 1b) (Piel) to sling

קלשון.definition: 1) forks, three-pronged pitchfork, goad; 1a) meaning uncertain
קלשון.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to prick;

קמה.grammar_note: feminine of active participle of H6965 (קוּם);

קמואל.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, only mentioned at Gen.22.21; ; son of: Nahor (H5152H) and Milcah (H4435); ; brother of: Uz (H5780H), Buz (H0938), Chesed (H3777), Hazo (H2375), Pildash (H6394), Jidlaph (H3044) and Bethuel (H1328A); ; half-brother of: Tebah (H2875), Gaham (H1514), Tahash (H8477) and Maacah (H4601); ; father of: Aram (H0758H); § Kemuel = "raised of God"; 1) son of Nahor by Milcah and father of Aram; 2) son of Shiphtan, prince of the tribe of Ephraim, and one of the 12 men selected to apportion the promised land between the tribes; 3) Levite, father of Hashabiah, prince of the tribe in the time of David
קמואל.grammar_note: from H6965 (קוּם) and H410 (אֵל); raised of God;

קמון.definition: ; § Camon = "raised"; the place in Gilead where the judge Jair was buried;

קמוש.definition: thistles or nettles, a thorny or useless plant; Also means: qim.ma.shon (קִמָּשׂוֹן "thorn" H7063)
קמוש.grammar_note: or קִימוֹשׁ; from an unused root meaning to sting;

קמח.grammar_note: from an unused root probably meaning to grind;

קמט.definition: 1) to seize; 1a) (Qal) to seize; 1b) (Pual) to be snatched away prematurely

קמל.definition: 1) to be decayed, be withered; 1a) (Qal) to moulder, be withered

קמץ.definition: (Qal) to grasp, enclose with the hand, take a handful

קמשון.definition: thistles or nettles, a thorny or useless plant; Another spelling of qim.mosh (קִמּוֹשׂ "nettle" H7057)

קן.definition: 1) nest; 1a) nest (of bird); 1b) cells (like nests in Noah's ark)

קנא.definition: 1) to envy, be jealous, be envious, be zealous; 1a) (Piel); 1a1) to be jealous of; 1a2) to be envious of; 1a3) to be zealous for; 1a4) to excite to jealous anger; 1b) (Hiphil) to provoke to jealous anger, cause jealousy

קנאה.definition: 1) ardour, zeal, jealousy; 1a) ardour, jealousy, jealous disposition (of husband); 1a1) sexual passion; 1b) ardour of zeal (of religious zeal); 1b1) of men for God; 1b2) of men for the house of God; 1b3) of God for his people; 1c) ardour of anger; 1c1) of men against adversaries; 1c2) of God against men; 1d) envy (of man); 1e) jealousy (resulting in the wrath of God)

קנה.definition: 1) to get, acquire, create, buy, possess; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to get, acquire, obtain; 1a1a) of God originating, creating, redeeming His people; 1a1a1) possessor; 1a1b) of Eve acquiring; 1a1c) of acquiring knowledge, wisdom; 1a2) to buy; 1b) (Niphal) to be bought; 1c) (Hiphil) to cause to possess; Aramaic equivalent: qe.na (קְנָא "to buy" H7066)

קנז.definition: A man of the Edomites living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.36.11; ; son of: Eliphaz (H0464); ; brother of: Teman (H8487), Omar (H0201), Zepho (H6825), Gatam (H1609), Amalek (H6002H) and Korah (H7141H); § Kenaz = "hunter"; 1) son of Eliphaz and grandson of Esau; one of the dukes of Edom; 2) a brother of Caleb and father of Othniel
קנז.grammar_note: probably from an unused root meaning to hunt; hunter;

קנזי.definition: Someone descended from Keniz(?), only mentioned at Gen.15.19; § Kenezite or Kenizzites = "descendant of Kenaz"; descendants of Kenaz

קנין.definition: 1) thing acquired, acquisition, possession, purchased property, wealth; 1a) thing acquired (by purchase); 1b) creatures (more general)

קנמון.definition: 1) cinnamon; 1a) fragrant bark used as spice
קנמון.grammar_note: from an unused root (meaning to erect);

קנן.definition: 1) to make a nest; 1a) (Piel) to make a nest; 1b) (Pual) to be nested
קנן.grammar_note: a primitive root; to erect; but used only as denominative from H7064 (קֵן);

קנץ.grammar_note: from an unused root probably meaning to wrench;

קנת.definition: ; § Kenath = "possession"; a city in Gilead east of the Jordan taken possession of by a certain Nobah and renamed in his own honour;

קסם.definition: 1) (Qal) to practice divination, divine; 1a) of diviners of the nations, Balaam; 1b) of false prophets of Israel; 1c) prohibited

קסת.grammar_note: from the same as H3563 (כּוֹס) (or as H7185 (קָשָׁה));

קעילה.definition: ; § Keilah = "fortress"; a city in the lowlands of Judah northwest of Hebron;
קעילה.grammar_note: perhaps from H7049 (קָלַע) in the sense of enclosing; citadel;

קפא.definition: v; 1) to thicken, condense, congeal, settle, become dense; 1a) (Qal) to be condensed; 1a1) thickening (participle); 1b) (Hiphil) to cause to curdle

קפוד.definition: species of bird, perhaps the bittern (from its contracted form)
קפוד.grammar_note: or קִפֹּדlemma קִכֹּד kaf, corrected to קִפֹּד; from H7088 (קָפַד);

קפוז.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to contract, i.e.

קפץ.definition: 1) to draw together, close, shut, shut up, stop up; 1a) (Qal) to shut; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to draw oneself together (of death); 1b2) to be shut up to death; 1c) (Piel) springing, skipping (participle)

קץ.definition: 1) end; 1a) end, at the end of (of time); 1b) end (of space)

קצב.definition: 1) cut, shape, extremity, form, base; 1a) cut, shape; 1b) extremity

קצה.definition: 1) end, extremity; 1a) end, mouth, extremity; 1b) border, outskirts; 1c) the whole (condensed term for what is included within extremities); 1d) at the end of (a certain time); Also means: qe.tseh (קֵ֫צֶה "end" H7097B)

קצו.grammar_note: and (feminine) קִצְוָה; from H7096 (קָצָה); (used like H7097 (קָצֶה), but with less variety)

קצח.definition: 1) black cummin; 1a) a plant with small black acrid seeds used as a condiment
קצח.grammar_note: from an unused root apparently meaning to incise;

קצין.definition: 1) chief, ruler, commander; 1a) chief, commander (in war); 1b) dictator; 1c) ruler (of one in authority)
קצין.grammar_note: from H7096 (קָצָה) in the sense of determining;

קציעה.definition: 1) cassia; 1a) a spice; a powdered bark like cinnamon

קציץ.definition: ; Combined with e.meq (עֵ֫מֶק "Emek" H6010J) ; § Keziz = "cut off"; a town on Benjamin and the eastern border of the tribe;

קציר.definition: 1) harvest, harvesting; 1a) process of harvesting; 1b) crop, what is harvested or reaped; 1c) time of harvest

קצע.definition: 1) to be cornered, be set in corners; 1a) (Hophal) to cut off places, make corners

קצף.definition: 1) to be displeased, be angry, fret oneself, be wroth; 1a) (Qal) to be wroth, to be full of wrath, to be furious; 1b) (Hiphil) to provoke to wrath or anger; 1c) (Hithpael) to put oneself in a rage, anger oneself; Aramaic equivalent: qe.tsaph (קְצַף "be angry" H7108)

קצפה.definition: snapping or splintering, something fragmented or splintered

קצץ.definition: 1) to cut off; 1a) (Qal) to cut off; 1b) (Piel) to cut or hew off, cut in two, cut in pieces; 1c) (Pual) to be cut or hewn off; Aramaic equivalent: qe.tsats (קְצַץ "to cut" H7113)

קצר.definition: 1) to be short, be impatient, be vexed, be grieved; 1a) (Qal) to be short; 1b) (Piel) to shorten; 1c) (Hiphil) to shorten
קצר.etymologyText: From Proto-Semitic √qṣr 'to be short'. Also 'to harvest'.

קצת.definition: 1) end, part; 1a) end; 1a1) of corners, of earth; 1b) from the end of; 1c) at the end of; Aramaic equivalent: qe.tsat (קְצָת "end" H7118)

קר.grammar_note: contracted from an unused root meaning to chill;

קרא.definition: : call_out/shout/announce; 1) to call, call out, recite, read, cry out, proclaim; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to call, cry, utter a loud sound; 1a2) to call unto, cry (for help), call (with name of God); 1a3) to proclaim; 1a4) to read aloud, read (to oneself), read; 1a5) to summon, invite, call for, call and commission, appoint, call and endow; 1a6) to call, name, give name to, call by; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to call oneself; 1b2) to be called, be proclaimed, be read aloud, be summoned, be named; 1c) (Pual) to be called, be named, be called out, be chosen
קרא.pattern: Qal: call, read; Niphal: be called; Pual: be called/named

קראה.definition: 1) (BDB) to encounter, befall, meet; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to meet, encounter; 1a2) to befall (fig)

קרב.definition: : among/within; 1) midst, among, inner part, middle; 1a) inward part; 1a1) physical sense; 1a2) as seat of thought and emotion; 1a3) as faculty of thought and emotion; 1b) in the midst, among, from among (of a number of persons); 1c) entrails (of sacrificial animals); Also means: qe.rev (קֶ֫רֶב ": inner_parts" H7130H)

קרבן.definition: offering, oblation; Also means: qur.ban (קֻרְבָּן "offering" H7133B)

קרדם.grammar_note: perhaps from H6923 (קָדַם) in the sense of striking upon;

קרה.definition: 1) to encounter, meet, befall, happen, come to meet; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to encounter, meet; 1a2) to befall; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to encounter, meet (without pre-arrangement); 1b2) to chance to be present; 1b3) to come to meet; 1c) (Hiphil) to cause to meet, appoint

קרח.definition: 1) to be bald, make bald; 1a) (Qal) to make bald, make a baldness; 1b) (Niphal) to make oneself bald; 1c) (Hiphil) to make oneself bald; 1d)(Hophal) to make bald

קרחי.definition: Someone descended from Korah who was a man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Exo.6.21; ; son of: Izhar (H3324); ; brother of: Nepheg (H5298), Zichri (H2147) and Shelomith (H8019A); ; father of: Assir (H0617), Elkanah (H0511) and Ebiasaph (H0043); Group of qo.rach (קֹ֫רַח "Korah" H7141I) ; § Korahite = "one of Korah"; descendants of Korah the son of Levi;

קרחת.definition: baldness of head, back baldness, bald spot

קרי.definition: opposition, contrariness, encounter, contrary or hostile encounter

קריה.definition: 1) city, town; 1a) in general; 1b) in specific; 1c) collective; 1d) indefinite; Aramaic equivalent: qir.yah (קִרְיָה "town" H7149)
קריה.grammar_note: from H7136 (קָרָה) in the sense of flooring, i.e.

קריות.definition: ; § Kerioth = "cities"; a town in the southern district of Judah

קרית ארבע.definition: Kirjath-arba = "city of Arba"; early name of the city which after the conquest was called 'Hebron'; Another name of chev.ron (חֶבְרוֹן "Hebron" H2275A)
קרית ארבע.grammar_note: or (with the article interposed) קִרְיַת הָאַרְבַּע; (Nehemiah 11:25), from H7151 (קִרְיָה) and H704 (אַרְבַּע) or H702 (אַרְבַּע); city of Arba, or city of the four (giants);

קרית בעל.definition: Kirjath-baal = "city of Baal"; a city on the northern boundary of Judah and on the western and southern boundaries of Benjamin; also 'Kirjath-jearim' and 'Baalah'; Another name of qir.yat ye.a.rim (קִרְיַת יְעָרִים "Kiriath-jearim" H7157)
קרית בעל.grammar_note: from H7151 (קִרְיָה) and H1168 (בַּעַל); city of Baal;

קרית חצות.definition: ; § Kirjath-huzoth = "city of streets"; a city in Moab;
קרית חצות.grammar_note: from H7151 (קִרְיָה) and the feminine plural of H2351 (חוּץ); city of streets;

קריתים.definition: Kiriathaim = "two cities"; a city east of the Jordan in Moab; Also named: qe.riy.yot (קְרִיּוֹת "Kerioth" H7152H)

קרית יערים.definition: ; § Kirjath-jearim = "city of forests"; a city on the northern boundary of Judah and on the western and southern boundaries of Benjamin; also 'Kirjath-baal' and 'Baalah';
קרית יערים.grammar_note: or (Jeremiah 26:20) with the article interposed; or (Joshua 18:28) simply the former part of the word; or קִרְיַת עָרִים; from H7151 (קִרְיָה) and the plural of H3293 (יַעַר) or H5892 (עִיר); city of forests, or city of towns;

קרית סנה.definition: Kirjath-Sannah or Kirjath-Sepher, a place in Palestine
קרית סנה.grammar_note: or קִרְיַת סֵפֶר; from H7151 (קִרְיָה) and a simpler feminine from the same as H5577 (סַנְסִן), or (for the latter name) H5612 (סֵפֶר); city of branches, or of a book;

קרם.definition: 1) to spread or lay something over, cover, spread over; 1a) (Qal) to be spread over

קרן.definition: 1) horn; 1a) horn; 1b) of strength (fig); 1c) flask (container for oil); 1d) horn (as musical instrument); 1e) horn (of horn-like projections on the altar); 1f) of rays of light; 1g) hill; Aramaic equivalent: qe.ren (קֶ֫רֶן "horn" H7162)
קרן.grammar_note: a primitive root; to push or gore; used only as denominative from H7161 (קֶרֶן),

קרן הפוך.definition: A woman living at the time of the Patriarchs, only mentioned at Job.42.14; ; daughter of: Job (H0347); ; sister of: Jemimah (H3224) and Keziah (H7103) ; § Keren-happuch = "horn of antimony"; one of the daughters of Job born after his trial;
קרן הפוך.grammar_note: from H7161 (קֶרֶן) and H6320 (פּוּךְ); horn of cosmetic;

קרס.grammar_note: a primitive root; properly, to protrude; used only as denominative from H7165 (קֶרֶס) (for alliteration with H7167 (קָרַע)),

קרע.definition: 1) to tear, tear in pieces; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to tear, rend; 1a2) to tear away or out; 1a3) to tear, rend asunder; 1a3a) to make wide or large (of eyes); 1a3b) to rend open (of heavens); 1a4) to tear, rend (of wild beasts); 1b) (Niphal) to be rent, be split asunder

קרץ.definition: 1) to narrow, form, nip, pinch, squeeze, wink, purse; 1a) (Qal) to pinch; 1b) (Pual) to be nipped or pinched off, be formed

קרקר.definition: ; § Karkor = "foundation"; a place east of the Jordan in Gilead where Zebah and Zalmunna were again routed by Gideon;

קרש.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to split off;

קרת.grammar_note: from H7136 (קָרָה) in the sense of building;

קרתה.definition: Kartah = "city"; a town in Zebulun allotted to the Merarite Levites; Another name of qit.ron (קִטְרוֹן "Kitron" H7003)

קרתן.definition: Kartan = "two cities"; 1) a town in Naphtali allotted to the Gershonite Levites; 1a) also 'Kirjathaim'

קשא.grammar_note: from an unused root (meaning to be hard);

קשב.definition: 1) to hear, be attentive, heed, incline (of ears), attend (of ears), hearken, pay attention, listen; 1a) (Qal) incline, attend (of ears), hearken, pay attention, listen; 1b) (Hiphil) to pay attention, give attention

קשה.definition: 1) to be hard, be severe, be fierce, be harsh; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be hard, be difficult; 1a2) to be hard, be severe; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be ill-treated; 1b2) to be hard pressed; 1c) (Piel) to have severe labour (of women); 1d) (Hiphil); 1d1) to make difficult, make difficulty; 1d2) to make severe, make burdensome; 1d3) to make hard, make stiff, make stubborn; 1d3a) of obstinacy (fig); 1d4) to show stubbornness
קשה.grammar_note: or קַשְׂוָה; from an unused root meaning to be round;

קשח.definition: 1) to make hard, treat hardly, treat severely; 1a) (Hiphil); 1a1) to make hard, make stubborn; 1a2) to treat hardly, treat roughly

קשט.definition: truth, balanced verity; Aramaic equivalent: qe.shot (קְשֹׁט "truth" H7187)
קשט.grammar_note: or קֹשְׁטְ; from an unused root meaning to balance;

קשיון.definition: Kishion = "hard"; a town on the boundary of Issachar allotted to the Gershonite Levites; Also named: qe.desh (קֶ֫דֶשׁ "Kedesh" H6943I)

קשיטה.definition: 1) a unit of unknown value; 1a) perhaps weight, money
קשיטה.grammar_note: from an unused root (probably meaning to weigh out);

קשקשת.grammar_note: by reduplication from an unused root meaning to shale off as bark;

קשר.definition: 1) to bind, tie, bind together, league together, conspire; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to bind, confine; 1a2) to league together, conspire; 1b) (Niphal) to be bound, be bound up; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to bind on; 1c2) to bind fast; 1c3) to bind, tie; 1c4) to bind to oneself; 1d) (Pual) robust, vigorous (participle); 1e) (Hithpael) to conspire

קשש.definition: 1) to gather, assemble; 1a) (Qal) to gather together; 1b) (Hithpoel) to gather oneself together
קשש.grammar_note: a primitive root; to become sapless through drought; used only as denominative from H7179 (קַשׁ);

קשת.definition: 1) bow; 1a) bow (for hunting, battle); 1b) bowmen, archers; 1c) bow (fig. of might); 1d) rainbow
קשת.grammar_note: from H7185 (קָשָׁה) in the original sense (of H6983 (קוֹשׁ)) of bending;

ראה.definition: : approach/close/[see]face; 1) to see, look at, inspect, perceive, consider; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to see; 1a2) to see, perceive; 1a3) to see, have vision; 1a4) to look at, see, regard, look after, see after, learn about, observe, watch, look upon, look out, find out; 1a5) to see, observe, consider, look at, give attention to, discern, distinguish; 1a6) to look at, gaze at; ; 1a7) to provide, choose; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to appear, present oneself; 1b2) to be seen; 1b3) to be visible; 1c) (Pual) to be seen; 1d) (Hiphil); 1d1) to cause to see, show; 1d2) to cause to look intently at, behold, cause to gaze at; 1e) (Hophal); 1e1) to be caused to see, be shown; 1e2) to be exhibited to; 1f) (Hithpael) to look at each other, face
ראה.pattern: Qal: see; Niphal: appear; Hiphil: show

ראובן.definition: A man of the tribe of Reuben living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.29.32; ; son of: Israel (H3478) and Leah (H3812); ; brother of: Simeon (H8095), Levi (H3878), Judah (H3063), Issachar (H3485), Zebulun (H2074) and Dinah (H1783); ; half-brother of: Dan (H1835H), Naphtali (H5321), Gad (H1410), Asher (H0836), Joseph (H3130) and Benjamin (H1144); ; father of: Hanoch (H2585J), Pallu (H6396), Hezron (H2696) and Carmi (H3756) ; § Reuben = "behold a son"; 1) the eldest son of Jacob by Leah; 2) the tribe descended from Reuben; 3) the territory inhabited by the tribe of Reuben;
ראובן.grammar_note: from the imperative of H7200 (רָאָה) and H1121 (בֵּן); see ye a son;

ראובני.definition: Someone from the tribe of Reuben living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.29.32; ; son of: Israel (H3478) and Leah (H3812); ; brother of: Simeon (H8095), Levi (H3878), Judah (H3063), Issachar (H3485), Zebulun (H2074) and Dinah (H1783); ; half-brother of: Dan (H1835H), Naphtali (H5321), Gad (H1410), Asher (H0836), Joseph (H3130) and Benjamin (H1144); ; father of: Hanoch (H2585J), Pallu (H6396), Hezron (H2696) and Carmi (H3756); Group of re.u.ven (רְאוּבֵן "Reuben" H7205) ; § Reubenite, of Reuben "behold a son"; a descendant of Reuben the son of Jacob;

ראומה.definition: A woman living at the time of the Patriarchs, only mentioned at Gen.22.24; ; mother of: Tebah (H2875), Gaham (H1514), Tahash (H8477) and Maacah (H4601) ; § Reumah = "elevated"; the concubine of Nahor, the brother of Abraham;

רמת גלעד.grammar_note: or רָמוֹת גִּלעָד; (2 Chronicles 22:5), from the plural of H7413 (רָמָה) and H1568 (גִּלְעָד); heights of Gilad;

רמת המצפה.definition: Ramath-mizpeh = "high place of the watch tower"; a place in Gilead on the northern border of Gad; Another name of ra.mot gi.l.ad (רָמֹת "Ramoth" H7433)
רמת המצפה.grammar_note: from H7413 (רָמָה) and H4707 (מִצְפֶּה) with the article interpolated; height of the watch-tower;

רמתי.definition: Someone descended from Ramath(?), only mentioned at 1Ch.27.27 ; § Ramathite, of Ramah "the height"; an inhabitant of Ramah;

רמתים צופים.definition: Ramathaim-zophim = "double height of the watchers"; the home place of Samuel located in the hill country of Ephraim; the same as ra.mah (רָמָה "Ramah" H7414); Another name of mits.pah (מִצְפָּה "Mizpah" H4709G)
רמתים צופים.grammar_note: from the dual of H7413 (רָמָה) and the plural of the active participle of H6822 (צָפָה); double height of watchers;

רמת לחי.definition: ; § Ramath-lehi = "height of a jawbone"; a place by the rock Elam in northern Judah near the border of the Philistines; named by Samson after his slaughter of the 1000 Philistines with the jawbone of an ass;
רמת לחי.grammar_note: from H7413 (רָמָה) and H3895 (לְחִי); height of a jaw-bone;

רנה.definition: 1) ringing cry; 1a) of entreaty, supplication; 1b) in proclamation, joy, praise

רנן.definition: 1) to cry out, shout for joy, give a ringing cry; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to give a ringing cry (in joy, exaltation, distress); 1a2) to cry aloud (in summons, exhortation of wisdom); 1b) (Piel) to give a ringing cry (in joy, exultation, praise; 1c) (Pual) ringing cry, singing out (passive); 1d) (Hiphil) to cause to ring or sing out (for joy); 1e) (Hithpolel) rejoicing (participle); Also means: ran.nen (רַנֵּן "to sing" H7444)

רסה.definition: ; § Rissah = "ruin"; a station of Israel in the wilderness;
רסה.grammar_note: from H7450 (רָסַס); a ruin (as dripping to pieces);

רסן.definition: 1) something that restrains, halter, jaw; 1a) halter; 1a1) of restraint thrown off (fig); 1b) jaw (of crocodile)
רסן.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to curb;

רסס.grammar_note: a primitive root; to comminute; used only as denominative from H7447 (רָסִיס),

רע.definition: : harmful; adj; 1) bad, evil; 1a) bad, disagreeable, malignant; 1b) bad, unpleasant, evil (giving pain, unhappiness, misery); 1c) evil, displeasing; 1d) bad (of its kind-land, water, etc); 1e) bad (of value); 1f) worse than, worst (comparison); 1g) sad, unhappy; 1h) evil (hurtful); 1i) bad, unkind (vicious in disposition); 1j) bad, evil, wicked (ethically); 1j1) in general, of persons, of thoughts; 1j2) deeds, actions

רעב.definition: 1) to be hungry, be voracious; 1a) (Qal) to be hungry; 1b) (Hiphil) to allow one to be hungry, allow to hunger

רעד.definition: 1) to tremble, quake; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to tremble; 1a2) (earth)quake; 1b) (Hiphil) trembling (participle)

רעה.definition: 1) to pasture, tend, graze, feed; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to tend, pasture; 1a1a) to shepherd; 1a1b) of ruler, teacher (fig); 1a1c) of people as flock (fig); 1a1d) shepherd, herdsman (subst); 1a2) to feed, graze; 1a2a) of cows, sheep etc (literal); 1a2b) of idolater, Israel as flock (fig); 1b) (Hiphil) shepherd, shepherdess; Also means: ro.i (רֹעִי "to shepherd" H7473)

רעו.definition: good pleasure, will; Aramaic of re.ut (רְעוּת "longing" H7469)
רעו.grammar_note: for H7471 (רְעִי) in the sense of H7453 (רֵעַ); friend;

רעואל.definition: A man of the Edomites living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.36.4; ; son of: Esau (H6215) and Mahalath (H4258); ; half-brother of: Eliphaz (H0464), Jeush (H3266), Jalam (H3281) and Korah (H7141); ; father of: Nahath (H5184), Zerah (H2226), Shammah (H8048) and Mizzah (H4199); § Reuel or Raguel = "friend of God"; 1) a son of Esau by his wife Bashemath, the sister of Ishmael; 2) the father-in-law of Moses; 2a) also 'Jethro'; 3) father of Eliasaph, the leader of the tribe of Gad at the time of the census at Sinai; 4) a Benjamite, ancestor of Elah
רעואל.grammar_note: from the same as H7466 (רְעוּ) and H410 (אֵל); friend of God;

רעות.definition: longing, striving; Aramaic equivalent: re.ut (רְעוּ "pleasure" H7470)
רעות.grammar_note: from H7462 (רָעָה) in the sense of H7453 (רֵעַ);

רעי.definition: shepherd (subst); A grammatical form of ra.ah (רָעָה "to pasture" H7462B)

רעיון.definition: longing, striving; Aramaic equivalent: ra.yon (רַעְיוֹן "thought" H7476)
רעיון.grammar_note: from H7462 (רָעָה) in the sense of H7469 (רְעוּת);

רעל.definition: 1) to quiver, shake, reel; 1a) (Hophal) to be made to quiver or shake

רעליה.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.2; also called Raamiah at Neh.7.7; ; Also named: ra.am.yah (רַעַמְיָה "Raamiah" H7485) ; § Reelaiah = "bearer of Jehovah"; 1) one who returned from exile with Zerubbabel; 1a) also 'Raamiah';
רעליה.grammar_note: from H7477 (רָעַל) and H3050 (יָהּ); made to tremble (i.e. fearful) of Jah;

רעם.definition: 1) to thunder; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to make the sound of thunder, thunder; 1a2) to rage; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to thunder, cause thunder; 1b2) to tremble, cause to tremble (by extension)

רעמה.definition: 1) vibration, quivering, waving, mane (of horse); 1a) meaning uncertain

רעמיה.definition: A man living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at Ezr.2.2; also called Raamiah at Neh.7.7; ; Another name of re.e.la.yah (רְעֵלָיָה "Reelaiah" H7480) ; § Raamiah = "thunder of Jehovah"; 1) one who returned from exile with Zerubbabel; 1a) also 'Reelaiah';
רעמיה.grammar_note: from H7481 (רָעַם) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has shaken;

רעמסס.definition: ; § Raamses or Rameses = "child of the sun"; a city in lower Egypt built by Hebrew slaves; probably in Goshen

רענן.definition: adj; luxuriant, fresh; Aramaic equivalent: ra.a.nan (רַעֲנַן "luxuriant" H7487)

רעע.definition: 1) to be bad, be evil; 1a)(Qal); 1a1) to be displeasing; 1a2) to be sad; 1a3) to be injurious, be evil; 1a4) to be wicked, be evil (ethically); 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to do an injury or hurt; 1b2) to do evil or wickedly; 1b3) mischief (participle)

רעף.definition: 1) to trickle, drip; 1a) (Qal) to trickle, drip; 1b) (Hiphil) to trickle

רעש.definition: 1) to quake, shake; 1a) (Qal) to quake, shake; 1b) (Niphal) to be made to quake; 1c)(Hiphil); 1c1) to cause to quake; 1c2) to cause to spring or leap (of horse)

רפא.definition: 1) to heal, make healthful; 1a) (Qal) to heal; 1a1) of God; 1a2) healer, physician (of men); 1a3) of hurts of nations involving restored favour (fig); 1a4) of individual distresses (fig); 1b) (Niphal) to be healed; 1b1) literal (of persons); 1b2) of water, pottery; 1b3) of national hurts (fig); 1b4) of personal distress (fig); 1c) (Piel) to heal; 1c1) literal; 1c2) of national defects or hurts (fig); 1d) (Hithpael) in order to get healed (infinitive)

רפאל.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.26.7; ; son of: Shemaiah (H8098I); ; brother of: Othni (H6273), Obed (H5744J), Elzabad (H0443H), Elihu (H0453I) and Semachiah (H5565) ; § Rephael = "healed of God"; son of Shemaiah and grandson of Obed-edom;
רפאל.grammar_note: from H7495 (רָפָא) and H410 (אֵל); God has cured;

רפד.definition: 1) to spread; 1a) (Qal) to spread; 1b) (Piel) to spread out, support

רפה.definition: 1) to sink, relax, sink down, let drop, be disheartened; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to sink down; 1a2) to sink, drop; 1a3) to sink, relax, abate; 1a4) to relax, withdraw; 1b) (Niphal) idle (participle); 1c) (Piel) to let drop; 1d) (Hiphil); 1d1) to let drop, abandon, relax, refrain, forsake; 1d2) to let go; 1d3) to refrain, let alone; 1d4) to be quiet; 1e) (Hithpael) to show oneself slack

רפוא.definition: A man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, only mentioned at Num.13.9; ; father of: Palti (H6406) ; § Raphu = "healed"; father of Palti, the spy from the tribe of Benjamin;

רפח.definition: A man of the tribe of Ephraim living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.7.25; ; son of: Beriah (H1283H); ; brother of: Sheerah (H7609) and Resheph (H7566) ; § Rephah = "healing of the breath"; son of Ephraim and a ancestor of Joshua;
רפח.grammar_note: from an unused root apparently meaning to sustain; support;

רפידים.definition: ; § Rephidim = "rests" or "stays" or "resting places"; a station of Israel in the wilderness between Egypt and Sinai;
רפידים.grammar_note: plural of the masculine of the same as H7507 (רְפִידָה); ballusters;

רפיה.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.3.21; ; son of: Hananiah (H2608L); ; brother of: Pelatiah (H6410), Jeshaiah (H3470B), Arnan (H0770), Obadiah (H5662H) and Shecaniah (H7935); § Rephaiah = "healed of Jehovah"; 1) a descendant of Zerubbabel and David; 2) a Simeonite chief in the reign of Hezekiah; 3) son of Tola and grandson of Issachar; 4) son of Binea and a descendant of Saul; 5) son of Hur and a ruler of Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah
רפיה.grammar_note: from H7495 (רָפָא) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has cured;

רפס.definition: 1) (Hithpael); 1c1) to stamp oneself down, humble oneself; 1c2) stamping or tramping down (participle); Aramaic equivalent: re.phas (רְפַס "to tread" H7512)

רפק.definition: 1) to support; 1a) (Hithpael) to support oneself, lean

רפש.definition: 1) to stamp, tread, foul by stamping or treading; 1a) (Qal) to tread down, foul by treading, foul with the feet; 1b) (Niphal) to be fouled

רצד.definition: (Piel) to watch stealthily or with envious hostility, watch with enmity, watch with envy

רצה.definition: 1) to be pleased with, be favourable to, accept favourably; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be pleased with, be favourable to; 1a2) to accept; 1a3) to be pleased, be determined; 1a4) to make acceptable, satisfy; 1a5) to please; 1b) (Niphal) to be accepted, be pleased with; 1c) (Piel) to seek favour of; 1d) (Hiphil) to please, pay off; 1e) (Hithpael) to make oneself acceptable or pleasing

רצון.definition: 1) pleasure, delight, favour, goodwill, acceptance, will; 1a) goodwill, favour; 1b) acceptance; 1c) will, desire, pleasure, self-will

רצח.definition: 1) to murder, slay, kill; 1a)(Qal) to murder, slay; 1a1) premeditated; 1a2) accidental; 1a3) as avenger; 1a4) slayer (intentional) (participle); 1b) (Niphal) to be slain; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to murder, assassinate; 1c2) murderer, assassin (participle) (subst); 1d) (Pual) to be killed

רציא.definition: A man of the tribe of Asher living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.7.39; ; son of: Shual (H7777B); ; brother of: Arah (H0733) and Hanniel (H2592H) ; § Rezia = "delight"; an Asherite of the sons of Ulla;

רצין.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Ki.15.37; § Rezin = "firm"; 1) king of Damascus during the reigns of kings Jotham and Ahaz of Judah; 2) the progenitor of a family of temple slaves who returned from captivity with Zerubbabel

רצע.definition: 1) (Qal) to bore, pierce; 1a) of the ear

רצף.definition: hot stone, glowing stone or coal, flame, firebolt, spark; Another spelling of rits.pah (רִצְפָּה "glowing stone" H7531B)

רצפה.definition: glowing stone or coal, live coal; Also means: re.tseph (רֶצֶף "coal" H7529)

רצץ.definition: 1) to crush, oppress; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to crush, get crushed, be crushed; 1a2) to crush, oppress (fig); 1a3) crushed (participle passive); 1b) (Niphal) to be crushed, be broken; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to crush in pieces; 1c2) to grievously oppress (fig); 1d) (Poel) to oppress (fig); 1e) (Hiphil) to crush; 1f) (Hithpoel) to crush each other

רק.definition: 1) only, altogether, surely; 1a) only; 1b) only, nought but, altogether (in limitation); 1c) save, except (after a negative); 1d) only, altogether, surely (with an affirmative); 1e) if only, provided only (prefixed for emphasis); 1f) only, exclusively (for emphasis)

רקד.definition: 1) to skip about; 1a) (Qal) to skip about; 1b) (Piel) to dance, leap; 1c) (Hiphil) to make to skip

רקון.definition: ; § Rakkon = "the temple"; a well-watered place in Dan near Joppa;

רקח.definition: 1) to mix, compound; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to mix, compound; 1a2) compounder, mixer, perfumer (participle) (subst); 1b) (Pual) mixed (participle); 1c) (Hiphil) to mix

רקיע.definition: 1) extended surface (solid), expanse, firmament; 1a) expanse (flat as base, support); 1b) firmament (of vault of heaven supporting waters above); 1b1) considered by Hebrews as solid and supporting 'waters' above

רקיק.grammar_note: from, H7556 (רָקַק) in its original sense;

רקם.definition: 1) to variegate, mix colours; 1a) (Qal) variegator (worker in colours) (participle); 1b) (Pual) to be skilfully wrought or woven

רקע.definition: 1) to beat, stamp, beat out, spread out, stretch; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to stamp, beat out; 1a2) one who beats out (participle); 1b) (Piel) to overlay, beat out (for plating); 1c) (Pual) beaten out (participle); 1d) (Hiphil) to make a spreading (of clouds)

רקת.definition: Rakkath = "shore"; a fortified city in Naphtali; Also named: Tiberias (Τιβεριάς "Tiberias" G5085H)
רקת.grammar_note: from H7556 (רָקַק) in its original sense of diffusing; a beach (as expanded shingle);

רשיון.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to have leave;

רשם.definition: 1) to inscribe, note; 1a) (Qal) that which is inscribed (participle); Aramaic equivalent: re.sham (רְשַׁם "to sign" H7560)

רשע.definition: 1) to be wicked, act wickedly; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be wicked, act wickedly; 1a2) to be guilty, be condemned; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to condemn as guilty (in civil relations); 1b2) to condemn as guilty (in ethical or religious relations); 1b3) to act wickedly (in ethics and religion)

רשעה.definition: 1) wickedness, guilt; 1a) wickedness (in civil relations); 1b) wickedness (of enemies); 1c) wickedness (ethical and religious)

רשש.definition: 1) to beat down, shatter; 1a) (Poel) to beat down, shatter; 1b) (Pual) to be beaten down

רשת.definition: 1) net; 1a) net; 1a1) for catching; 1a2) of judgment (fig); 1a3) of leaders leading people to sin; 1a4) as a trap for man; 1b) network (brazen-for altar of tabernacle)

רתח.definition: 1) to boil; 1a) (Piel) to cause to boil; 1b) (Pual) to be made to boil; 1c) (Hiphil) to cause to boil

רתיקה.definition: chain; Another spelling of rat.toq (רַתּוֹק "chain" H7569)

רתם.definition: 1) broom-plant, retem; 1a) a kind of broom plant

רתמה.definition: ; § Rithmah = "heath"; station of Israel in the wilderness, probably northeast of Hazeroth;

רתק.definition: 1) to bind; 1a) (Niphal) to be snapped, be broken; 1b) (Pual) to be bound

שאב.definition: 1) to draw (water); 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to draw (water); 1a2) water-drawing women (participle)

שאג.definition: 1) (Qal) to roar; 1a) of lion, conqueror, Jehovah, cry of distress

שאגה.definition: 1) roaring; 1a) of lion, the wicked, distress cry

שאה.definition: 1) crash, make a din or crash, crash into ruins, be in ruins, be desolated; 1a) (Qal) to crash into ruins; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be ruined; 1b2) to crash; 1b3) to be left (a desolation); 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to cause to crash; 1c2) to cause to be desolated

שאול.definition: Sheol, underworld, grave, hell, pit; 1a) the underworld; 1b) Sheol-the OT designation for the abode of the dead; 1b1) place of no return; 1b2) without praise of God; 1b3) wicked sent there for punishment; 1b4) righteous not abandoned to it; 1b5) of the place of exile (fig); 1b6) of extreme degradation in sin;

שאולי.definition: Someone descended from Shaul who was a man of the tribe of Simeon living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at Gen.46.10; ; son of: Simeon (H8095) and Canaanite_woman (H3669); ; brother of: Jemuel (H3223), Jamin (H3226), Ohad (H0161), Jachin (H3199) and Zerah (H2226L); ; father of: Shallum (H7967K); Group of sha.ul (שָׁאוּל "Shaul" H7586H) ; § Shaulites, of Saul "desired"; descendants of Saul or Shaul;

שאון.definition: 1) roar, din, crash, uproar; 1a) roar (of water); 1b) uproar (of revellers)

שאט.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to push aside;

שאל.definition: 1) to ask, enquire, borrow, beg; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to ask, ask for; 1a2) to ask (as a favour), borrow; 1a3) to enquire, enquire of; 1a4) to enquire of, consult (of deity, oracle); 1a5) to seek; 1b) (Niphal) to ask for oneself, ask leave of absence; 1c) (Piel); 1c1) to enquire, enquire carefully; 1c2) to beg, practise beggary; 1d) (Hiphil); 1d1) to be given on request; 1d2) to grant, make over to, let (one) ask (successfully) or give or lend on request (then) grant or make over to; Aramaic equivalent: she.el (שְׁאֵל "to ask" H7593)

שאלא.definition: affair, request; Aramaic of she.e.lah (שְׁאֵלָה "petition" H7596)

שאלה.definition: 1) request, thing asked for, demand; 1a) request, petition; 1b) thing asked for; Aramaic equivalent: she.e.la (שְׁאֵלָא "affair" H7595)

שאלתיאל.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah living at the time of Exile and Return, first mentioned at 1Ch.3.17; ; son of: Jehoiachin (H3078); ; brother of: Zedekiah (H6667I)(?); father(?) of Malchiram (H4443), Pedaiah (H6305H), Shenazzar (H8137), Jekamiah (H3359H), Hoshama (H1953) and Nedabiah (H5072); § Shealtiel or Salathiel = "I have asked of God"; son of king Jehoiachin or Jeconiah or Coniah of Judah and uncle of Zerubbabel
שאלתיאל.grammar_note: or שַׁלְתִּיאֵל; from H7592 (שָׁאַל) and H410 (אֵל); I have asked God;

שאן.definition: (Pilel) to be at ease, be at peace, rest, rest securely, be quiet

שאנן.definition: adj; 1) at ease, quiet, secure; 1a) at ease, secure; 1b) at ease, careless, wanton, arrogant; subst; 2) security, pride, arrogance; 2a) one at ease; 2b) arrogance

שאף.definition: 1) to gasp, pant, pant after, long for, breathe heavily; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to gasp, pant after, snuff up; 1a2) to gasp or pant (with desire), pant after, be eager for; 1a3) to thirst for one's blood (from actions of animals) (fig)

שאר.definition: 1) to remain, be left over, be left behind; 1a) (Qal) to remain; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be left over, be left alive, survive; 1b1a) remainder, remnant (participle); 1b2) to be left behind; 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to leave over, spare; 1c2) to leave or keep over; 1c3) to have left; 1c4) to leave (as a gift)

שארה.definition: kinswomen; A grammatical form of she.er (שְׁאֵר "flesh" H7607)

שאר ישוב.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at Isa.7.3; ; son of: Isaiah (H3470A); ; brother of: Maher-shalal-hash-baz (H4122) ; § Shear-jashub = "a remnant shall return"; a symbolical name for the son of Isaiah the prophet;
שאר ישוב.grammar_note: from H7605 (שְׁאָר) and H7725 (שׁוּב); a remnant will return;

שארית.definition: 1) rest, residue, remainder, remnant; 1a) rest, what is left; 1b) remainder, descendants

שאת.definition: 1) elevation, exaltation, dignity, swelling, uprising; 1a) dignity, exaltation, loftiness; 1b) swelling; 1c) uprising

שבא.definition: A man of the Cushites living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.10.7; ; son of: Raamah (H7484); ; brother of: Dedan (H1719B); also called Sabean at Job.1.15; 3x; § Sheba = "seven" or "an oath"; 1) son of Joktan and a descendant of Seth; 2) son of Raamah, grandson of Cush, and a descendant of Ham; 3) son of Jokshan, the son of Abraham by Keturah; 4) a nation in southern Arabia

שבאי.definition: Someone descended from Sheba who was a man of the Cushites living at the time of the Patriarchs, first mentioned at Gen.10.7; ; son of: Raamah (H7484); ; brother of: Dedan (H1719B); also called Sabean at Job.1.15; 3x; Group of she.va (שְׁבָא "Sheba" H7614) ; § Sabeans = "drunkard" or "he who is coming"; the people of the nation of Sheba;

שבב.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to break up;

שבה.definition: 1) to take captive; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to take captive; 1a2) captive (participle); 1a3) to lead captive; 1b) (Niphal) to be taken captive

שבו.definition: 1) a precious stone (in the high priest's breastplate); 1a) probably an agate
שבו.grammar_note: from an unused root (probably identical with that of H7617 (שָׁבָה) through the idea of subdivision into flashes or streamers (compare H7632 (שָׁבִיב)) meaning to flame;

שבואל.definition: A man of the tribe of Levi living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness, first mentioned at 1Ch.23.16; ; son of: Gershom (H1647); ; father of: Jehdeiah (H3165); also called Shubael at 1Ch.24.20; ; § Shebuel or Shubael = "captive of God"; 1) son of Gershom and grandson of Moses; 2) one of the 14 sons of Heman the musician
שבואל.grammar_note: or שׁוּבָאֵל; from H7617 (שָׁבָה) (abbreviated form) or H7725 (שׁוּב) and H410 (אֵל); captive (or returned) of God;

שבוע.definition: 1) seven, period of seven (days or years), heptad, week; 1a) period of seven days, a week; 1a1) Feast of Weeks; 1b) heptad, seven (of years); Also means: sha.vu.a (שָׁבוּעַ "week" H7620I)
שבוע.grammar_note: or שָׁבֻעַ; also (feminine) שְׁבֻעָה; properly, passive participle of H7650 (שָׁבַע) as a denominative of H7651 (שֶׁבַע);

שבועה.definition: 1) oath, curse; 1a) oath; 1a1) attesting of innocence; 1a2) curse; 1b) oath (of Jehovah)

שחריה.grammar_note: from H7836 (שָׁחַר) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has sought;

שחת.definition: 1) to destroy, corrupt, go to ruin, decay; 1a) (Niphal) to be marred, be spoiled, be corrupted, be corrupt, be injured, be ruined, be rotted; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to spoil, ruin; 1b2) to pervert, corrupt, deal corruptly (morally); 1c) (Hiphil); 1c1) to spoil, ruin, destroy; 1c2) to pervert, corrupt (morally); 1c3) destroyer (participle); 1d) (Hophal) spoiled, ruined (participle); Aramaic equivalent: she.chat (שְׁחַת "to corrupt" H7844)

שט.definition: swerver, revolter, rebel, deeds that swerve

שטה.definition: 1) to turn aside, go aside, turn, decline; 1a) (Qal) to turn aside

שטח.definition: 1) to spread, spread abroad, stretch out; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to spread; 1a2) spreading, expanding (participle); 1b) (Piel) to spread out

שטים.definition: Shittim = "the acacias"; place of Israel's encampment between the conquest of the transjordanic region and crossing the Jordan into Canaan; Also named: a.vel hash.shit.tim (אָבֵל הַשִּׁטִּים "Abel-shittim" H0063)

שטם.definition: 1) to hate, oppose oneself to, bear a grudge, retain animosity against, cherish animosity against; 1a) (Qal) to cherish animosity against

שטף.definition: 1) to wash, rinse, overflow, engulf, rinse or wash off; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to overflow; 1a2) to flow, run; 1a3) to rinse or wash off; 1b) (Niphal) to be swept away, be rinsed out; 1c) (Pual) to be rinsed, be scoured and rinsed

שטרי.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.27.29 ; § Shitrai = "my officers"; an official of David;
שטרי.grammar_note: from the same as H7860 (שֹׁטֵר); magisterial;

שי.definition: gift, present, gift offered as homage

שיב.definition: (Qal) to be hoary, be gray; Aramaic equivalent: siv (שִׂיב "be gray" H7868)

שיבה.definition: 1) age, gray hair, hoary head, old age; 1a) gray hair, hoary head; 1b) old age

שיד.definition: 1) lime, whitewash; 1a) made by burning bones
שיד.grammar_note: a primitive root probably meaning to boil up (compare H7736 (שׁוּד)); used only as denominative from H7875 (שִׂיד);

שיזא.definition: A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.11.42; ; father of: Adina (H5721) ; § Shiza = "splendour"; a Reubenite, father of Adina, one of David's mighty warriors;

שיח.definition: 1) to put forth, mediate, muse, commune, speak, complain, ponder, sing; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to complain; 1a2) to muse, meditate upon, study, ponder; 1a3) to talk, sing, speak; 1b) (Polel) to meditate, consider, put forth thoughts

שיחור.definition: ; § Shihor or Sihor = "dark"; a river or canal on east border of Egypt and a branch of the Nile

שיחור לבנת.definition: ; § Shihor-libnath = "blackness of whiteness"; a stream in Asher;
שיחור לבנת.grammar_note: from the same as H7883 (שִׁיחוֹר) and H3835 (לָבַן); darkish whiteness;

שילה.definition: A man living at the time of the Patriarchs, only mentioned at Gen.49.10; also translated "tribute" ; meaning uncertain;

שילוני.grammar_note: or שִׁילֹנִי; or שִׁלֹנִי; from H7887 (שִׁילֹה);

שימון.definition: A man of the tribe of Judah(?) living at the time of Divided Monarchy, only mentioned at 1Ch.4.20; ; father of: Amnon (H0550H), Rinnah (H7441), Ben-hanan (H1135), Tilon (H8436) ; § Shimon = "desert"; a Judaite, father of Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-Hanan, and Tilon;

שיר.definition: 1) to sing; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to sing; 1a2) singer, songstresses (participle); 1b) (Polel); 1b1) to sing; 1b2) singer, songstress (participle); 1c) (Hophal) to be sung
שיר.grammar_note: or (the original form) שׁוּר; (1 Samuel 18:6), a primitive root (rather identical with H7788 (שׁוּר) through the idea of strolling minstrelsy);

שיש.grammar_note: from an unused root meaning to bleach, i.e. whiten;  See H8336 (שֵׁשׁ).

שישא.definition: A man living at the time of United Monarchy, first mentioned at 2Sa.8.17; ; father of: Elihoreph (H0456) and Ahijah (H0281); also called Shavsha at 1Ch.18.16; Sheva(Ketiv: Sheya) at 2Sa.20.25; Shisha at 1Ki.4.3;; Another name of se.ra.yah (שְׂרָיָהוּ "Seraiah" H8304G) ; § Shisha = "Jehovah contends"; 1) father of Elihoreph and Ahiah, the royal secretaries in the reign of Solomon; 1a) apparently the same as 'Shavsha' who held the same position under David;
שישא.grammar_note: from the same as H7893 (שַׁיִשׁ); whiteness;

שית.definition: : make/establish; 1) to put, set; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to put, lay (hand upon); 1a2) to set, station, appoint, fix, set mind to; 1a3) to constitute, make (one something), make like, perform; 1a4) to take one's stand; 1a5) to lay waste; 1b) (Hophal) to be imposed, be set upon

שלישי.definition: 1) third, one third, third part, third time; 1a) ordinal number
